Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 10: Vehinne, teshuva illaa zo, deitdabbekuta derucha berucha al-yede tora ugemilut chasadim, hi bivchinat hameshacha milmala lematta, lihyot devar Adonai mammash befiv, uchemo shekkatuv: "vaasim devaray beficha", "vimino techabbekeni" bigmilut chasadim, dechesed deroa yemina vechulei".

Aval adam hattachton tzarich lelech mimmadrega lemadrega mimmatta lemala, hi bechinat teshuva illaa veitdabbekut rucha berucha, bechavvavnat hallev bitfilla, uvifrat bikriat-shema uvirchoteha, kede lomar: "veahavta vegomer bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha vegomer", beemet laamitto: vechen: "vehayu haddevarim haelle vegomer, vedibbarta bam vegomer", lihyot devar Adonai befiv beemet, "veen emet vechulei":

Vechen lekayyem kol hammitzvot, kemo sheomrim: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav", kemo: "hare at mekuddeshet li", hi bechinat kodesh haelyon, leshon perishut vehavedala, sheeno yachol lehitlabbesh toch almin, mishshum dechulla kammeh kela chashiv", ella bivchinat sovev kol almin, hu ratzon haelyon baruch-hu vechulei, kemo shennitbaer belikkute-amarim perek 46.

Vegam achar hattefilla omrim: "elecha Adonai nafshi essa", dehayynu, leitdabbeka rucha berucha kol hayyom vechulei. vechol ze, al-yede hahitbonnut bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu behaamakat haddaat, bishtayim lefaneha" uvifsuke dezimra", kannoda.

Umeachar shehattefilla hi bechinat teshuva illaa – tzarich lehakedim lefaneha bechinat teshuva tattaa. vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha bammishna: "en omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch koved rosh", uferesh Rashi: "hachenaa", vehi bechinat teshuva tattaa leorer rachamim kannizkar leel, vechidyalif hatam baggemara mikkera, dichtiv: vehi marat nafesh.

Achen, babbarayyta sham: "tanu rabbanan, en omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch simcha". veachshav bedor yatom hazze, sheen hakkol yecholin lahafoch libbam kerega min hakkatze, azay, etza hayyeutza lehakedim bechinat teshuva tattaa betikkun chatzot kannizkar leel. umi shei efshar lo bechol layla – al kol panim lo yifchot mippaam achat bashshavua, lifne yom hashshabbat, kannoda layyodim, shehashshabbat hi bechinat teshuva illaa, veshabbat – otiyyot "tashev enosh", ki beshabbat hi aliyyot haolamot limkoram kulei, uvifrat tefillot hashshabbat, veday lamevin.

(Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv: "shuva elay ki gealticha", perush, ki meachar shemmachiti chaav peshaecha" hi haavarat hassitra ochora, ugealticha" min hachitzonim behitorrut rachamim elyonim, beitaruta diltatta bitshuva tattaa kannizkar leel – azay – "shuva elay" bitshuva illaa):
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 11: Veamnam, lihyot belibbo hahachnaa, hi bechinat teshuva tattaa kannizkar leel, vegam hassimcha baAdonai, shetehen beyachad – kevar milleta amura belikkute-amarim sof perek 34, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh "chedva tekia belibbay missitra da vechulei". uvetzeruf od haemuna vehabbittachon, lihyot nachon libbo batuach baAdonai, ki chafetz chesed hu, vechannun verachum verav lisloach, techef umiyyad shemmevakkesh mechila uselicha meitto yitbarech ("kerov rachamecha meche feshaay" "kabbeseni tahareni", vechol avonotay meche" vechulei), beli shum safek usefek sefeka baolam.

Uchemo sheanu mevarchin bechol tefillat 18 techef shemmevakshim "selach lanu kulei" – "baruch atta Adonai channun hammarbe lisloach", vahare "sefek berachot lehakel", mishshum chashash beracha levattala? ella, en kan shum safek kelal, meachar shebbikkashnu "selach lanu" "mechal lanu", veillu lo hayinu chozrim vechotim – hayinu nigalin miyyad, kemo sheanu mevarchin: "baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael".

Vahare afilu bemiddat basar vadam ken, shetztzarich haadam limchol techef umiyyad shemmevakshim mimmennu mechila, velo yehe achzari millimchol, vaafilu bekotea yad chavero, kidita baggemara besof perek 8 devava kamma:

Veim bikkesh mimmennu 3 peamim velo machal lo – shuv en tzarich levakkesh mimmennu, vehaggivonim shebbikkesh david hammelech alav-hashshalom mehem mechila bead shaul shehemit et haggivonim, velo ratzu limchol – gazar david alehem shello yavou bikhal Adonai, shehem rachamanim vechulei, kidita beferek 8 divamot.
Uvemiddat hakkadosh-baruch-hu, al achat kamma vechamma leen ketz.

Uma shemmeshabbechim umevarchim et Adonai "channun hammarbe lisloach" – "hammarbe" dayyka, uchemo shekkatuv beezra "verav lisloach", dehayynu, shebbemiddat basar vadam, im yecheta ish leish uvikkesh mimmennu mechila umachal lo veachar kach chazar lesuro – kashe meod sheyyimchol lo shenit, umikkol shekken bishlishit ureviit.

Aval bemiddat hakkadosh-baruch-hu en hefresh ben paam achat leelef peamim, ki hammechila hi mimmiddat harachamim, umiddotav hakkedoshot enan bivchinat gevul vetachlit, ella bivchinat en-sof, kemo shekkatuv "ki lo chalu rachamav", ulegabbe bechinat en-sof en hefresh kelal ben mispar katan legadol, dechulla kammeh kela – mammash – chashiv", umashve katan vegadol vechulei".

Velachen "maavir ashmotenu bechol shana veshana", vechol hachataim shemmitvavdim beal chet" midde shana, af shechazar veavar alehem – chozer umitvadde alehem beyom hakkippurim beshana habbaa, vechen leolam. uvechol shana veshana" lav davka, ella kemo chen bechol yom vayom 3 peamim mevarchim: "baruch atta Adonai channun hammarbe lisloach".

Uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "tefilla keneged temidin tikkenuha", vetamid shel shachar haya mechapper al averot hallayla, vetamid shel ben haarbayyim al shel yom, vechen midde yom beyom leolam: ella sheyyom hakkippurim mechapper al averot chamurot, vehattamid, shehu karban ola, mechapper al mitzvot ase bilvad, vechen hattefilla bizman hazze im hatteshuva, kannizkar leel.

Veen ze "echeta veashuv", ki hayeynu davka shebbishat hachet haya yachol lichbosh yitzro, ella shessomech belibbo al hatteshuva, velachen, hoil vehatteshuva goremet lo lachato – "en maspikin vechulei". veaf gam zot "en maspikin" dayyka, aval im dachak venitchazzek venitgabber al yitzro veasa teshuva – mekabbelin teshuvato.

Aval anu shemmevakshim bechol yom: "selach lanu" – anu makdimin levakkesh: "vehachazirenu bitshuva shelema lefanecha", dehayynu shello nashuv od lechisla, vechen beyom hakkippurim mevakshim: "yehi ratzon millefanecha shello echeta od" – maspikin umaspikin, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "habba littaher mesayyeyin oto" – "habba" dayyka, miyyad shebba. vee lazot, gam hasselicha vehammechila hi miyyad.

Uma shekkatuv "vechattati negdi tamid" – en hamechuvvavn lihyot tamid atzev nivze chas veshalom, deha ketiv batreh: "tashmieni sason vesimcha vegomer veruach nediva tismecheni vegomer", umishshum shetztzarich lihyot kol yamav bitshuva illaa, shehi besimcha rabba kannizkar leel. ella "negdi" dayyka, kemo: "veatta tityatztzev minneged", "minneged saviv leohel moed yachanu", uferesh Rashi "merachok". vehamechuvvavn, rak levilti rum levavo, velihyot shefal ruach bifne chol haadam, kesheyyihye lezikkaron ben enav shechata neged Adonai.

Veadderabba, leinyan hassimcha yoil zichron hachet beyeter seet, bichde lekabbel besimcha kol hammeoraot hammitraggeshot uvaot, ben min hashshamayim, ben al-yede habberiyyot, bedibbur o bemaase (vezo etza tova lehinnatzel mikkaas vechol mine kefeda vechulei). uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "hanneelavin veenan olvin, shomin cherpatam veen meshivin, osim meahava usemechim beyissurim vechulei", vechol hammaavir al middotav – maavirim lo al kol peshaav":
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 12: Vetaam hassimcha beyissure hagguf, lefi shehi tova gedola vaatzuma lannefesh hachotet, lemarkah baolam hazze ulehatztzilah mehammeruk begehinnom (bifrat bedorotenu elle, sheen bicholet lehitannot kefi mispar kol hatztzomot shebbetikkune teshuva mehaari zichrono livracha, hatztzerichot lemeruk hannefesh lehatztzilah mimmeruk begehinnom).

Uchemo shekkatav haramban zichrono livracha bahakedama leferush iyyov, sheafilu yissurim shel iyyov 70 shana – en lahen erech kelal leyissure hannefesh shaa achat begehinnom, ki esh echad mishshishshim vechulei. ella lefi sheolam hazze "chesed yibbane", uveyissurin kallin baolam hazze nitztzol middinim kashim shel olam-habba.

Kimshal hilluch vehaetakat hatztzel baaretz tefach lefi hilluch galgal hashshemesh barakia alafim milin vechulei. veyeter al ken leen ketz hu bannimshal, bivchinat hishtalshelut haolamot merum hammaalot ad olam hazze haggashmi. vechannoda mimma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh, meinyan aliyyot olamot haelyonim beitaruta diltatta, behakeravat of echad ben yona o tor al gabbe hammizbeach o kometz mincha. vechen hu bechol hammitzvot maasiyyot, kannoda mehaarizal.

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim" – "adam mekaddesh atzmo meat millematta, mekaddeshin oto harebe milmala vechulei" (uchemo shennitbaer leel beinyan "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav" vechulei, bechinat "sovev kol almin", vechulei).

Vechacha mammash hu beinyan sachar veonesh, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "sechar mitzva – mitzva vechulei", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher. vedaat lenavon nakal, umaskil al davar yimtza tov:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 1: Potchin bivracha, levarech ulehodot laAdonai ki tov. shemua tova shama vattechi nafshi, "torat Adonai temima" – zo hashelamat kol hashshas kullo berov ayayrot uminyanim meanshe shelomenu, hodaa al heavar uvakkasha al heatid, ko yitten vecho yosif Adonai leammetz libbam baggibborim midde shana beshana, bigvura shel tora. ulehodia livne adam gevuratah shel tora shebbeal pe vechochah oz;

Peresh shelomo hammelech alav-hashshalom "chagra veoz matneha kulei" – "matnayim", hem bechinat davar hammaamid kol hagguf im harosh hannitztzav veomed alehem, vehem hammolichim umeviim oto limchoz cheftzo.

Uchemo shehu begashmiyyut hagguf, kach hu bivchinat ruchaniyyut hannefesh haelohit, haemuna haamittit baAdonai echad en-sof baruch-hu, deihu memalle kol almin vesovev kol almin, velet atar panuy minneh, lemala ad en ketz ulematta ad en tachlit, vechen led sitrin bivchinat en-sof mammash, vechen bivchinat shana venefesh, kannoda:

Hinne emuna zo nikret beshem bechinat "matnayim" davar hammaamid umekayyem et harosh, hu hassechel hammitbonen umaamik daat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat olam-shana-nefesh, uverov chasdo venifleotav immanu, lihyot "am kerovo", uledavka vo mammash, kannoda mimmaamar "yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze mikkol chayye olam-habba", shehu rak ziv veheara mibbechina hannikret "shechina" hashshochen kulei, venivra beYod achat mishshemo yitbarech kulei, aval teshuva umaasim tovim mekarvin yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim mammash, lemahuto veatzmuto kivyachol, bechinat en-sof mammash, uchemo shekkatuv "hodo al eretz veshamayim, vayyarem keren leammo kulei", "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu kulei".

Vechammayim happanim kulei" leholid mittevuna zo dechilu urechimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim, lihyot bechinat "tzaak libbam el Adonai", o bechinat rishpe esh veshalhevet azza, bivchinat "ratzo", veachar kach bivchinat "shov", lihyot pachad Adonai belibbo velevosh miggedullato kulei, vehu bechinat "semol docha", kemo shekkatuv bemattan-tora "vayyar haam vayyanuu vayyaamdu merachok kulei", vehen bechinot hazzeroot vehagguf shebbannefesh:

Ach mi hu hannoten koach vaoz livchinat "matnayim", lehaamid ulekayyem harosh vehazzeroot? – hu esek velimmud halachot battora shebbeal pe, shehi bechinat gilluy ratzon haelyon, deorayyta – mechachma hi denafkat, aval mekorah vesharshah – hu lemala mala mibbechinat chachma, vehu hannikra beshem "ratzon haelyon" baruch-hu, uchemo shekkatuv "katztzinna ratzon taterennu" kaatara shehi al hammochin shebbarosh, vechannoda mimma sheppershu al pasuk "eshet chayil ateret balah"; vechol hashshone halachot bechol yom kulei".

Vezehu "chagra veoz matneha" – "en oz ella tora" shehi notenet koach vaoz livchinat matnayim hachagurim umelubbashim bah, lechazzek uleammetz zerooteha, hen dechilu urechimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim, kol chad lefum shiura dileh, (veal haamadat vekiyyum bechinat harosh shebbannefesh, hu hassechel hammitbonen kulei, amar "taama ki tov sachrah kulei", umevoar bemakom acher):

Ach et uzeman hachizzuk veimmutz hazzeroot veharosh, hi sheat tefillat hashshachar, shehi sheat rachamim veet ratzon haelyon lemala. velazot, otah avakkesh mimmevakshe Adonai, yavinu veyaskilu yachdav, velihyot lezikkaron ben enehem kol ma shekkatavti alehem eshtakad bichlal, uvifrat meinyan kavvavnat hattefilla meumeka delibba, yom yom yidreshun Adonai bechol libbam uvechol nafsham, venafsham tishtappech kammayim nochach pene Adonai, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha besifre: "ad mitztzuy hannefesh kulei":
Veatta happaam, hinneni yosif shenit yadi betosefet beur, uvakkasha kefula, shetucha uferusa lifne kol anshe shelomim hakkerovim veharchokim, lekayyem alehem.

Shekkol yeme hachol lo yerdu lifne hatteva habbaale asakim sheen lahem penay kol kach, rak otam sheyyesh lahem penay, o hamelammedim, o hassemuchim al shulechan avihem, sheyyecholim lehaarich bitfillat hashshachar erech shaa umechetza lefachot kol yemot hachol – mehem yihye hayyored lifne hatteva, al pi haggoral, o al pi ritztzuy harov. vehu yeesof elav besaviv lo kol hassemuchim al shulechan avihem, o melammedim sheyyuchelu lehaarich kamohu, beval yeshunne na vena:

Ach beshabbatot veyamim tovim, sheggam kol baale asakim yesh lahem penay usheat hakkosher lehaarich bitfillatam bechavvavnat libbam venafsham laAdonai, veadderabba, alehem muttal beyeter seet veyeter oz, kemo shekkatuv beshulechan aruch orach chayyim", uchemo shekkatuv betorat moshe: "sheshet yamim taavod kulei veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha" dayyka – kullo laAdonai, velazot gam hem yerdu lifne hatteva beshabbat veyom tov, al pi haggoral o beritztzuy harov, kemo shekkatavti eshtakad:

Uchegon da tzarich leodoe, shebbedati, im yirtze Adonai, lishloach lechol hamminyanim meraggelim basseter, leda ulehodia, kol mi sheefshar lo vechol mi sheyyesh lo penay lehaarich uleayyen bitfilla umitatztzel, yihye niddon berichuk makom, lihyot nidche bishte yadayim bevoo lefo lishmoa "divre elokim chayyim", umikkelal lav – atta shomea hen. velashshomim yuneam, vetavo alehem birkat tov, veen tov ella tora vechulei:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 2: Achar biato mapetarebaverag

"Katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol kulei". perush, shebbechol chesed vachesed shehakkadosh-baruch-hu ose leadam tzarich lihyot shefal ruach bimod. ki chesed deroa yemina, "vimino techabbekeni", shehi bechinat kirvat elohim mammash beyeter seet millefanim, vechol hakkarov el Adonai beyeter seet vehagebeah lemala mala, tzarich lihyot yoter shefal ruach lematta matta, kemo shekkatuv "merachok Adonai nira li". vechannoda, dechulla "kammeh" davvka – kela chashiv, veim ken, kol shehu "kammeh" yoter – hu yoter kela veayin vaefes.

Vezo hi bechinat yamin shebbikdushsha vechesed leavraham, sheamar "anochi afar vaefer". vezo hi gam ken middato shel yaakov, uvazot hitnatztzel al yirato mippene esav, velo day lo behavetachato "vehinne anochi immach kulei" – mippene heyot katan yaakov bimod meod beenav, mechamat ribbuy hachasadim "ki vemakli kulei", veeno rauy ucheday kelal lehinnatzel kulei, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "shemma yigrom hachet", shennidme veenav shechata.
Ma sheen ken beze leummat ze, hu yishmael – chesed diklippa, kol shehachesed gadol, hu holech vegadel begova vegassut haruach verochav libbo.

Velazot, bati min hammodiim modaa rabba lichlalut anshe shelomenu, al ribbuy hachasadim asher higdil Adonai laasot immanu, leechoz bemiddotav shel yaakov "shear ammo" usheerit yisrael", shemmesim atzmo keshirayim umotarot mammash sheen bo shum tzorech, levilti rum levavam meachehem kulei, velo leharechiv alehem pe, o lishrok alehem chas veshalom, has millehazkir beazhara noraa, rak lehashepil rucham velibbam, bemiddat emet leyaakov, mippene kol adam, binmichut ruach, umaane rach meshiv chema", "veruach nechea kulei", vechulle hay veulay yitten Adonai belev achehem "kammayim happanim vegomer":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 3: Vayyilbash tzedaka kashshiryon, vechova yeshua berosho. vedarshu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "ma shiryon ze kol kelippa ukelippa mitztarefet leshiryon gadol, af tzedaka kol peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol". perush, shehashshiryon asuy kaskassim al nekavim, vehem meginnim shello yikkanes chetz bannekavim, vechacha hu maase hatztzedaka:

Uveur hainyan, ki gedola tzedaka mikkol hammitzvot, shemmehen naasim levushim lehanneshama, hannimshachim meor-en-sof baruch-hu mibbechinat "sovev kol almin" (kimmevoar happerush "memalle kol almin" vesovev kol almin" belikkute amarim, ayyen sham) beitaruta diltatta, hi mitzvat Adonai veratzon haelyon baruch-hu. veikkar hameshacha zo meor-en-sof baruch-hu, hu levush veor makkif" ley sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya, hammishtalshelot meilla leilla umimmadrega lemadrega kulei, hannikraot beshem "memalle kol almin".

Perush, ki or-en-sof baruch-hu mitlabbesh umeir betoch kol hishtalshelut haeser sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya, vehu hammaatzil haeser sefirot daatzilut, hammishtalshelot livria-yetzira-asiyya, al-yede tzimtzum atzum hamevoar beetz chayyim, venikra "or penimi".

Veal-yede kiyyum hammitzvot nimshach "or makkif" hannizkar leel, umeir toch haeser sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya, umityayched im haor penimi", venikra "yichud kudesha-berich-hu ushechinteh", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher, umeheara deheara meor makkif" hannizkar leel, al-yede tzimtzum rav, naase levush livchinot nefesh-ruach-neshama shel haadam began eden hattachton vehaelyon, sheyyuchelu lehanot ulehassig eze hassaga veheara meor-en-sof baruch-hu, kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher.

Veze sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "sechar mitzva behay alma lekka", ki baolam hazze haggashmi uvaal gevul vetzimtzum rav veatzum meod meod, i efshar lehitlabbesh shum heara meor-en-sof baruch-hu, ki im al-yede 10 sefirot, hannikraim "gufa" bazzohar hakkadosh: chesed deroa yemina kulei.

Lefi, shekkemo sheen aroch lo lehagguf haggashmi legabbe hanneshama, kach en aroch kelal ley sefirot daatzilut legabbe hammaatzil haelyon en-sof baruch-hu, ki afilu chachma illaa, shehi reshitan, hi bivchinat asiyya gufanit legabbe en-sof baruch-hu, kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim.

Vee lazot, bemaase hatztzedaka ugemilut chasadim, sheadam ochel mipperotehen baolam hazze", yesh nekavim, al derech mashal, ballevush haelyon hammakkif al "gufa", hem hakkelim dey sefirot, lehair mehem ulehashpia or veshefa mechesed deroa yemina" orech yamim baolam hazze haggashmi, veosher vechavod midderoa semala", vechen betiferet, vehod vehadar vechedva vechulei;

Ach kede shello yinku hachitzonim lemala meor veshefa hammishtalshel veyored lematta matta ad olam hazze haggashmi, vechen lematta lehagen al haadam uleshamro ulehatztzilo mikkol davar ra begashmiyyut uveruchaniyyut, lazot, chozer umeir or hammakkif vesotem hannekev, al derech mashal, ki hu mibbechinat en-sof vesovev kol almin kannizkar leel. vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol" dayyka, "ki gadol Adonai umehullal meod", beli sof vetachlit ugevul [chas veshalom]:

Ach mi hu haggorem liridat haor vehashshefa laolam hazze haggashmi mi sefirot hannikraim "gufa", hu hayyichud hannizkar leel, shehi tosefet heara vehashepaa mibbechinat or-en-sof hammaatzil haelyon baruch-hu, beyeter seet al haheara vehahashpaa shebbitchillat haatzilut vehahishtalshelut vechulei. vereshit tosefet haheara vehahashpaa, hi lereshit hay sefirot.

Veze hu "vechova yeshua berosho" – "yeshua" hu milleshon "vayyisha Adonai el hevel veel minchato", vehu yeridat haor vehashshefa desh nehorin shebbazzohar hakkadosh, uchemo shekkatuv: "yaer Adonai panav elecha", "yaer panav ittanu sela" – "ittanu" hu al-yede maase hatztzedaka.

Veze hu "zorea tzedakot matzmiach yeshuot". vechacha yaer Adonai panav alehem, "tzidkatam omedet laad", vekarnam tarum bishuat "matzmiach keren yeshua", "tzemach tzedaka" mehakkova yeshua" hannizkar leel, kenefesh tidreshennu:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 4: En yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka, shenneemar "veshaveha bitzdaka". ketiv: "tzedek lefanav yehallech", vahava-leh-lememar: "yelech". ach hainyan, al pi ma shekkatuv "lecha amar libbi bakkeshu fanay", perush, bakkeshu penimit hallev. ki hinne, belahav yesod haesh haelokit shebballev (nusach achar: hinne, behallev [yesod haesh haelokit shebballev]) yesh 2 bechinot: bechinat chitzoniyyut, uvechinat penimiyyut.

Chitzoniyyut hallev, hi hitlahavut hammitlahevet mibbechinat habbina vehaddaat bigdullat Adonai en-sof baruch-hu, (lahetabevanenan) [lehitbonen] bigdullato, uleholid mittevuna zo ahava azza kerishpe esh vechulei.

Ufenimiyyut hallev, hi hannekudda shebbifnimiyyut hallev veumeka delibba, shehi lemala mala mibbechinat haddaat vehattevuna sheyyuchal haadam lehitbonen belibbo bigdullat Adonai, uchemo shekkatuv "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai" – meumeka delibba (veal derech mashal, kemo bemille dealma, lifamim yesh inyan gadol meod meod, shekkol chayyut haadam taluy bo venogea ad nekuddat penimiyyut hallev vead bichlal, vegorem lo lifamim laasot maasim uledabber devarim shello vedaat kelal).

Veze leummat ze, kacha hu mammash baavoda shebballev. vehayeynu, lefi shebbechinat nekuddat penimit hallev hi lemala mibbechinat haddaat hammitpashshet umitlabbesh bammiddot shennoldu mechachma-bina-daat kannoda, rak hi bechinat hearat chachma elyona shellemala mehabbina vehaddaat, uvah melubbash veganuz or Adonai mammash, kemo shekkatuv "Adonai bechachma kulei", vehi hi bechinat nitzotz elokut shebbechol nefesh miyyisrael.

Uma sheen kol adam zoche lemadrega zo, laavoda shebballev meumeka delibba bivchinat penimiyyut, hayeynu, lefi shebbechina zo hi etzlo bivchinat galut veshivya, vehi bechinat galut hashshechina mammash, ki hi hi bechinat nitzotz elohut shebbenafsho haelohit. vesibbat haggalut, hu maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "galu levavel shechina immahem", dehayynu mippene shehilbish bechinat penimit nekuddat levavo beze leummat ze", dehayynu bilvushim tzoim demille dealma vetaavot olam hazze, hannikra beshem "bavel", vehi bechinat arla hamechassa al habberit unekudda happenimit shebballev, veal ze neemar: "umaltem et arlat levavchem".

Vehinne, bammila yesh shene bechinot: mila uferia, shehen arla gassa ukelippa dakka. vechen bearlat hallev yesh gam ken taavot gassot vedakkot – mila uferia; umal velo fara – keillu lo mal", mippene shessof sof adayin nekuddat penimit hallev hi mechussa bilvush sak dak, bivchinat galut veshivya.

Vehinne, al milat haarla mammash ketiv "umaltem et arlat levavchem" attem beatzmechem. ach lehasir hakkelippa haddakka, zehu davar hakkashe al haadam, veal ze neemar beviat hammashiach: "umal Adonai elohecha et levavcha kulei, leahava et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha lemaan chayyecha", kelomar – lemaan ki Adonai levaddo hu kol chayyecha mammash, shellachen ahava zo hi meumeka delibba – minnekudda penimit mammash kannizkar leel, ulemala mibbechinat haddaat.

Velachen mashiach ba behessach haddaat lichlalut yisrael, vehi gilluy bechinat nekudda penimit hakkelalit, vitziat hashshechina hakkelalit mehaggalut vehashshivya, laad uleolme olamim. vechen, kol nitzotz perati mehashshechina shebbenefesh kol echad miyyisrael yotzet mehaggalut vehashshivya lefi shaa, bechayye shaa" zo tefilla, vaavoda shebballev meumeka delibba, mibbechinat nekudda happenimit hanniglet mehaarla, veola lemala, ledavka vo bitshuka azza bivchinat "lemaan chayyecha".

Vehu gam ken bivchinat hessach daat haadam, ki bechina zo hi lemala middaat haadam vehitbonnuto bigdullat Adonai, rak hi bechinat mattana netuna meet Adonai min hashshamayim, mehearat bechinat panim haelyonim, kemo shekkatuv "yaer Adonai panav elecha", uchemo shekkatuv: "umal Adonai elokecha" kulei.

Ach mudaat zot, ki "itaruta dilella" hi beitaruta diltatta" davka, bivchinat haalaat "mayyin nukevin", kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "en tippa yoredet milmala kulei". velachen tzarich haadam laasot beatzmo techillat mila zo, lehasir arlat hallev ukelippa haggassa vedakka, hammalbishot umechassot al bechinat nekuddat penimit hallev, shehi bechinat ahavat Adonai, bechinat "lemaan chayyecha", shehi baggalut betaavot olam hazze, shehem gam ken bivchinat "lemaan chayyecha" beze leummat ze", kannizkar leel.

Vehayeynu, al-yede netinat hatztzedaka laAdonai mimmamono, shehu chayyuto. uvifrat mi shemmezonotav metzumetzamim udechika leh shata tuva, shennoten mechayyav mammash. uvifratut im nehene migia kappav, shei efshar shello asak bahem peamim rabbot bivchinat nekuddat penimit hallev meumeka delibba, keminhag haolam beiskehem bemassa umattan uchehay gavna.

Vahare atta happaam keshemmefazzer migio venoten laAdonai besimcha uvetuv levav hinne baze pode nafsho mishshachat, dehayynu bechinat nekuddat penimit levavo, shehayta bivchinat galut veshivya betoch hakkelippa gassa o dakka, kemo shekkatuv, "mikkol mishmar netzor libbecha" – "mishmar" perush bet haasurim, veatta, nifde mehachitzonim bitzdaka zo. veze gam ken leshon "peria" inyan periat chov, shennitchayyev venishtabed lachitzonim shemmashlu vo al nekuddat penimiyyut levavo, vezehu "veshaveha bitzdaka".

Vezehu "tzedek lefanav yehallech", "lefanav" – hu milleshon penimiyyut, viyhallech" – hu milleshon holacha, shemmolich et penimit hallev laAdonai, veachar kach "yasim lederech" Adonai "peamav", kemo shekkatuv: "vehalachta bidrachav", "achare Adonai elohechem telechu", bechol maase hammitzvot, vetalmud tora keneged kullan, shekkullan olin laAdonai al-yede penimit hallev, beyeter seet umala mala mealiyyaytan laAdonai al-yede chitzonit hallev, hannolad mehattevuna vehaddaat levaddan, beli hearat panim milmala ella bivchinat hester panim, ki en happanim haelyonim meirim lematta ella beitaruta diltatta, bemaase hatztzedaka hannikra "shalom". vezehu shekkatuv: "pada veshalom nafshi" – "nafshi" dayyka.

Vezehu gam ken hattaam shennikra hatztzedaka "shalom", lefi shennaase shalom ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim" kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, dehayynu al-yede pidyon nafshotehen, hem chelek Adonai mammash, mide hachitzonim, uvifrat tzidkat eretz yisrael, shehi tzidkat Adonai mammash, kemo shekkatuv: "tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah", "vehayu enay velibbi sham kol hayyamim".

Vehi sheamda lanu lifdot chayye nafshenu meatzat hachoshvim lidchot peamenu, vetaamod lanu laad, lasum nafshenu bechayyim amittim, mechayye hachayyim, "leor beor hachayyim", asher "yaer Adonai panav ittanu sela", amen ken yehi ratzon:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 5: Vayyaas david shem. uferesh bazzohar hakkadosh, mishshum shenneemar: "vayhi david ose mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo kulei", "bacha rabbi shimon veamar: man avid shema kaddisha bechol yoma man deyahiv tzedaka lemiskene kulei".

Veyuvan, behakedim maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "ki beyah Adonai tzur olamim" – "baAdonai nivra olam hazze, beYod nivra olam-habba". perush, shehattaanug shemmitannegim nishmot hatztzaddikim venehenin mizziv hashshechina hammeir began eden elyon vetachton, hu, shemmitannegim behassagatam vehasekalatam, shemmaskilim veyodim umassigim eze hassaga beor vechayyut hashshofea sham meen-sof baruch-hu, bivchinat gilluy lenishmatam veruach binatam, lehavin ulehassig eze hassaga kol echad veechad lefi madregato ulefi maasav, velachen nikra olam-habba beshem "bina" bazzohar hakkadosh.

Vehashepaa zo nimshechet mibbechinat chachma illaa, shehu mekor hahaskala vehahassaga hannikra beshem bina, vehu kadmut hassechel kodem shebba lichlal gilluy hassaga vahavana, rak adayin hu bivchinat helem vehester, rak shemmeat mizzeer sham zeer sham shofea venimshach mishsham livchinat bina, lehavin ulehassig sechel hannelam, velachen nikra beshem "nekudda behechala" bazzohar hakkadosh, vezo hi temunat yod shel shem havaya baruch-hu. venikra "eden", asher alav neemar: "ayin lo raata" kulei. venikra "abba yasad beratta".

Perush, ki hinne hithauut otiyyot haddibbur hayyotzot meAdonai motzaot happe enan davar musekol velo muteba beteva motzaot hallalu, lehotzi mivta haotiyyot al-yede hahevel vehakkol hammakke bahen al pi derech hatteva velo al pi derech hassechel. kegon hassefatayim, al derech mashal, sheotiyyot 128 yotzot mehen, en hatteva velo hassechel noten litziat mivta arba chelke shinnuye bittuy otiyyot ellu, al pi shinnuye tenuat hassefatayim, shemmitnoanot behevel echad vekol echad happogea bahen beshave, veadderabba, shinnuy hattenuot shebbisfatayim hu lefi shinnuy bittuy haotiyyot shebbirtzon hannefesh, levatte visfatayim kirtzonah, lomar ot 2 o 6 o 40 o 80. velo lehefech, sheyyihye retzon hannefesh vechavvanatah laasot shinnuy tenuot hassefatayim kemo shehen mitnaanot atta bevittuye 4 otiyyot ellu, vechannire bechush, sheen hannefesh mitkavvevnet veyodaat lechavven kelal shinnuy tenuot hassefatayim beshinnuyim ellu.

Veyoter nire ken bevittuy hannekuddot, shekkeshehannefesh retzonah lehotzi mippiha nekuddat kamatz azay mimmela nikmatzim hassefatayim, uvefattach niftachim hassefatayim, velo shertzon hannefesh likmotz velo liftoach kelal uchelal. veen lehaarich bedavar happashut umuvan umusekol lechol maskil, shemmivta haotiyyot vehannekuddot hu lemala mehassechel hammussag umuvan, ella missechel hannelam vekadmut hassechel shebbannefesh hamedabberet, velachen en hattinok yachol ledabber, af shemmevin hakkol:

Ach haotiyyot hen bivchinat chomer vetzura, hannikra penimit vechitzonit, ki hagam shemmekoran hu mikkadmut hassechel uretzon hannefesh, zo hi bechinat tzurat shinnuy hammivta shebbechv otiyyot, aval bechinat hachomer veguf hithauutan, vehu bechinat chitzoniyyutan, hu hahevel hayyotze mehallev, shemmimmennu mithavve kol pashut hayyotze mehaggaron, veachar kach nechlak lechv havarot, uvittuy 22 otiyyot baAdonai motzaot hayeduot: 84 mehaggaron, 133 mehachech kulei. umivta hahevel hu ot Adonai "ata kallila kulei", vehu mekor hachomer veguf haotiyyot terem hitchallekutan lechv, velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, sheolam hazze nivra baAdonai":

Vehinne, hagam shehi Adonai tattaa, Adonai acharona shebbeshem havaya, verabbotenu-zichronam-livracha darshu ze al pasuk: "ki beyah", hayeynu lefi shemmekorah vereshitah lavo livchinat gilluy mehelem hayyud hu mushepa venimshach mibbechinat Adonai illaa, sheyyesh lah hitpashshetut orech verochav, lehorot al bechinat bina, shehi hitpashshetut hassechel hannelam bivchinat gilluy vehassaga beharechavat haddaat, vehashepaatah mistayyemet ballev, uchemo shekkatuv battikkunim, devina libba, uvah hallev mevin", umishsham yotze hahevel mekor gilluy guf haotiyyot haddibbur, hammitgallot baAdonai motzaot mehelem hayyud.

Utemunat Adonai tattaa bichtivatah gam ken behitpashshetut orech verochav, mora al hitpashshetut bechinat malchuto yitbarech, "malchut kol olamim", lemala ulematta uled sitrin, hammitpashshetot venimshachot meotiyyot devar Adonai, kemo shekkatuv bekohelet: "baasher devar melech shilton", kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher.

[Ulehavin meat mizzeer inyan umahut otiyyot haddibbur belohut, sheen lo demut hagguf velo hannefesh chas veshalom, kevar nitbaer bederech arukka uketzara (belikkute amarim chelek 2 perakim 11 veyv, ayyen sham)]:

Ach beur hainyan, lamma amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheolam hazze davka nivra baAdonai? hinne yadua lechol chachme lev, ki ribbuy haolamot vehahechalot asher en lahem mispar, kemo shekkatuv: "hayesh mispar ligdudav", uvechol hechol ugedud elef alfin veribbo rivvan malachim, vechen nefesh-ruach-neshama-chayya-yechida madregot leen ketz, uvechol olam vehechalot meribbuy hechalot shebbaatzilut-beria-yetzira.

Hinne kol ribbuyim ellu, ribbuy achar ribbuy ad en ketz mammash, hakkol nimshach venishpa meribbuy tzerufe 22 otiyyot devar Adonai, hammitchallekot gam ken letzerufim rabbim ad en ketz vetachlit mammash, kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira: "shiva avanim bonot chameshet alafim vearbaim battim, mikkan veelach tze vachashov ma sheen happe yachol ledabber kulei".

Vahagam sheyyesh bemaalot umadregot hammalachim uneshamot kamma vechamma mine maalot umadregot chalukot leen ketz, gavoah al gavoah – hinne hakkol nimshach lefi chillufe hatztzerufim vehattemurot beatt bash kulei (uchemo shennitbaer beferek 12). ach derech kelal, hinne kullam baale chachma vadaat, veyodim et boram, mippene heyot chayyutam mippenimiyyut haotiyyot hannimshachot mibbechinat chachma illaa, vechannizkar leel.

Ach haolam hazze hashshafal, im hachayyut shebbetocho, katan mehachil velisbol or vechayyut mibbechinat tzurat haotiyyot ufenimiyyutan, lehair ulehashpia bo beli levush vehester kemo shemmeirot umashpiot linshamot umalachim, rak haheara vehahashpaa baa venishpa laolam hazze mibbechinat chomer veguf haotiyyot vechitzoniutam, shehu bechinat hahevel, hammitchallek lez havalim shebbekohelet shealehem haolam omed, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh.

Vehu "motza fi Adonai" hammitlabbesh baolam hazze vechol tzevaav lehachayotam, uvetocho melubbeshet bechinat tzurat otiyyot haddibbur vehammachashava, mimmiddotav hakkedoshot uretzono vechachmato vechulei, hameyuchadot been-sof baruch-hu betachlit (vezehu sheamar haari zichrono livracha, shebbechinat chitzoniyyut hakkelim demalchut daatzilut, hamerummazot baAdonai shel shem havaya baruch-hu, hem yardu venaasu neshama leolam haasiyya). vechen katuv battikkunim shehayyud hu baatzilut kulei, vaAdonai tattaa mekannenet baasiyya:

Vehinne, baadam hattachton lemashal, mi shehu chacham gadol lehasekil nifleot chachma, umetzamtzem sichlo umachashavto beot echad middibburo, hinne ze hu tzimtzum atzum virida gedola lechachmato hanniflaa, kacha mammash al derech mashal, veyater mizze leen ketz – haya tzimtzum gadol atzum verav, kaasher "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu", besheshet yeme vereshit, "uveruach piv kol tzevaam", hi ot Adonai shel shem havaya baruch-hu, "ata kallila", kemo shekkatuv: "behibbaram" – "baAdonai beraam", hi mekor hat maamarot shenimshechu mimmaamar rishon "bereshit" dename maamar hu", hi bechinat chachma hannikret "reshit".

Ach az hayta hameshacha virida zo beli itaruta diltatta kelal, ki "adam ayin laavod kulei", rak "ki chafetz chesed hu", veolam chesed yibbane". vezehu "behibbaram" – "beavraham", ki "chesed leavraham" kulei.

Ach achar beriat haadam "leavdah kulei", azay kol itaruta dilella leorer middat chesed elyon, hu beitaruta diltatta, bitzdaka vachesed sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze. lachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: kol haomer en lo ella tora beli gemilut chasadim, afilu tora en lo, ella laasok battora uvigmilut chasadim.

Ki hinne, hagam deorayyta mechachma nafkat", uveorayyta mitkayyem alma uveinun delaan bah, ki bedibburam mamshichim hearot vehashepaot (<small>nusach achar:</small> vehasheraot) chachma illaa, mekor hattora – livchinat otiyyot haddibbur shebbahen nivra haolam, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "al tikre banayich ella bonayich" hare hameshacha zo hi bechinat yerida gedola, velaze tzarich leorer chesed elyon, hannimshach kammayim mimmakom gavoah lemakom namuch, beitaruta diltatta, bitzdaka vachesed tattaa, shemmamshichim chayyim vachesed, lehachayot ruach shefalim venidkaim.

Vezehu shekkatuv: "al yithallel chacham bechachmato kulei, ki im bezot yithallel kulei, ki ani Adonai ose chesed kulei", ki hachesed hu hammamshich chayye hachachma lematta, veim lav, hare nikret "chachmato" levaddo, beli hameshachat chayyim mimmenna chas veshalom.

Uvaze yuvan ma sheamar haarizal, sheyyesh 2 mine neshamot beyisrael – nishmot talmide chachamim haoskim battora kol yemehem, venishmot baale mitzvot haoskim bitzdaka ugemilut chasadim. delichora, hare gam talmide chachamim tzerichim laasok bigmilut chasadim, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, sheafilu tora en lo".

Ella shehattalmide chachamim shettoratan ikkar verov yemehem bah, umiut yemehem bigmilut chasadim, hinne peullat itarutam diltatta leorer chesed elyon, lehameshich ulehorid or-en-sof hamelubbash bechachma illaa, mekor torat Adonai shebbefihem, hu rak leolam hanneshamot shebbabberia al-yede esek hattalmud, velammalachim shebbaytzira al-yede limmud hammishna, yaan heyot chayyut hanneshamot vehammalachim nishpaot mitztzerufe otiyyot haddibbur, hi tora shebbeal pe, – umekor haotiyyot hu mechachma illaa kannizkar leel.

Ach lehameshich ulehorid heara vechayyut mibbechinat hevel haelyon Adonai tattaa laolam hazze hashshafal, shehu tzimtzum gadol beyeter oz, lo day beitaruta diltatta shel talmide chachamim haoskim miut yemehem bitzdaka ugemilut chasadim, ella al-yede itaruta devaale mitzvot haoskim rov yemehem bitzdaka ugemilut chasadim (uchemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim bechelek 1 perek 34). velachen nikreu "tamche orayyta", vehen bechinot umadregot netzach vehod, lihyotan mamshichin or hattora lematta leolam haasiyya.

Uvaze yuvan lamma nikra hatztzedaka beshem "maase", kemo shekkatuv: "vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom", al shem sheppeullatah lehameshich or Adonai leolam haasiyya. vezehu dikduk leshon zohar hakkadosh: "man deavid shema kaddisha" – "deavid" dayyka, ki beitaruta diltatta bitzdaka vachesed tattaa meorer chesed elyon, lehameshich or-en-sof mibbechinat chachma illaa yod shel shem, laAdonai shel shem, bechinat haddibbur veruach piv yitbarech, kede lehashepia leolam haasiyya.
Veal derech mashal, lehavedil havedalot en ketz, kemo sheadam eno medabber ella laacherim (velo keshehu beno leven atzmo), veaz metzamtzem sichlo umachashavto bedibburo alehem. vehammaskilim yavinu:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 6: Zorea tzedaka secher emet (bemishle 11). perush, shessechar zeriat hatztzedaka hi middat emet.
Uchetiv: "titten emet leyaakov", ushevacha dekudesha-berich-hu mesadder neviyya kulei", kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh. perush, shehakkadosh-baruch-hu hu hannoten middat emet leyaakov.
Vetzarich lehavin, vechi en emet beyaakov chas veshalom ad shehakkadosh-baruch-hu yitten lo milmala?

Ach hinne mudaat zot, demiddat yaakov hi middat rachamanut, vaavodat Adonai bemiddat rachamanut hi habbaa mehitorrut rachamim rabbim belev haadam al nitzotz elokut shebbenafsho, harchoka meor pene Adonai kaasher holech bechoshech havele olam, vehitorrut rachamanut zo hi baa mehattevuna vehaddaat bigdullat Adonai, ech sheafilu haolamot haelyonim lemala mala ad en ketz kela mammash chashive kammeh, ki kol shifam vechayyutam eno rak mizziv veheara meot echad mishshemo yitbarech, kammaamar: "beYod nivra olam-habba kulei".

Vehinne, beziv veheara zo, shehu hitpashshetut hachayyut mishshemo yitbarech lehachayot elyonim vetachtonim, hu sheyyesh hevdel vehefresh ben elyonim letachtonim, sheolam hazze nivra baAdonai vechulei", vechen kol shinnuye happeratim shebbechol olam veolam hu lefi shinnuye tzerufe haotiyyot, vechen shinnuye hazzemannim beavar hove veatid, veshinnuye kol hakkorot bechillufe hazzemannim hakkol mishshinnuye tzerufe haotiyyot, shehen hen hameshachat hachayyut mimmiddotav yitbarech shemo (kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek 2 perek 11).

Aval legabbe mahuto veatzmuto yitbarech ketiv: "ani Adonai lo shaniti", ben bivchinat shinnuye hahishtalshelut merum hammaalot ad lematta matta, shekkemo shehu yitbarech matzuy baelyonim – kach hu mammash beshave battachtonim (uchemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek 1 perek nusach acher), uven bivchinat shinnuye hazzeman, shekkemo shehaya hu levaddo hu, yachid umeyuchad, lifne sheshet yeme vereshit – kach hu atta achar habberia, vehayeynu, mishshum shehakkol keayin vaefes mammash legabbe mahuto veatzmuto, uchemo ot echad middibburo shel adam o afilu mimmachashavto legabbe kelalut mahut hannefesh hassichlit veatzmutah, al derech mashal, leshakkech et haozen, uveemet "en aroch elecha" ketiv, uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher (belikkute amarim chelek 2 perek 9) ayyen sham.

Vezehu sheomrim: "hammelech hameromam levaddo meaz", perush, kemo shemmeaz" kodem habberia haya hu levaddo hu, kach atta hu "meromam kulei" umitnasse mimot olam", perush, shehu ram venissa lemala mala mibbechinat zeman hannikra beshem "yemot olam", vehayeynu lefi shechayyut kol "yemot olam" hu rak mibbechinat "hammelech kulei", uchemo shemmevoar bemakom acher.

Vee lazot, harachamanut gedola meod meod al hannitzotz hashshochen bagguf hechashuch vehaafel, mashka dechivya, healul lekabbel tumea ulehitgael bechol hattaavot rachamana litztzelan, lule shehakkadosh-baruch-hu magen lo venoten lo oz vetaatzumot lilchom im hagguf vetaavotav ulenatztzechan, vezehu sheomrim: "adon uzzenu kulei magen yishenu kulei".

Vehinne mudaat zot, deyesh 2 mine dechilu urechimu: harishonot, hen hannoladot mehattevuna vehaddaat bigdullat Adonai uvidvarim hammeviin lide ahavat Adonai veyirato, vehaacharonot, hen habbaot achar kach milmala bivchinat mattana, uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher al pasuk: "avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem", shehi middat ahava, vechen hu gam ken beyyira.

Vehinne, vadday en aroch kelal ben harishonot shehen toldot hassechel hannivra, legabbe haacharonot shehen mehabbore yitbarech shemo, velachen hen hen hannikraot beshem "emet", ki "chotamo shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu emet", shehu emet haamitti, vechol haemet shebbannivraim – kela chashive kammeh.

Ach eze hadderech sheyyizke haadam leemet Adonai", hinne, hu al yede sheyyeorer rachamim rabbim lifne Adonai al hannitzotz shebbenafsho, shehi middato shel yaakov, "mavriach mehakkatze el hakkatze", dehayynu merum hammaalot ad lematta matta, lehameshich "emet Adonai" laolam hashshafal hazze hechashuch, uchemo shekkatuv: "ki eshev bachoshech Adonai or li". vezehu "ki gavar alenu chasdo kulei".
Ach hitorrut rachamim rabbim lifne Adonai tzarich lihyot gam ken beemet, vegam keshehu beemet shello ech yuchal al-yede emet shello leorer rachamim elyonim meemet Adonai"?

Ach haetza laze hi – middat hatztzedaka, shehi middat harachamim al man delet leh miggarmeh lehachayot ruach shefalim kulei, uveitaruta diltatta – itaruta dilella, Adonai meorer yeshenim umekitz nirdamim, hem bechinat rachamim rabbim vachasadim elyonim hannelamim, latzet mehahelem el haggilluy veheara rabba, "leor beor hachayyim", "emet Adonai leolam".

(Veze) [vezehu] leshon zeria hanneemar bitzdaka, lehatzemiach emet haelyon, "emet Adonai". uvifrat, bitzdaka vachesed shel emet sheosim im eretz hakkodesh tibbane vetikkonen bimhera veyamenu amen, lekayyem ma shekkatuv: "emet meeretz titzmach", al-yede zeriat hatztzedaka bah, vechesed verachamim rabbim hanneesafim venilkatim letochah, hem meorrim gam ken chasadim elyonim hatztzefunim venelamim (<small>benosach achar:</small> bah), kemo shekkatuv: "asher tzafanta kulei" lechonnah velahakimah. vezehu shekkatuv: "bitzdaka tikkonani":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 7: Ashrenu ma tov chelkenu uma naim goralenu kulei, "Adonai menat chelki vechosi vegomer", "chavalim naflu li vegomer".

Lehavin leshon "chelkenu" vegoralenu" tzarich levaer hetev lashon hashshagur bemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en lo chelek belohe yisrael", ki hagam delichora lo shayyaych leshon "chelek" kelal belokut yitbarech, sheeno mitchallek lachalakim chas veshalom.

Ach hainyan, kemo shekkatuv beyaakov: "vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael", perush, ki hinne beemet hakkadosh-baruch-hu kishmo ken hu, ki af deihu memalle kol almin elyonim vetachtonim merum hammaalot ad mittachat laaretz hallezu hachumerit, kemo shekkatuv: "halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male" – "ani" mammash, dehayynu mahuto veatzmuto kivyachol velo kevodo levad, af-al-pi-chen hu kadosh umuvedal meelyonim vetachtonim, veeno nitpas kelal betocham chas veshalom kitfisat nishmat haadam begufo al derech mashal, kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher baarichut.

Velazot, lo hayu yecholim lekabbel chayyutam mimmahuto veatzmuto levaddo kivyachol, rak hitpashshetut hachayyut asher hakkadosh-baruch-hu mechayye elyonim vetachtonim, hu al derech mashal, kemo heara meira mishshemo yitbarech, shehu ushemo echad, uchemo shekkatuv: "ki nisgav shemo levaddo", rak zivo vehodo al eretz veshamayim vegomer".

Veheara zo mitlabbeshet mammash baelyonim vetachtonim lehachayotam, venitpeset betocham al-yede memutztzaim rabbim, vetzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim, behishtalshelut hammadregot derech illa vealul vechulei.

Vehinne, heara zo, af shellemala hi meira umitpashshetet bivchinat beli gevul vetachlit, lehachayot olamot nelamim leen ketz vetachlit, kemo shekkatuv beidra rabba, af-al-pi-chen, beridtah lematta al-yede tzimtzumim rabbim lehachayot hannivraim vehayetzurim vehannaasim, hi nechleket derech kelal lemispar taryag, keneged taryag mitzvot hattora, shehen hen taryag mine hameshachot heara zo meor-en-sof baruch-hu, lehair lenishmat haadam hakkelula meramach evarim veshasa gidim, asher baavurah hu ikkar tachlit yeridat vehameshachat heara zo lematta lechol hannivraim vehayetzurim vehannaasim, shettachlit kullan hu haadam, kannoda:

Vehinne, mispar ze hu bederech kelal, aval bederech perat, hinne kol mitzva umitzva mitchalleket lifratim rabbim leen ketz vetachlit, vehen hen gufe halachot peratiyyot shebbechol mitzva – sheen lahem mispar, kemo shekkatuv: "shishshim hemma melachot" hen 60 massechtot kulei, "vaalamot en mispar" hen hahalachot kulei, shehen hameshachat ratzon haelyon kulei.

Vechen hu mammash benishmat haadam, ki hinne, kol hanneshamot shebbaolam hayu kelulot beadam harishon, vederech kelal, hayta nishmato nechleket lemispar taryag: ramach evarim veshasa gidim, ach derech perat, nechleket lenitzotzot en mispar, shehen nishmot kol yisrael mimot haavot vehashshevatim ad biat hammashiach vead bichlal, sheyyekuyyam az ma shekkatuv: "vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam, asher lo yimmad velo yissafer" merov.

Vehinne, "shufereh deyaakov meen shufereh deadam harishon", shettikken chet adam harishon, vehayta nishmato gam ken kelula mikkol hanneshamot shebbeyisrael, meolam vead olam, vehaya merkava lattora shellemala, shennikret beshem "adam", kemo shekkatuv: "veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam vechulei", uchemo shekkatuv: "vezot lefanim beyisrael kulei" – "en zot ella tora kulei", shehayta kelula umelubbeshet benishmat "yisrael sava", hakkelula mikkol hanneshamot.

Vezehu "vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael" – "el" leshon hameshachat haheara meor-en-sof baruch-hu mehahelem el haggilluy, lehair bivchinat gilluy benishmato, uchemo shekkatuv: "el Adonai vayaer lanu"; veacharav kol yishre lev, haoskim battora uvammitzvot, meir or Adonai en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat gilluy benishmatam.
Uzeman gilluy ze beyeter seet veyeter oz haheara bemocham velibbam hu bishat hattefilla, kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher.

Vehinne, af sheggilluy ze al-yede esek hattora vehammitzvot hu shave lechol nefesh miyyisrael bederech kelal, ki tora achat umishpat echad lechullanu, af-al-pi-chen, bederech perat, en kol hannefashot o haruchot vehanneshamot shavot beinyan ze lefi et uzeman gilgulam uvoam baolam hazze uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "avuch bemay have zahir tefe, amar leh betzitzit kulei".
Vechen, en kol haddorot shavin. ki kemo sheevre haadam, kol ever yesh lo peulla peratit umeyuchedet, haayin lirot vehaozen lishmoa, kach bechol mitzva meir or perati umeyuchad meor-en-sof baruch-hu.

Veaf shekkol nefesh miyyisrael tzericha lavo begilgul lekayyem kol taryag mitzvot, mikkol makom lo nitzrecha ella lehaadafa uzehirut uzerizut yetera, beyeter seet veyeter oz, kefula umechuppelet, lemala mala mizzehirut shear hammitzvot. vezehu sheamar "bemay have zahir tefe" – "tefe" dayyka.

Vehinne, yitron haor hazze happerati linshamot peratiyyot eno bivchinat taam vadaat mussag, ella lemala mibbechinat haddaat, shekkach ala bemachashava lefanav yitbarech, vedugemato lematta hu bechinat haggoral mammash:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 8: Zorea tzedakot, matzmiach yeshuot. hinne, ma shekkatuv leshon "zeria" bemitzvat hatztzedaka, uchemo shekkatuv bappasuk: "ziru lachem litzdaka kulei", yuvan al pi ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "rabbi elazar yahiv peruta leani vahadar matzlle, dichtiv: ani betzedek echeze fanecha". perush, ki gilluy elokuto yitbarech hammitgalle bemachashavto shel adam vechavvanato bitfillato, kol chad lefum shiura dileh, hu betorat tzedaka "vechesed Adonai meolam vead olam al yereav kulei".

Kelomar, sheor Adonai en-sof baruch-hu hammeir lemala beolamot elyonim, beheara rabba bivchinat gilluy rav veatzum, ad shebbeemet hen betelin bimtziut uchela mammash chashive kammeh venichlalin beoro yitbarech, vehen hen hahechalot im hammalachim vehanneshamot shebbahen, hamevoarim bazzohar hakkadosh bishmotam limkomotam beseder hattefilla shessidderu lanu anshe keneset haggedola, hinne, mishsham meir haor ki tov laolam hashshafal hazze, al "yire Adonai vechoshve shemo", hachafetzim leavdo baavoda shebballev zo tefilla", uchemo shekkatuv: "vaAdonai yaggiah chashki".
Vehinne, yeridat heara zo lematta laolam hazze, nikret beshem "chesed Adonai", hamechunne beshem "mayim", hayyordim mimmakom gavoah lemakom namuch kulei:

Vehinne, mudaat zot, sheyyesh lemala gam ken middat haggevura vehatztzimtzum, letzamtzem ulehastir oro yitbarech leval yitgalle lattachtonim. ach hakkol taluy beitaruta diltatta", sheim haadam mitnaheg bachasidut lehashepia chayyim vachesed kulei kach meorer lemala, kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "bemidda sheadam moded – bah moddin lo".

Ella delichora zo enah min hammidda, ki im lehashepia lo chayye haolam-habba levad keneged ma shehu mashpia chayye olam hazze, aval lo lehashepia lo chayye hearat or Adonai [<small>nusach achar:</small> en-sof baruch-hu] mammash, sheyyair veyaggiah chashko baavoda shebballev zo tefilla", shehi bechinat umadregat teshuva illaa kannoda shehare hi lemala mala mikkol chayye olam-habba, kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim kulei", uchemo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut, deolam-habba eno ella ziv veheara vechulei:

Ach hainyan hu, al derech mashal, kemo shezzorin zeraim o notin garin, shehashshibbolet hatztzomachat mehazzera, vehailan uferotav mehaggarin, enan mahutan veatzmutan shel hazzera vehaggarin kelal, ki mahutam veatzmutam kale venirkav baaretz, vechoach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz atzmah [nusach achar: atzmo] hu hammotzi vehamegaddel hashshibbolet vehailan uferotav. rak sheeno motzi umegalle kocho lachutz mehakkoach el happoal, ki im al-yede hazzera vehaggarin shennirkavin baaretz vechale kol kocham bechoach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz, venitachadu vehayu laachadim, veal-yede ze motzi koach hatztzomeach et kocho el happoal, umashpia chayyut legaddel shibbolet keen hazzera, aval beribbuy harebe meod beshibbolet achat, vechen perot harebe al ilan echad, vegam mahutan veatzmutan shel happerot meulla beilluy rav veatzum lemala mala mimmahuto veatzmuto shel haggarin hannatua. vechen kehay gavna beferot haaretz haggedelim mizzeronin keen garinin, kemo kishshuim uchehay gavna.

Vehakkol hu, mippene sheikkar veshoresh chayyut happerot nishpa mikkoach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz, hakkolel chayyut kol happerot. vehaggarinin hazzeruim baaretz, enan ella keen "itaruta diltatta", hannikret beshem "haalaat mayyin nukevin" bechitve haarizal:

Vechacha mammash al derech mashal, kol maase hatztzedaka sheosin yisrael, ole lemala bivchinat "haalaat mayyin nukevin" leshoresh nishmotehen lemala, hannikra beshem "keneset yisrael" veimma tattaa" bilshon hazzohar, ushechina" bilshon haggemara, hakkelula mikkol middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, umeyuchedet bahen betachlit, vereshitan – hi middat hachesed. veal-yede haalaa zo mitorer "chesed Adonai" mammash, shehu gilluy oro yitbarech, lered ulehair lematta lenishmot yisrael, bivchinat gilluy rav veatzum bishat hattefilla al kol panim. ki af shelligdullato en cheker", ad dechulla kammeh kela chashive" hare "bemakom sheatta motze gedullato, sham atta motze anvetanuto", kemayim sheyyordin kulei".

Vezehu shekkatuv: "zarach bachoshech or laysharim, channun verachum vetzaddik", deal-yede shehaadam "channun verachum vetzaddik" "tzedakot ahev", gorem leor Adonai sheyyizrach lenishmato hamelubbeshet begufo, haomed bachoshech, shehu mashka dechivya. veze nikra beshem "yeshua", kad ithappecha chashocha linhora.

Vezehu "matzmiach yeshuot", sheyyeshua zo tzomachat mizzeriat hatztzedaka shezzorin baaretz haelyona, "eretz chefetz", hi hashshechina ucheneset yisrael, shennikret ken al shem shemmitlabbeshet battachtonim lehachayotam, kemo shekkatuv: "malchutecha malchut kol olamim".

Uvifrat min happerat, keshezzorin beeretz hakkodesh hattachtona hamechuvvevnet kenegdah mammash, shehazzeria nikletet techef umiyyad baaretz haelyona, beli shum menia veikkuv baolam, meachar sheen shum davar chotzetz umafsik kelal ben "artzot hachayyim", ki "ze shaar hashshamayim" ma-sheen-ken bechutz laaretz, veday lammevin:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 9: Ahuvayy achayy vereayy asher kenafshi, bati kemazkir umeorer yeshenim betardemat havele havalim, velifkoach ene haivrim yabbitu lirot, lihyot kol yisham vecheftzam umegammatam lechol bahem chayye rucham bimkor mayim chayyim" chayye hachayyim, kol yeme chayyehem, minnefesh vead basar. dehayynu, kol mille dealma veiske parnasa lo yihye keellu deavdin legarmayyhu, velo yihye bet yisrael kechol haggoyim, dezanin umefarnesin umokrin linshayyhu uvenayyhu meahava, ki – "mi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz" ketiv, dehayynu – sheggam beinyene eretz lo yafridu [nusach achar: yippardu] meechad haemet chas veshalom, lehaid edut sheker chas veshalom, bikriat-shema erev vavoker, beenayim segurot, "Adonai echad" bed ruchot uvashshamayim mimmaal uvaaretz mittachat, uvifkoach ene haivrim "hataif enecha bo veenennu" chas veshalom.

Ach bezot yeot lanu, lihyot [<small>nusach achar:</small> bihyot] kol iskenu bemille dealma lo legarmayyhu, ki im, lehachayot nafshot chelke elokut, ulemallovt machsorehem bechesed chinnam, shebbaze anu medammin hatztzura leyotzrah, Adonai echad, asher "chesed el kol hayyom", chesed shel emet, lehachayot haolam umeloo bechol rega varega, rak sheishto uvanav shel adam kodmin lakkol al pi hattora chutz mitztzaddikim shebbaddor shehen kodmin levanav, vetzaddikim shebbeeretz yisrael kodmin latzaddikim shebbechutz laaretz, levad mizzot shello hinnichu kemotan bechutz laaretz, veday lamevin.

Al ken, ahuvayy achayy, simu na levavchem laelle haddevarim hanneemarim biktzara meod (veim yirtze Adonai pe el pe adabber bam baarukka), ech heyot kol ikkar avodat Adonai baittim hallalu beikkevot meshicha hi avodat hatztzedaka, kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka". velo amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "talmud tora shakul keneged gemilut chasadim", ella bimehem, shettalmud tora haya ikkar haavoda etzlam, veal ken hayu chachamim gedolim tannaim veamoraim. ma sheen ken beikkevot meshicha, shennafla "sukkat david" ad bechinat raglayim vaakevayim, shehi bechinat asiyya, en derech ledavka bah beemet ulehappecha chashocha linhora dilah [nusach achar: dileh] ki im bivchinat asiyya gam ken, shehi maase hatztzedaka, kayyadua lammaskilim, shebbechinat asiyya belokut – hi bechinat hashepaat vehameshachat hachayyut lematta matta leman delet leh miggarmeh kelum. vechol hazzoveach et yitzro baze ufoteach yado ulevavo, itkafya sitra ochora umehappech chashocha leor hashshem yitbarech, hashshochen alenu bivchinat asiyya beikkevot meshicha, veyizke lirot "ayin beayin beshuv Adonai tziyyon" kulei:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 10: Achar derishat shelomam vechayyim, petach devaray yair ozen shomaat tochachat chayyim, asher hochiach Adonai chayyim al-yede nevio, veamar: chasde Adonai ki lo tamnu vegomer, vahava-leh-lememar "ki lo tammu", kemo sheomrim: "ki lo tammu chasadecha vegomer". veyuvan al pi ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh: "it chesed veit chesed, it chesed olam kulei veit chesed illaa dehu rav chesed kulei".

Ki hinne mudaat zot, hattora nikret "oz", shehu leshon gevura, uchemo sheamru chachamenu-zichronam-livracha: "taryag mitzvot neemru lemoshe missinay mippi haggevura"; uchedichtiv: "mimino esh dat lamo", perush, shehattora mekorah vesharshah hu rak chasde Adonai, hamechunnim beshem "yamin", dehayynu, hameshachat bechinat elohuto yitbarech veheara meor-en-sof baruch-hu el haolamot elyonim vetachtonim, al-yede haadam hammamshich haor al atzmo, bekiyyum ramach mitzvot ase, shehen ramach evarim demalka, perush ramach kelim ulevushim leheara [<smal>nire detzarich lihyot:</small> lehaheara] meor-en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bahen (umeor ze yumeshach lo dechilu urechimu bechol mitzva kannoda).

Rak shehameshacha zo nitlabbesha techilla bemiddat gevurato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu, hamechunna beshem "esh", shehi bechinat tzimtzum haor vehachayyut hannimshachot meor-en-sof baruch-hu, kede shettuchal lehitlabbesh bemaase hammitzvot, sherubban kechullan hem bidvarim chumeriyyim, ketzitzit utefillin vekarbanot utzedaka.

Veaf mitzvot shehen beruchaniyyut haadam, kemo yira veahava, af-al-pi-chen, hen bivchinat gevul umidda – velo bivchinat en-sof kelal, ki ahava rabba laAdonai beli ketz ugevul umidda en haadam yachol lesovlah belibbo velihyot kayyaym begufo afilu rega, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shebbishat mattan tora, shehayta hitgallut elohuto yitbarech veor-en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat dibbur vehitgallut – "parcha nishmatan kulei";

Vehinne, lefi shehammitzvot nittenu lanu al-yede hitlabbeshut bemiddat gevura vetzimtzum haheara kulei, lachen rov hammitzvot yesh lahen shiur metzumetzam, kemo: orech hatztzitzit yb gudalin, vehattefillin etzbaayim al etzbaayim umerubbaot davka, vehallulav 4 tefachim, vehassukka 7 tefachim, vehashshofar tefach, vehammikve 40 sea, vechen bekarbanot yesh lahen shiur metzumetzam lizman, kemo kevasim bene shana, veelim bene shetayim, ufarim kulei.

Vechen bemaase hatztzedaka ugemilut chasadim bemamono, af shehi mehaammudim shehaolam omed alehem, uchedichtiv: "olam chesed yibbane", afilu hache yesh lah shiur katzuv, chomesh lemitzva min hammuvechar, umaaser lemidda venonit kulei veze nikra "chesed olam", perush: "chesed el kol hayyom", hammitlabbesh baolamot elyonim vetachtonim, al-yede itaruta diltatta, hi mitzvat hatztzedaka vachesed sheosim bene adam ze im ze.

Ulefi shehaolam hu bivchinat gevul umidda "mehaaretz ad larakia 500 shana, vechen merakia lerakia kulei", veshit alfe shene have alma" kulei, lachen nittan shiur umidda gam ken lemitzvat hatztzedaka vehachesed shebbattora kemo lishar mitzvot hattora.

Ach, hayeynu davka leshomer hattora velo sar mimmenna yamin usemol afilu kimlo nima; aval mi sheheevir alav hadderech chas veshalom, meachar sheheeva darko, latet migraot bakkodesh haelyon, sheggara erko, bechinat hameshachato, ma shehaya yachol lehameshich mibbechinat elohuto vehearat haor meor-en-sof baruch-hu illu haya shomer hattora umekayyeymah kehilchatah hare meuvvavt ze lo yuchal litkon, ki im behameshachat haor haelyon shellemala mehaolamot veeno mitlabbesh bahen, hannikra "chesed illaa" verav chesed", lefi shemmeir umitpashshet bivchinat en-sof beli gevul umidda, meachar sheenennu metzumetzam toch haolamot ella bivchinat makkif alehen milmala, meresh kol dargin ad sof vechulei, ucheshehaadam mamshicho lematta bemaasav veitaruta diltatta", azay, or elyon ze meir umitpashshet toch haolamot umetakken kol meuvvavt vechol migraot shennittenu bakkodesh haelyon, umechaddesh oran vetuvan beyeter seet veyeter oz, bivchinat or chadash mammash. lachen amru: "bemakom shebbaale teshuva omdin vechulei".
Vehinne, ikkar hatteshuva hu ballev, ki al-yede hacharata meumeka delibba meorer omek or haelyon hazze.

Ach kede lehameshicho lehair baolamot elyonim vetachtonim tzarich "itaruta diltatta" mammash bivchinat maase, dehayynu, maase hatztzedaka vachesed beli gevul umidda, dichmo shehaadam mashpia rav chesed, perush chas delet, dehayynu ledal veevyon "delet leh miggarmeh kelum", veeno noten gevul umidda lintinato vehashepaato, kach hakkadosh-baruch-hu mashpia oro vetuvo bivchinat chesed illaa, hannikra "rav chesed", hammeir bivchinat en-sof beli gevul umidda toch haolamot elyonim vetachtonim, shekkullam hem bivchinat delet etzlo yitbarech, delet lehon miggarmehon kelum, vecholla kammeh kela chashive", veal-yede ze nitkenu kol happegamim sheppagam haadam baavonotav lemala baolamot elyonim vetachtonim.
Vezehu shekkatuv: "aso tzedaka umishpat nivchar laAdonai mizzavach", lefi shehakkarbanot hen bivchinat shiur umidda ugevul, ma sheen ken bitzdaka sheyyuchal lefazzer beli gevul letakken avonotav.

Uma sheamru: "hamevazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh", hayeynu davka bemi shello chata, o shettikken chataav besiggufim vetaaniyyot karauy, letakken kol happegamim lemala. aval mi shetztzarich letakken nafsho adayin, peshita dela gara refuat hannefesh merfuat hagguf, sheen kesef nechshav – "vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho" ketiv.

Vehinne, middat chesed zo beli gevul umidda nikret al shemo shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu – "chasde Adonai", kedichtiv: "vechesed Adonai meolam vead olam kulei". ki hagam shekkol yisrael hem rachamanim vegomle chasadim, beram yesh gevul umidda lerachame haadam, aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu nikra "en-sof baruch-hu", ulemiddotav en sof, kedichtiv: "ki lo chalu rachamav vechulei".

Vezehu sheamar hannavi achar hachureban vehaggalut: "chasde Adonai ki lo tamnu vegomer", perush: lefi shello tamnu", sheen anu temimim ushelemim beli shum chet ufegam bannefesh uvaolamot elyonim, al ken tzerichin anu lehitnaheg bechasde Adonai shehem beli gevul vetachlit, kede leorer alenu rachamim vechesed illaa, shehu rav chesed verachamim beli gevul vetachlit, kemo shekkatuv: "ki lo chalu rachamav vegomer".
Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka", sheyyaasu gam im yihyu peturim middina, ki "en ben david ba kulei":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 11: Lehasekilcha bina, ki lo zo hadderech yishkon or Adonai lihyot chafetz bechayye vesarim uvane umezone, ki al ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "battel retzoncha kulei", dehayynu, sheyyihye retzono batel bimtziut, velo yihye lo shum ratzon kelal beinyene olam hazze kullam, hannichlalim bevane chayye umezone, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheal karchach atta chay";

Uveur hainyan, hu rak emuna amittit beyotzer bereshit", dehayynu, shehabberia "yesh" meayin", hannikret "reshit chachma" – vehi chachmato sheenah musseget leshum nivra – habberia hazzot, hi bechol et varega, shemmithavvim kol habberuim "yesh" meayin" mechachmato yitbarech hamechayya et hakkol, uchesheyyitbonen haadam beomek havanato, vitzayyer bedato havavyayto meayin" bechol rega varega mammash, haech yaale al dato ki ra lo, o shum yissurim mibbane chayye umezone, o sheare yissurin baolam, hare haayin", shehi chachmato yitbarech, hu mekor hachayyim vehattov vehaoneg, vehu haeden shellemala meolam-habba, rak, mippene sheeno mussag, lachen nidme lo ra o yissurim, aval beemet en ra yored milmala, vehakkol tov, rak sheeno mussag legodlo verav tuvo.
Vezehu ikkar haemuna shebbishvilah nivra haadam, lehaamin delet atar panuy mineh", uveor pene melech chayyim", veal ken "oz vechedva bimkomo" – hoil vehu rak tov kol hayyom.

Veal ken, reshit hakkol, sheyyismach haadam veyagel bechol et veshaa, veyichye mammash beemunato baAdonai, hamechayye umetiv immo bechol rega. umi shemmitatztzev umitonen – mare beatzmo sheyyesh lo meat ra veyissurin vechaser lo eze tova, vahare ze kechofer chas veshalom. veal ken hirchiku middat haatzvut bimod chachme haemet.
Aval hammaamin – lo yachush mishshum yissurin baolam, uvechol inyene haolam "hen" velav" shavin etzlo behashevava amittit.

Umi sheen shavin lo, mare beatzmo shehu meerev rav" dilgarmayyhu avdin", veohev et atzmo, latzet mittachat yad Adonai velichyot bechayye haggoyim bishvil ahavato et atzmo, veal ken hu chafetz bechayye vesarim uvane umezone, ki ze tov lo.

Venoach lo shello nivra", ki ikkar beriat haadam baolam hazze hu bishvil lenassoto benisyonot ellu, veladaat et asher bilvavo, im yifne levavo achare "elohim acherim", shehem taavot hagguf hammishtalshelim missitra ochora", uvahem hu chafetz, o im cheftzo uretzono lichyot chayyim amittim hammishtalshelim meelokim chayyim".

Veyaamin shebbeemet hu chay bahem, vechol tzerachav vechol inyanav mishtalshelim beemet bifrate peratiyyutehem shello missitra ochora", ki "meAdonai mitzade gever konanu" veen milla kulei" veim ken, hakkol tov betachlit rak sheeno mussag.

Uveemuna zo beemet, naase hakkol tov gam begaluy, shebbeemuna zo shemmaamin shehara hannidme begaluy, kol chayyuto hu mittov" haelyon, shehi chachmato yitbarech sheenah musseget, vehi haeden" shellemala meolam-habba, hare beemuna zo nichlal umitalle beemet hara hamedumme battov" haelyon hagganuz:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 12: Vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom, vaavodat hatztzedaka hasheket vavetach ad olam. lehavin hahefresh shebben "maase" laavoda" uven "shalom" lehasheket vavetach" kulei. al pi ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk "ose shalom bimromav" – ki "michael sar shel mayim vegavriel sar shel esh, veen mechabbin ze et ze".

Kelomar, shemmichael sar shel chesed, hannikra beshem "mayim", hayyordim mimmakom gavoah lemakom namuch, vehu bechinat hahashpaa vehitpashshetut hachayyut meolamot elyonim letachtonim, uvechinat esh shettivah laalot lemala, hi bechinat haggevura vehistallekut hashepaat hachayyim mimmatta lemala, shello lehashepia, rak betzimtzum atzum verav, vehen middot negdiyyot vehafkiyyot zo lazo, vehayeynu keshehen bivchinat middot levaddan.

Ach hakkadosh-baruch-hu – ose shalom benehem, dehayynu, al-yede gilluy shemmitgalle bahen heara rabba vehashepaa atzuma meod meor-en-sof baruch-hu, asher kishmo ken hu, sheeno bivchinat midda chas veshalom, ella lemala mala ad en ketz, afilu mibbechinat chachma-bina-daat mekor hammiddot, vaazay, hammiddot negdiyyot shel michael vegavriel nichlalot bimkoran vesharshan, vehayu laachadim mammash, uvetelim beoro yitbarech hammeir lahem bivchinat gilluy.

Vaazay mitmazzegim umitmattekim haggevurot bachasadim, al-yede bechina memutztzaat – kav hammachria umatte kelappe chesed, hi middat harachamim, hannikret beshem "tiferet" bedivre chachme haemet, lefi shehi kelula miv gevavnin: loven veodem, hamerammezim lechesed ugevura.

Velachen, setam shem havaya baruch-hu shebbechol hattora – more al middat hattiferet, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh, lefi, shekkan hu bechinat gilluy or-en-sof baruch-hu, heara rabba, beyeter seet mishshear middotav hakkedoshot yitbarech.

Vehinne, itaruta dilella, leorer gilluy heara rabba vehashepaa atzuma hannizkeret leel, meor-en-sof baruch-hu, laasot shalom hannizkar leel, hi beitaruta diltatta, bemaase hatztzedaka vehashepaat chayyim chen vachesed verachamim leman delet leh miggarmeh kelum, ulehachayot ruach shefalim kulei.

Umudaat zot, ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al haosek battora lishmah: mesim shalom befamalya shel mala uvefamalya shel matta, "pamalya shel mala" hem hassarim vehammiddot hannizkarot leel, shehen hahechalot elyonim beolam habberia shebbazzohar hakkadosh, ufamalya shel matta" hen hahechalot hattachtonim, uvifrat olam hazze hashshafal hameorav tov vara mechet adam harishon, vehara sholet al hattov, kemo shekkatuv: "asher shalat haadam beadam kulei", "uleom milom yeematz".
Vechannire bechush baadam hattachton, hannikra beshem "olam katan", shellifamim hattov gover, velifamim, lehefech chas veshalom.

Veen shalom baolam ad et ketz, sheyyitbarer hattov mehara liddavek besharsho umekoro, mekor hachayyim baruch-hu, vaazay "yitpardu kol poale aven", veruach hattumea yaavor min haaretz, kesheyyitbarer mittocho bechinat hattov hamechayyehu.
Uverur ze yihye gam ken al-yede gilluy elokuto lematta beheara rabba vehashepaa atzuma, kemo shekkatuv: "ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai", "venigla kevod Adonai kulei".

Vezehu bichlalut haolam leatid, ach baadam hattachton, bechol "et metzo" – zo tefilla, o shear ittim mezummanim lehitboded im kono, kol echad lefi maasav, zoche lemeen berur ze, al-yede esek hattora lishmah vechen al-yede hatztzedaka, kemo sheamru: "rabbi elazar yahiv peruta leani vahadar matzlle, dichtiv: ani betzedek echeze fanecha", hi bechinat gilluy heara vehashepaat haddaat vehattevuna, lehitbonen bigdullat Adonai, uleholid mizze dechilu urechimu sichliyyim kannoda.

Veal-yede ze nivrar hattov laAdonai venifrad hara, kemo shekkatuv: "matzref lakkesef vechur lazzahav, veish lefi mahalalo", perush, lefi hillulo et Adonai beomek haddaat leholid dechilu urechimu – kacha nivrar hattov venifrad hara, keverur uferud hassigim mikkesef vezahav bematzref vechur.

Vehinne mudaat zot, sheyyisrael betivam hem rachamanim vegomle chasadim, mippene heyot nafshotehem nimshachot mimmiddotav yitbarech, asher hachesed gover bahen al middat haddin vehaggevura vehatztzimtzum, uchemo shekkatuv: "gavar chasdo al yereav", shellachen nikret hanneshama "bat kohen" kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh.

Vehinne, hatztzedaka hannimshechet mibbechina zo, nikret beshem "maase hatztzedaka", ki shem "maase" nofel al davar shekkevar naasa, o shennaase tamid mimmela vehi davar hahove veragil tamid. veaf kan, hare middat hachesed veharachamanut huteba benafshot kol bet yisrael mikkevar meet beriutan vehishtalshelutan mimmiddotav yitbarech, kemo shekkatuv: "vayyippach beappav kulei", "veatta nafachta bi", "uman denafach kulei", vegam bechol yom vayom betuvo mechaddesh maase vereshit, vachadashim labbekarim kulei".

Ach leshon "avoda" eno nofel ella al davar shehaadam ose bigia atzuma neged teva nafsho, rak shemmevattel tivo uretzono mippene ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, kegon leyaygea atzmo betora uvitfilla "ad mitztzuy hannefesh kulei". veaf kan bemitzvat hatztzedaka, litten harebe yoter mitteva rachamanuto uretzono uchemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk "naton titten" – "afilu mea feamim vechulei".

Vezehu shekkatuv "vehaya maase hatztzedaka", sheggam hatztzedaka hannikret beshem "maase" velo beshem "avoda", af-al-pi-chen, beitaruta diltatta itaruta dilella", meorer gilluy or-en-sof baruch-hu beheara rabba vehashepaa atzuma, venaase shalom bimromav vegam befamalya shel matta.

Rak shebbaolam hazze hashshafal lo yitgalle hashshalom vehabberur uferud hara mehattov ad et ketz velo bizman haggalut, kannizkar leel. rak beolam katan" hu haadam bechol "et metzo" – zo tefilla, kemo shekkatuv "betzedek echeze fanecha", kannizkar leel. ach achar hattefilla, yuchal lihyot hara chozer veneor bekal ulehitarev battov, kaasher yithallech becheshchat olam hazze.

Ach hatztzedaka bivchinat "avoda", hinne, measher yakra vegadla maalatah bimod meod, bihyoto mevattel tivo uretzono haggufani mippene ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, veitkafya sitra ochora, vaazay istallek yekara dekudesha-berich-hu kulei, ucheyitron haor min hachoshech" davka kannoda, e lazot – en hara yachol lihyot od chozer veneor bekallut kol kach meelav, rak im haadam yeorrennu veyamshichennu al atzmo chas veshalom.

Vezehu shekkatuv "hasheket vavetach ad olam", "hasheket" hu milleshon "shoket al shemarav", dehayynu, shehashshemarim nifradim legamre min hayyayin venoflin lematta legamre, vehayyayin lemala zach vetzalul betachlit. veal derech ze hu baavodat hatztzedaka", hashshemarim" hen bechinat taarovet ra shebbenafsho, – nivrar venifrad meat meat ad shennofel lematta limkoro vesharsho, uchemo shekkatuv: "vetashlich bimtzulot yam kol chattotam":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 13: Ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha vegomer.
Hinne, bichlal ovde Adonai yesh 2 bechinot umadregot chalukot mitztzad shoresh nishmatam lemala, mibbechinat yamin usemol.
Dehayynu, shebbechinat semol hi middat hatztzimtzum vehahester baavodat Adonai, kemo shekkatuv: "vehatzenea lechet kulei" "bammistarim tivke kulei", "kol haosek battora basseter kulei".

Vehinne, mimmidda zo nimshecha gam ken bechinat hatztzimtzum vehaggevul baavodat Adonai, kemo bitzdaka lihyot niddon behesseg yad, vehamevazbez – al yevazbez yoter mechomesh", uchehay gavna betalmud tora usheare mitzvot, day lo sheyyotze yede chovato mechiyyuv meforash shechiyyeyvattu hattora beferush likboa ittim kulei. umimmenna nimshach gam ken ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "zerok mara battalmidim kulei".

Ach bechinat yamin, hi middat hachesed vehahitpashshetut baavodat Adonai, behitrachavut beli tzimtzum vehester kelal, kemo shekkatuv: "veethallecha varchava kulei", vegam beli tzimtzum ugevul kelal, veen maatzor leruach nidvato, ben bitzdaka uven betalmud tora usheare mitzvot, velo day lo latzet yede chovato bilvad, ella ad beli day kulei:
Vehinne, kol ish yisrael tzarich lihyot kalul miv bechinot ellu, veen lecha davar sheen lo makom".

Velachen matzinu kamma devarim mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel, lelammedenu, sheaf bet shammay sheshshoresh nishmatam mibbechinat semol haelyon, velachen hayu danin lehachamir tamid bechol issure hattora, uvet hillel shehayu mibbechinat yamin haelyon, hayu melammedin zechut lehakel ulehattir issure bet shammay, sheyyihyu muttarim meissuram veyuchelu laalot lemala, af-al-pi-chen, bechamma devarim hayu bet shammay mekillin, mippene hitkallut shoresh nishmatam shehu kalul gam miyyamin.

Vechen shoresh nishmat bet hillel kalul gam missemol, kayyadua derech umiddot kodesh haelyon, delet taman kitztzutz uferud" chas veshalom, vechol hammiddot kelulot zo mizzo, velachen hem meyuchadot zo bazo, kayyadua leyode chen; uchedichtiv beavraham, shehu middat hachesed vehaahava: "atta yadati ki yere elohim atta", al-yede shellavash middat haggevura, "vayyaakod et yitzchak beno . . vayyikkach et hammaachelet kulei".

Uma sheamar hakkatuv: "avraham ohavi" ufachad yitzchak", hinne hahefresh vehahevdel hazze hu bivchinat gilluy vehelem, shebbemiddat yitzchak – happachad hu bivchinat gilluy vehaahava mesutteret bivchinat helem vehester, vehahefech – bemiddat avraham avinu alav-hashshalom.

Vezehu sheamar david hammelech alav-hashshalom: "ma rav tuvecha vegomer". kelomar, shemmiddat hattov vehachesed asher hi bivchinat helem vehester etzel kol mi sheshshoresh nishmato mibbechinat semol, hannikra beshem "yereecha", kemiddat bet shammay, hinne af shehu tov hagganuz vetzafun, af-al-pi-chen, hu rav vegadol meod kemo middat haggedulla vehachesed mammash shemmibbechinat yamin, ushetehen hen mibbechinat gilluy beli gevul umidda veshiur.

Vezehu shekkatuv "ma rav tuvecha", kelomar beli gevul umidda, ben hattov "asher tzafanta lireecha", uven asher "paalta lachosim bach", shehem baale habbittachon shemmibbechinat yamin, vechasdam vetuvam, hu gam ken bivchinat gilluy vehitpashshetut – "neged bene adam", velo bivchinat tzimtzum vehester kelal.

(Uma shekkatuv "lireecha" velo "bireecha", hayeynu mishshum shekkol ma shehu bivchinat helem bechol neshama, hinne bechina zo enah melubbeshet toch hagguf bemocho velibbo, ella hu bivchinat makkif milmala, umishsham hi meira lemocho velibbo laittim hatztzerichim lehitorrut bechina zo, shettitorer vetair lemocho velibbo, kede lavo lide maase befoal mammash).

Veamar al ken, asher "rav tuv levet yisrael", hatztzafun vehaggaluy, hu bivchinat beli gevul umidda lefi erech nafshotam hamelubbeshet bagguf, lachen, gam atta Adonai titnaheg immahem bemiddat chasdecha haggadol beli gevul vetachlit, hannikra "rav chesed".

Deit chesed veit chesed": it chesed olam, sheyyesh kenegdo uleummato middat haddin chas veshalom, lemaet uletzamtzem chasdo vetuvo. aval chesed elyon hannikra "rav chesed", en kenegdo middat haddin lemaet uletzamtzem rov chasdo millehitpashshet beli gevul vetachlit, ki hu nimshach mibbechinat "sovev kol almin" utemira dechol temirin", hannikra "keter elyon". vezehu shekkatuv: "tastirem beseter panecha vegomer titzpenem besukka vegomer":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 14: Leorer et haahava hayeshana vechibbat eretz hakkodesh, lihyot boeret kerishpe esh mikkerev ish velev amok, keillu hayyom mammash natan Adonai rucho alenu, ruach nediva, behitnaddev am lemallovt yadam laAdonai, beyad melea urechava, beribbuy achar ribbuy, midde shana beshana, holech veole lemala rosh, kemiddat "kodesh haelyon" hammeir leeretz hakkodesh, hammitchaddesh umitrabbe tamid, kedichtiv: "tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah, mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana";
Dehay "vead acharit kulei" eno muvan lichora, shehare beacharit shana zo matchelet shana sheniyya, veim ken hava-leh-lememar "leolam vaed"?

Ach hainyan yuvan, al pi ma shekkatuv: "Adonai bechachma yasad aretz", sheyyesod haaretz haelyona" – hi bechinat "memalle kol almin", vehattachtona – hi "eretz chefetz" hamechuvvevnet kenegdah mammash venikret al shemah "eretz hachayyim", hinne hu nimshach mehameshachat vehearat chachma illaa, mekor hachayyim haelyonim, kedichtiv: "hachachma techayye vealeha vechulei".

Veheara vehameshacha zo hi mitchaddeshet beor chadash mammash bechol shana veshana, ki hu yitbarech vechachmato echad betachlit hayyichud, venikra beshem "or-en-sof baruch-hu", sheen sof veen ketz lemaalat ugedullat haor vehachayyut hannimshach mimmennu yitbarech umechachmato, beilluy achar illuy, ad en ketz vetachlit, lerum hammaalot lemala mala.

Uvechol shana veshana yored umeir mechachma illaa or chadash umechuddash, shello haya meir adayin meolam laaretz haelyona, ki or kol shana veshana mistallek lesharsho bechol erev rosh-hashshana keshehachodesh mitkasse bo", veachar kach, al-yede tekiat shofar vehattefillot, nimshach or chadash elyon mibbechina elyona yoter shebbemadregat chachma illaa, lehair laaretz elyona veladdarim aleha, hem kol haolamot haelyonim vehattachtonim hamekabbelim chayyutam mimmenna, dehayynu, min haor-en-sof baruch-hu vechachmato hamelubbash bah, kedichtiv: "ki immecha mekor chayyim, beorcha nire or", dehayynu, or hammeir mechachma illaa mekor hachayyim (vechannoda leyode chen, shebbechol rosh-hashshana hi hannesira, umekabbelet mochin chadashim elyonim yoter kulei).
Uvifrate peratiyyut, ken hu bechol yom vayom, nimshachin mochin elyonim yoter bechol tefillat hashshachar, veenan mochin harishonim shennistalleku achar hattefilla, rak gevohin yoter.
Vederech kelal bichlalut haolam beshit alfe shenin", ken hu bechol rosh-hashshana verosh-hashshana.
Vezehu shekkatuv "tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah", shehaenayim" hem kinnuyim lehameshachat vehearat or hachachma, shellachen nikreu chachamim "ene haeda", vaavira deeretz yisrael machkim".

Veheara vehameshacha zo, af shehi temidit, af-al-pi-chen enah bivchina umadrega achat levaddah mime olam, ella shebbechol shana veshana hu or chadash elyon, ki haor shennitchaddesh veheir berosh-hashshana ze, hu mistallek beerev rosh-hashshana habbaa lesharsho. vezehu shekkatuv "mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana" levaddah.

Velachen ketiv "mereshit" chaser 1 – romez al histallekut haor shemmistallek belel rosh-hashshana ad achar hattekiot, sheyyored or chadash elyon yoter shello haya meir adayin mime olam or elyon kaze, vehu mitlabbesh umistatter beeretz hachayyim" shellemala veshellematta, lehachayot et kol haolamot kol meshech shana zo.
Ach gilluyo mehahester hazze, taluy bemaase hattachtonim uzechutam uteshuvatam baaseret yeme teshuva, veday lammevin:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 15: Lehavin mashal umelitza divre chachamim vechidotam beinyan hassefirot, mudaat zot baaretz mippi kedoshe elyon nishmatam eden.

Lekarev ketzat el hassechel, may dichtiv "umibbesari echeze eloah", shehakkavvavna hi lehavin ketzat elohuto yitbarech minnefesh hamelubbeshet bivsar haadam, veal pi maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk: "barchi nafshi vegomer" "ma hakkadosh-baruch-hu kulei, af hanneshama kulei", veal pi maamar hazzohar al pasuk: "vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim"; man denafach, mittocheh nafach, vaafilu nefesh daasiyya hi baa mizziuug zeer anpin venukeva daasiyya, vehammochin shellahem shehem bechinat chayya uneshama dizer anpin venukeva, shehen hen achorayim dechelim dizer anpin venukeva daatzilut, shehem elohut mammash, shebbetocham meir or-en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash veganuz bechachma daatzilut, deihu vegarmohi chad" baatzilut.

Veal ken, gam benishmat haadam meir or-en-sof baruch-hu, melubbash veganuz beor hachachma shebbah, lehachayot et haadam. umimmenna yuchal haadam lehavin ketzat bisfirot haelyonot, shekkullan meirot benishmato hakkelula mehen.

Ach tzarich lehakedim, ma sheshshamati mimmori alav-hashshalom al pasuk "veanochi afar vaefer", sheamar avraham avinu alav-hashshalom al hearat nishmato hammeira begufo meor chesed elyon, vehi middato middat "ahava rabba", (nusach achar: shebbah haya) shehaya ohev et hakkadosh-baruch-hu ahava gedola veelyona kol kach, ad shennaasa "merkava" lehakkadosh-baruch-hu.
