Vesalka datach amina, shebbechinat chesed veahava shellemala bassefirot haelyonot, hi meen vesug mahut middat "ahava rabba" shel avraham avinu alav-hashshalom, rak shehi gedola veniflaa mimmenna lemala mala ad en ketz vetachlit, kannoda mimmiddot haelyonot sheen lahem [<small>nusach achar:</small> ketz] sof vetachlit mitztzad atzman, ki or-en-sof baruch-hu meir umelubbash betocham mammash, veihu vegarmohi chad". ma sheen ken benishmat haadam hamelubbeshet bachomer, sheyyesh lemiddoteha ketz ugevul, aval mikkol makom salka datach amina shemmiddoteha hen meen vesug middot haelyonot.

Velaze amar: "veanochi afar vaefer", dichmo shehaefer hu mahuto veatzmuto shel haetz hannisraf, shehaya murekav mid yesodot: esh ruach mayim afar, veg yesodot esh mayim ruach – chalfu vehalchu lahem vechalu beashan hammithavve meharekavatan kannoda, visod had shehaya baetz – shehu heafar shebbo hayyored lematta veen haesh sholetet bo, hu hannishar kayyaym, vehu haefer.

Vehinne, kol mahut haetz umammasho vechumero vetzurato beorech verochav veovi shehaya nire laayin kodem shennisraf, ikkaro haya misod heafar shebbo, rak sheesh mayim ruach kelulim bo, ki heafar hu chumeri yoter mikkullan, veyesh lo orech verochav veovi, ma sheen ken beesh veruach, vegam hammayim hem meat mizzeer baetz, vechol arko verachbo veovyo "hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar", shehu haefer hannishar achare shennifredu mimmennu esh mayim ruch.

Vehinne, kemo shehaefer en lo dimyon veerech el mahut haetz haggadol beorech verochav veovi kodem shennisraf, lo bechammuto velo beechuto, af shehu [hu] mahuto veatzmuto umimmennu nithavva – kach al derech mashal amar avraham avinu alav-hashshalom al middato, middat hachesed vehaahava hammeira bo umelubbeshet begufo, deaf shehi [hi] middat haahava vechesed haelyon shebbaatzilut hammeir benishmato shehayta merkava elyona, af-al-pi-chen beridtah lematta lehitlabbesh begufo al-yede hishtalshelut haolamot mimmadrega lemadrega al-yede tzimtzumim rabbim, en dimyon veerech mahut or haahava hammeir bo el mahut or ahava vechesed elyon shebbaatzilut, ella keerech vedimyon mahut heafar shennaasa efer el mahuto veechuto keshehaya "etz nechmad lemare vetov lemaachol" al derech mashal, veyoter mizze, lehavedil baalafim havedalot, rak sheddibbera tora kilshon bene adam" bemashal umelitztza:

Vehinne, kelalut hay sefirot shebbenishmat haadam, noda lakkol [bederech kelal. bichtav yad leta], shehammiddot nechlakot bederech kelal lez middot, vechol perate hammiddot shebbaadam – baot meachat miz middot ellu, shehen shoresh kol hammiddot uchelalutan, shehen: middat hachesed lehashepia beli gevul, umiddat haggevura – letzamtzem millehashpia kol kach, o shello lehashepia [nusach achar: kol ikkar] kelal, umiddat harachamim – lerachem al mi sheshshayyaych leshon rachamanut alav, vehi midda memutztzaat ben gevura lechesed, shehi lehashepia lakkol, gam lemi shello shayyaych leshon rachamanut alav kelal, mippene sheeno chaser kelum veeno sharuy betzaar kelal.

Ulefi shehi midda memutztzaat, nikret "tiferet", kemo bigde tiferet al derech mashal, shehu beged tzavua bigvavnim harebe meoravim [bo. <small>bichtav yad leta</small>] bederech shehu tiferet venoy, ma sheen ken beged hatztzavua begavevn echad lo shayyaych bo leshon tiferet.

Veachar kach, bevo hahashpaa lide maase, dehayynu bishat hahashpaa mammash tzarich lehityaetz ech lehashepia, bederech sheyyuchal hamekabbel lekabbel hahashpaa, kegon sherotze lehashepia devar chachma lelammedah livno, im yomrenna lo kullah kemo shehi besichlo – lo yuchal habben lehavin ulekabbel, rak shetztzarich lesadder lo beseder veinyan acher, "davar davur al ofnav", meat meat.

Uvechinat etza zo nikret "netzach" vehod", shehen "kelayot yoatzot"; vegam [<small>nusach achar:</small> vehen] "teren bein", hamevashshelim hazzera, shehi hattippa hannimshechet mehammoach, dehayynu devar chachma vasechel hannimshach missechel haav, shello yumeshach kemo shehu sechel dak meod bemocho vesichlo, rak yishtanne ketzat middakkut sichlo veyithavvev sechel sheeno dak kol kach, kede sheyyuchal habben lekabbel bemocho vahavanato, vehu mammash, al derech mashal, ketippa hayyoredet mehammoach shehi dakka meod [meod], venaaset gassa vechumerit mammash bakkelayot uteren bein.

Vegam "netzach" vehod" nikraim "shechakim" verechayim" sheshshochakim man latztzaddikim", kemo, hattochen [chittim] barechayim, al derech mashal, shemmefarer hachittim lachalakim dakkim meod, kach tzarich haav lehaketin hassechel udevar chachma sherotze lehashepia livno, ulechallekam lachalakim rabbim velomar lo meat meat bemoetzot vadaat.

Vegam bichlal bechinat "netzach" hu lenatztzeach velaamod neged kol monea hahashpaa vehallimmud mibbeno mibbayit umichutz, mibbayit – hayeynu lehitchazzek neged middat haggevura vehatztzimtzum shebbaav atzmo, shehi meoreret dinim birtzono al beno, lomar sheeno rauy lechach adayin (<small>bichtav yad nirsham:</small> chaser)

Uvechinat "yesod" hi, al derech mashal, hahitkashsherut shemmekashsher haav sichlo besechel beno bishat limmudo immo beahava veratzon, sherotze sheyyavin beno; uvilade ze, gam im haya habben shomea dibburim ellu atzmam mippi aviv [shemmedabber baado velomed leatzmo <small>bichtav yad kodesh 251 baal tzemach tzedek nishmato eden, (baderavesh "ki yedativ" saif 13 shahevaatak sham leshon ze) – leta tevot ellu</small>] lo haya mevin kol kach kemo achshav, sheaviv mekashsher sichlo elav umedabber immo panim el panim beahava vacheshek, shechoshek meod sheyyavin beno,

Vechol ma shehacheshek vehattaanug gadol, kach hahashpaa vehallimmud gadol, shehabben – yuchal lekabbel yoter, vehaav – mashpia yoter, ki al-yede hacheshek vehattaanug, mitrabbe umitgaddel sichlo beharechavat haddaat lehashepia ulelammed livno (uchemo al derech mashal begashmiyyut mammash, ribbuy hazzera hu merov hacheshek vehattaanug, veal-yede ze mamshich harebe mehammoach, velachen himshilu chachme haemet leziuug gashmi, kemo sheyyitbaer).

Vehinne, middot ellu hen bechinot chitzoniyyot shebbannefesh, uvetochan melubbashot middot penimiyyot, shehen bechinot ahava veyira kulei. dehayynu, al derech mashal, baav hammashpia livno mechamat ahavato, umonea hashepaato mippachdo veyirato, shello yavo lide michshol, chas veshalom.

Umekor veshoresh middot ellu, happenimiyyot vehachitzoniyyot, hu mechachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho, ki lefi sechel haadam – kach hen middotav, kannire bechush, shehakkatan, shehachachma-bina-daat shello hen bivchinat katnut – kach kol middotav hen bidvarim ketanne haerech.
Vegam bigdolim "lefi sichlo yehullal ish", ki lefi rov chachmato – kach hu rov ahavato vechasdo. vechen shear kol middotav penimiyyot vechitzoniyyot, mekoran hu mechachma-bina-daat shebbo.
Vehaikkar – hu haddaat shebbo, hannimshach mibbechinat hachachma uvina shebbo, kannire bechush, ki lefi shinnuy deot bene adam ze mizze kach hu shinnuy middotehem.

Vehinne, kol ze hu rak al derech mashal levad, ki kol ze hu bannefesh hassichlit hattachtona shebbaadam, habbaa mikkelippat noga. ach beemet laamitto, bannefesh haelyona haelohit, shehi "chelek eloah mimmaal", kol hammiddot, penimiyyot vechitzoniyyot, hen laAdonai levaddo.
Ki mechamat ahavat Adonai umerov cheftzo ledavka vo, hu chafetz chesed kede liddavek bemiddotav, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk "uledavka vo": "hiddavek bemiddotav".

Vechen bemiddat haggevura – lehippara min harshaim uleansham beonshe hattora, vechen, lehitgabber al yitzro ulekaddesh et atzmo bammuttar lo, velaasot gader useyayg lattora, mippene pachad Adonai veyirato, pen yavo lide chet chas veshalom.
Vechen lefaer et Adonai vetorato bechol mine peer, uledavka bishvachav bechol bechinot nafsho, dehayynu behitbonnut sichlo umachashavto, gam bedibburo.

Vechen laamod benitztzachon neged kol monea meavodat Adonai umilledavka vo, veneged kol monea millihyot kevod Adonai male et kol haaretz, kemilchamot Adonai asher nilcham david hammelech alav-hashshalom.

Vechen lehishtachavot ulehodot laAdonai, asher mechayye umehavve et hakkol, vehakkol batel bimtziut etzlo, vechulla kammeh kela chashiv, ucheayin vaefes mammash. veaf sheen anu massigim ech hu hakkol efes mammash kammeh, af-al-pi-chen, modim anachnu behodaa amittit shekken hu beemet laamitto.

Uvichlal ze gam ken, lehodot laAdonai al kol hattovot asher gemalanu, velo lihyot kefuy tova chas veshalom. uvichlal ze, lehodot al kol shevachav umiddotav ufeullotav baatzilut uveriat elyonim vetachtonim, shehem meshubbachim ad en tachlit [<small>nusach achar:</small> cheker], venaim ureuyim elav yitbarech veyitalle, vehu milleshon "hod vehadar".
Vechen bemiddat "tzaddik yesod olam", lihyot nafsho keshura baAdonai chayye hachayyim, uledavka vo bidvika vachashika, becheshek vetaanug nifla.
Uvemiddat malchut, lekabbel alav ol malchuto vaavodato kaavodat kol eved laadono beema uveyira.

Umekor veshoresh kol hammiddot hen mechachma-bina-daat, dehayynu: hachachma – hi mekor hassechel hammassig et Adonai vechachmato ugedullato umiddotav hakkedoshot shemmanhig umechayye bahen kol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim, uvina – hi hahitbonnut behassaga zo beorech verochav veomek binato, lehavin davar mittoch davar, uleholid mehassaga zo – toldoteha, shehen middot ahava veyira usheare middot hannoladot bannefesh haelohit, hammaskelet umitbonenet bigdullat Adonai. ki, "ligdullato en cheker".

Veyesh bechinat gedullat Adonai, sheal-yede hitbonnut hannefesh haelohit bah – tippol aleha emata vafachad shehi yira tattaa, shehi bechinat malchut, veyesh bechinat gedullat Adonai – shemmimmenna baa yira illaa, yira boshet, veyesh bechina shemmimmenna baa – ahava rabba, veyesh bechina shemmimmenna baa – ahava zuta. vechen bammiddot hachitzoniyyot, shehen chesed kulei.

Uvechullan tzarich lihyot melubbash bahen bechinat haddaat, shehu bechinat hitkashsherut hannefesh, hakkeshura utekua behassaga zo shemmasseget eze inyan miggedullat Adonai, shemmimmenna nolda bah eze midda mehammiddot, ki behessach haddaat kerega mehassaga zo – mistalleket gam ken hammidda hannolda mimmenna, mehaggilluy bannefesh el hahelem, lihyot bah bechoach velo befoal.

Velachen nikra hazziuug bilshon "daat", mippene shehu leshon hitkashsherut. vezehu bechinat daat tachton [<small>nusach achar:</small> haddaat hattachton], hammitpashshet bammiddot umitlabbesh bahen lehachayotan ulekayyeyman.

Veyesh bechinat daat haelyon, shehu bechinat hitkashsherut vechibbur mekor hassechel hammassig omek hammussag, shehu kinkudda uchevarak hammavrik al sichlo, sheyyitpashshet lematta veyavo omek hammussag lide havana, beharechavat habbeur beorech verochav, shehi bechinat bina, hannikret "rechovot hannahar", kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 16: Leanshe Kohelet vechulei

Ahuvayy, achayy vereayy asher kenafshi! hinne, lo nelam mimmenni tzok haittim, asher nitdaldela happarnasa, uvifrat hayeduim li mimmachanechem asher mata yadam beli shum mashen umashena, umammash lovim veochlim, Adonai yerachem alehem veyarchiv lahem batztzar bekarov.

Veim kol ze, lo tov hem osim lenafsham, lefi hannishma, asher kaftzu yadam happetucha meodam ad hayyom hazze, litten beyad melea veayin yafa lechol hitztarchut hahechrechiyim lede machsore haevyonim nekiyyim, asher enehem nesuot elenu, veim anu lo nerachem alehem chas veshalom, mi yerachem alehem? veche achicha immach ketiv!

Velo amru "chayyecha kodmin", ella keshebbeyad echad kitton shel mayim vechulei", shehu davar hashshave lishnehem beshave lishtot lehashiv nafsham batztzama. aval im heani tzarich lechem lefi hattaf veetzim uchesut bakkara uchehay gavna, kol devarim ellu kodmin lechol malbushe chavod vezevach mishpacha basar vedagim vechol matammim shel haadam vechol bene veto, velo shayyaych baze "chayyecha kodmin", meachar sheenan chayye nefesh mammash kemo shel heani, shave beshave mammash, kidita bindarim daf 80.

Vehinne, zehu al pi shurat haddin gamur. aval beemet, gam im hu inyan delo shayyaych kol kach hay taama rauy lechol adam shello ledakdek lehaamid al haddin, rak lidchok chayyav velikkanes lifnay velifnim mishshurat haddin, velidog leatzmo mimmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shekkol hamedakdek bechach – sof ba lide chach, chas veshalom.

Vegam, ki kullanu tzerichim lerachame shamayim bechol et, beitaruta diltatta davka bechol et uvechol shaa, leorer rachamenu al hatztzerichim lerachamim, vechol hameammetz levavo vechovesh rachamav, yihye meeze taam sheyyihye – gorem kach lemala, lichbosh vechulei chas veshalom.

Uma gam, "ki adam en tzaddik baaretz asher yaase tov – tamid – velo yecheta", vehatztzedaka mechapperet umeginna min happureanut vechulei, velazot hi refuat hagguf venefesh mammash, asher "or bead or vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho".

Besheggam, anu maaminim bene maaminim, ki hatztzedaka, enah rak halevaa lehakkadosh-baruch-hu, kedichtiv: "malve Adonai chonen dal, ugemulo yeshallem lo" bechiflayim baolam hazze, dischar kol hammitzvot lekka baolam hazze, levad mitztzedaka, lefi shehu tov labberiyyot, kidita bekiddushin sof perek kamma.
Vegam yesh lachush leonesh, chas veshalom, keshechaverav nimnim lidvar mitzva vehu lo nimne immahem, kannoda mimmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha.
Velashshomim yuneam, vetavo alehem birkat tov, bechol mille demetav, hetiva Adonai lattovim visharim, kenafsham venefesh haddoresh shelomam mikkol lev vanefesh:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 17: Noda, divitaruta diltatta", shehaadam meorer belibbo middat hachesed verachamanut al kol hatztzerichim lerachamim – "itaruta dilella", leorer alav rachamim rabbim mimmekor harachamim, lehashepia lo happerot baolam hazze, vehakkeren laolam-habba.

Perush, "happerot" – hi hashepaa hannishpaat mimmekor harachamim vechayye hachayyim baruch-hu, venimshechet lematta matta bivchinat hishtalshelut haolamot milmala lematta kulei, ad shemmitlabbeshet baolam hazze haggashmi bevane chayye umezone" kulei.
Vehakkeren" hu kemo shekkatuv: "rechava mitzvatcha meod", vahava-leh-lememar "mitzvotecha" leshon rabbim (vegam leshon "rechava" eno muvan):

Ella: "mitzvatcha" dayyka, hi mitzvat hatztzedaka, shehi mitzvat Adonai mammash, ma shehakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uveatzmo ose tamid lehachayot haolamot, veyaase leatid beyeter seet vaoz, uchemo shekkatuv: "veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka kulei", kemo derech sheholchim bah meir leir, al derech mashal, kach hatztzedaka hi bechinat gilluy vehearat or-en-sof baruch-hu "sovev kol almin", sheyyair veyitgalle ad olam hazze, beitaruta diltatta", betorat tzedaka vechesed chinnam, leatid bitchiyyayt hammetim, beyeter seet veyeter oz leen ketz mibbechinat gilluy (heara) [haheara] began eden hattachton vehaelyon, shehare kol nishmot hatztzaddikim vehattannaim vehanneviim, shehem atta began eden haelyon berum hammaalot, yitlabbeshu begufotehem leatid veyakumu bizman hattechiyyay lehanot mizziv hashshechina.

Lefi shehaheara vehaggilluy shebbegan eden hi bechinat "memalle kol almin", shehu bechinat hishtalshelut mimmadrega lemadrega al-yede tzimtzumim atzumim, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "beYod nivra olam-habba", vehi bechinat chachma illaa, hannikret "eden haelyon", hammishtalshelet umitlabbeshet bechol haolamot, kemo shekkatuv: "kullam bechachma asita kulei", vehachachma techayye kulei", uvegan eden, hi bivchinat gilluy hahassaga lechol chad lefum shiura dileh, kannoda, sheoneg hanneshamot began eden hu mehassagat sodot hattora sheasak baolam hazze bannigle, kidita bazzohar hakkadosh parashat shelach, uvaggemara, beuveda derabba bar nachmani.

Aval gilluy haheara shebbitchiyyayt hammetim, yihye mibbechinat "sovev kol almin", sheenah bivchinat tzimtzum veshiur ugevul, ela beli gevul vetachlit, kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim" perek 48 beur inyan "sovev kol almin", sheeno kemashmao kemo iggul, chas veshalom, ella sheeno bivchinat hitlabbeshut vechulei, veayyen sham hetev.

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "veatrotehem berashehem venehenin kulei", "atara" hi bechinat makkif vesovev, venikra "keter" milleshon "koteret", vehu bechinat memutztza hamechabber hearat hammaatzil en-sof baruch-hu lehanneetzalim, veleatid yair veyitgalle baolam hazze lechol hatztzaddikim sheyyakumu battechiyyay ("veammech kullam tzaddikim kulei").

Veze sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "atidim tzaddikim sheyyomru lifnehem kadosh", ki "kadosh" hu bechinat muvedal, sheeno begeder hassaga vadaat, ki hu lemala mala mibbechinat hachachma vadaat shebbegan eden, ki "hachachma meayin timmatze" ketiv, hu bechinat "keter elyon" hannikra "ayin" bazzohar hakkadosh, vehashepaato vehearato bivchinat gilluy – hu davka keshehanneshama titlabbesh beguf zach vetzach achar hattechiyya, ki "nautz techillatan besofan" davka, vesof maase bemachashava techilla kulei", kannoda.

Ach i efshar lehaggia lemadrega zo, ad sheyyehe began eden techilla, lehassig bechinat chachma illaa (kulei) [<small>efshar tzarich lihyot:</small> kol chad] kefum shiura dileh, vetal tora mechayyehu", "vahakitzota hi tesichecha kulei", veday lammevin.

Vezehu "rechava mitzvatcha meod", hi mitzvat hatztzedaka, shehi keli veshetach rachav meod, lehitlabbesh bah hearat or-en-sof baruch-hu (uchemo shekkatuv: "levusho tzedaka"), asher yair leatid bivchinat beli gevul vetachlit bechesed chinnam beitaruta diltatta" zo, hannikret "derech Adonai". vezehu leshon "meod", shehu beli gevul vetachlit.

Aval "lechol tichla raiti ketz", "tichla" hi milleshon "kelot hannefesh" shebbegan eden, shehi bivchinat "ketz" vetachlit vetzimtzum kannizkar leel, ulechol tichla" hu lefi sheyyesh kamma vechamma maalot umadregot gan eden ze lemala mizze ad rum hammaalot, kemo shekkatuv belikkute hashshas mehaarizal beferush maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "talmide chachamim en lahem menucha kulei", sheolim tamid mimmadrega lemadrega behassagat hattora sheen lah sof kulei, ad achar hattechiyya sheyyihye lahem menucha kulei:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 18: Ketiv: "ma yafit uma naamt, ahava battaanugim".

Hinne 2 mine ahavot hen, haachat – "ahava battaanugim", dehayynu, shemmitanneg al Adonai oneg nifla besimcha rabba vaatzuma, simchat hannefesh uchelotah, betaamah ki tov Adonai venaim, neimut arevut ad lehafeli, meen olam-habba mammash, shennehenin kulei, veal ze ketiv: "simchu tzaddikim baAdonai"; velo kol adam zoche laze.

Vezo hi bechinat "kahana biruta delibba" shebbazzohar hakkadosh, veal ze neemar: "avodat mattana vegomer vehazzar hakkarev vegomer", ki en derech lehassigah al-yede yegiat basar, kemo hayyira, sheshshoalin aleha: "yagata beyira", veoy levasar shello nityaygea beyira", kemo shekkatuv bereshit chachma", uchetiv beyira: "im tevakshenna chakkasef vegomer", melammed shetztzericha yegia rabba vaatzuma kimchappes achar otzarot.

Aval ahava rabba zo ["ahava battaanugim"], nofelet laadam meeleha milmala beli sheyyachin vichavvevn lah, ach verak achar shennityaygea beyirat harommut", vehiggia letachlit ma sheyyuchal lehassig mimmenna lefi bechinat nishmato, azay mimmela baa haahava battaanugim" milmala, lishkon ulehityayched im hayyira, ki "darko shel ish lechazzer kulei", kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim.

Vehashshenit – hi ahava vetaava, shehannefesh mitavva veohevet vachafetza ledavka baAdonai, litzror bitzror hachayyim, vekirvat elohim tov lah meod, uvo tachpotz, vera lah meod lehitrachek mimmennu yitbarech chas veshalom, lihyot mechitza shel barzel mehachitzonim mafseket chas veshalom.
Veahava zo hi museteret belev kelal yisrael, afilu birshaim, umimmenna baa lahem hacharata.
Ach mippene shehi museteret venelama bivchinat galut bagguf, hare hakkelippa yechola lishlot aleha, vezehu ruach shetut hammachati laadam.

Veal ken, avodat haadam lekono hi, lehitchazzek ulehitgabber al hakkelippa bakkol mikkol kol, dehayynu, mittechilla legarshah mehagguf legamre, mimmachashava dibbur umaase shebbemoach velashon veramach evarim, veachar kach, yuchal gam ken "lehotzi mimmasger assir" bechozek yad, dehayynu, lihyot chazak veammitz libbo baggibborim", lihyot haahava hamesutteret niglet begilluy rav bechol kochot chelke hannefesh shebbagguf. dehayynu, haikkar besechel uvemachashava shebbammoach, shehassechel yachshov veyitbonen tamid kefi sichlo vehasekalato babbore yitbarech, ech shehu chayye hachayyim bichlal vechayye nishmato bifrat.

Veal ken yichsof veyitavve lihyot davuk bo vekarov elav, kosef tivi, keven hakkosef lihyot tamid etzel aviv, uchemo esh haola lemala tamid betivah limkorah. vechol ma sheyyatmid lachashov besichlo kosef ze kacha yitgabber veyitpashshet kosef ze gam befiv uvechol evarav laasok betora umitzvot, ledavka vahem baAdonai mammash, deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad".
Veal kosef ze shebbegilluy rav ketiv: "tzama nafshi vegomer", keadam hatztzame lemayim veen lo taanug adayin kelal.

Vegam al kosef ze veahava zo hamuseteret banu, anu matirim laAdonai lihyot beezrenu, lehotziah mimmasger, vesheyyihye hallev male mimmenna levaddah, velo tikkanes tzaratah bevetah shehi taavat olam hazze, rak shettihye hi akeret habbayit limshol betzaratah ulegarshah hachutza mimmachashava dibbur umaase al kol panim, hagam shello yuchal leshallechah legamre millibbo, al kol panim tihye hi museteret bivchinat galut veavdut laakeret habbayit gevirtah, lehishtammesh bah lidvarim hechrechim lah levad, kaachila ushetiyya, kedichtiv: "bechol derachecha daehu":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 19: Ote or kassalma vegomer. hinne, belikkute tora" shel haarizal parashat ki tissa ufarashat vayyikra katav, ki hassagat moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom lo hayta bivchinat penimiyyut dechachma illaa, hannikra "abba daatzilut", vechol shekken bisfirat hakketer shellemala mimmenna, hannikra "arich anpin", ki im bivchinat achorayim dechachma hammitlabbeshim bevina, hammitlabbeshet bez sefirot tachtonot shennikraim "zeer anpin", sod hattora, umitpashshetet ad sof 4 sefirot hattachtonot, shehen netzach-hod-yesod-malchut, vesham hayta hassagat nevuato bivchinat penimiyyut, dehayynu mibbechinat penimiyyut denetzach-hod-yesod-malchut.

Aval lemala minnetzach-hod-yesod-malchut lo hayta lo shum hassaga bifnimiyyut, ki im bivchinat achorayim dechachma hamelubbashim bevina, hamelubbeshet umitpashshetet toch penimiyyut denetzach-hod-yesod-malchut, besod "novlot chachma shellemala – tora", shehi bivchinat "zeer anpin", uchedichtiv: "veraita et achoray, ufanay lo yerau", ayyen sham uveshaar hannevua perek 1.

Velichora yesh lehafeli, hare neemar: "velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe", veech hissig haarizal yoter mimmennu vedarash kamma derushim bivchinat penimiyyut, afilu bisfirot umadregot rabbot shellemala mehachachma vecheter daatzilut?

Ach hainyan hu pashut umuvan lakkol, sheyyesh hefresh gadol ben hassagat chachme haemet kerashbi vehaarizal, shehi hassagat chachma vadaat, uven hassagat moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom ushear hanneviim binvua, hamechunna bakkatuv beshem "reiyya" mammash; veraita et achoray", "vaere et Adonai", "vayyera elav Adonai".

Veaf shezzehu derech mashal, veenah reiyyayt en basar gashmi mammash, mikkol makom, hannimshal tzarich lihyot dome lammashal, uchetargum "vayyera elav Adonai", "veitgeli leh vechulei", shehu bechinat hitgallut, shennigla elav hannelam baruch-hu bivchinat hitgallut. ma sheen ken behassagat chachme haemet, shello nigla alehem havaya bivchinat hitgallut, rak shehem massigim taalumot chachma hannelam [<small>nusach achar:</small> bannelam] umufela mehem.

Velachen amru: "chacham adif minnavi", sheyyachol lehassig bechachmato lemala mala mimmadregot sheyyuchelu lered lematta bivchinat hitgallut linviim bemare nevuatam, ki lo yuchelu lered ulehitgallot alehem, rak madregot hattachtonot, shehen: netzach-hod-yesod-malchut, shehen hen hayyordot tamid umitgallot mehammashpia lehamekabbel bivchinat mochin vechayyut, kayyadua leyode chen, shehannetzach-hod-yesod-malchut shel haelyon mitlabbeshim battachton lehachayoto, shehen hen kele hahashpaa vehoradat hachayyut mehaelyon lattachton bechol haolamot vehammadregot, velachen gam ken – hen hen hammitgallot lanneviim bivchinat hitgallut mammash, uvetochan melubbash or habbina, shehi bechinat havanat haelohut meor [<small>nusach achar:</small> veor] en-sof baruch-hu.

Uvetochah melubbashim achorayim dechachma, shehi madrega shellemala mehassechel vehahavana belohut baruch-hu, ki shem "chachma" more al mekor hassechel vehahavana. velachen amru bazzohar deorayyta – mechachma nafkat", ki taame mitzvot lo nitgallu, vehem lemala mehassechel vehahavana.

Vegam beezehu mekoman shennitgalla venitparesh eze taam hammuvan lanu lichora en ze – hattaam hammuvan lanu levaddo – tachlit hattaam ugevulo, ella betocho melubbash penimiyyut vetaalumot chachma shellemala mehassechel vehahavana.

Vechen bechol dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh-baruch-hu lanneviim, hakketuvim battora-neviim-ketuvim, hen divre tochacha vehen sippure maasiyyot, melubbash betocham bechinat chachmat elohut shellemala mehassechel vehahavana, kannire bechush meinyan hakkeri" vehakketiv", ki hakkeri" hu lefi hahavana hanniglet lanu, vehakketiv" hu lemala mehassechel vehahavana, shetteva zo kichtivatah en lah levush bivchinat hahavana, uvikriatah bappe yesh lah levush.
Vechen hainyan beotiyyot gedolot shebbetora neviim uchetuvim, shehen mealma illaa, umeirot mishsham begilluy – beli levush kishar haotiyyot.

Vehinne, bechinat chachmat elohut baruch-hu hamelubbeshet betaryag mitzvot hattora nikret beshem "bechinat achorayim dechachma", ki kol achorayim shebbassefirot hen madregot hachitzonot vehattachtonot bemaala shebbisfira zo, ma sheyyuchelu lered ulehitpashshet lematta lehitlabbesh babberuim lehachayotam; uvechinat happanim, hi hassefira atzmah hameyuchedet bemaatzilah en-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud.

Kegon derech mashal, sefirat chachma shehi meyuchedet bemaatzilah en-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud, ki hakkadosh-baruch-hu vechachmato echad (kemo shennitbaer leel), uma shemmeir umitpashshet mechachmato yitbarech lematta battachtonim, shehem baale gevul vetachlit, umitlabbesh bahem – nikra "achorayim", venikra gam ken bechinat "asiyya shebbaatzilut".

Perush, al derech mashal, kemo shebbaadam hattachton sheyyesh benishmato Adonai madregot, zo lematta mizzo, shehen bechinot hassechel vehammiddot umachashava vedibbur umaase, vehammaase – hi hattachtona shebbechullam, shehachayyut hammitpashshet mehanneshama umelubbash bechoach hammaase, hu keayin legabbe hachayyut hammitpashshet mimmenna umelubbash bechoach haddibbur, shehu keayin legabbe hachayyut hammitpashshet mimmenna umelubbash bemachashava umiddot vesechel.

Ken al derech ze mammash – hi bechinat chachmato yitbarech, ma sheyyuchal lehitpashshet mimmenna (lehashepia) [lehitlabbesh] battachtonim kullam, hem keayin legabbe bechinat panim hameyuchad bammaatzil baruch-hu, dechulla kammeh kela chashiv", vehahashpaa lechol hannivraim kullam shehem baale gevul vetachlit – nechshevet yerida vetzimtzum kivyachol legabbe hammaatzil en-sof baruch-hu, al derech mashal, kemo shennechshevet yerida vetzimtzum lesechel haadam hammaskil hametzumetzam beeze asiyya gashmiyyut vechumerit mammash.

Velachen moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom, shehissig ad achorayim dechachma, zacha shettinnaten al yado hattora, shehi "novlot chachma shellemala", perush, ma shennovel mimmenna veyored lematta umitlabbesh betora gashmiyyut shellanu, sheikkarah vetachlitah hu kiyyum hammitzvot lo taase vaase befoal umaase mammash, kammaamar: "hayyom laasotam", vegadol talmud shemmevi lide maase", vehallomed shello laasot noach lo shennehefcha shilyayto vechulei", vechol adam mucherach lehitgalgel ad sheyyekayyem kol hattaryag mitzvot befoal mammash, kannoda mehaarizal:
Haotiyyot hanniglot lanu, hen bemaase dibbur umachashava.
Demaase – hen temunat haotiyyot shebbichtav ashuri shebbesefer tora.

Veotiyyot haddibbur – nechkakot behevel vekol, hammitchallek lechv chalakim shonim ze mizze betzuratan, shehi havarat umivta hachv otiyyot bechol lashon, ki en hefresh ben leshon hakkodesh uven shear leshonot bemahut havarat haotiyyot, ki im betzerufan.
Veotiyyot hammachashava hen – gam ken bechol lashon sheadam mechashshev – tevot veotiyyot hallashon, shehen 22 levad.

Rak shebbemachashava, yesh bah 3 mine bechinot otiyyot. shehare kesheroe besefer tora temunat haotiyyot – hen mitztayyeyrot bemachashavto, veze nikra bechinat "asiyya shebbemachashava"; vechen kaasher shomea otiyyot haddibbur hen nirshamot bemachashavto umeharher bahen, veze nikra bechinat "dibbur shebbemachashava" uvechinat "yetzira"; veotiyyot hammachashava levaddah beli hirhur otiyyot haddibbur nikraot "machashava shebbemachashava", bechinat "beria".
Vehinne, otiyyot haddibbur mammash, hen mithauot umekabbelot chayyutan meotiyyot ellu atzman shebbemachashava.

Veaf shellifamim medabber adam umeharher bedavar acher – hare eno yachol ledabber, ki im otan dibburim vetzerufim shekkevar dibberam vehayu bemachashavto peamim rabbot meod, venishar bedibburim vetzerufim ellu harshimu mehammachashava shennichnesa bahem peamim rabbot.
Vezehu bechinat achorayim vechitzoniyyut netzach-hod-yesod mippartzuf haelyon shennichnas battachton, lihyot lo bechinat mochin vechayyut, kannoda:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 20: Ihu vechayyohi chad, ihu vegarmohi chad behon. (perush, eser sefirot daatzilut; chayyohi hen haorot, vegarmohi" hen hakkelim, shekkullan elokut, ma sheen ken bivria-yetzira-asiyya kulei). vetzarich lehavin hetev, ech haen-sof" chad im "garmohi" hen hakkelim, hare hakkelim hen bivchinat gevul vetachlit, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim.
Amnam, hakkavvavna hi, lomar shehen elokut livro yesh meayin kemo haen-sof", velo bivchinat hishtalshelut illa vealul levad.

Uma shekkatav haramak inyan hishtalshelut illa vealul, vechen hu bazzohar hakkadosh parashat bereshit, hayeynu, behishtalshelut hassefirot bassefirot atzman (bivchinat hakkelim), shennikraot "beli ma" besefer yetzira, sheenan bivchinat yesh umahut mussag, uchemo haen-sof" delet machashava tefisa veh kelal, uchemo shekkatuv: "ufanay lo yerau". unevuat moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom vehassagato, hayta mipperek elyon denetzach dizer anpin". uvehishtalshelut healul hu mukkaf mehailla, uvatel bimtziut etzlo keziv hashshemesh bashshemesh, kemo shekkatuv bappardes meharamak.

Veaf gam tzimtzumim rabbim meod lo yoilu lihyot geshem av keafar, mehishtalshelut haruchaniyyut missechalim nivdalim afilu shel hammalachim, ella lihyot "ruach habbehema" mippene shor", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher, veayyen sham.

Veyesh meayin" nikra "beria" bilshon hakkodesh. vahagam shehayyesh hannivra hu gam ken kela chashiv kammeh, dehayynu, shebbatel bimtziut legabbe hakkoach vehaor hashshofea bo mehakkelim dey sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya, shehakkav" or-en-sof baruch-hu meir bahem, ucheziv hashshemesh bashshemesh, kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek 2 – hayeynu "kammeh" davka, shehi yediato yitbarech milmala lematta.

Aval bidia shemmimmatta lemala – hayyesh hannivra hu davar nifrad legamre bidia vehassaga zo shemmimmatta, ki hakkoach hashshofea bo eno mussag kelal uchelal, vegam en aroch ze laze kelal uchelal, lo minneh velo miktzateh, mehaerech shemmehealul el hailla, shehealul yodea umassig eze hassaga beillato uvatel etzlo al-yede yedia vehassaga zo, vegam bemahutam veatzmutam en hefresh gadol kol kach, rak shezze illa veze alul, velo minneh velo miktzateh, mehahefresh shebben mahut hayyesh hannivra lemahut hakkoach vehaor hashshofea bo lehauoto meayin leyesh, velachen nikra "yesh" meayin" davka.

Vehinne, reshit hayyesh hannivra utechillato, hen hakkelim dey sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya, vegam haorot nefesh-ruach, venivreu mibbechinat hanneshama dey sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya shehu elokut, vehen hallamed kelim demalchut daatzilut. vechen baatzilut, mechitzoniyyut hakkelim dey sefirot daatzilut shehen elokut, nivreu hahechalot daatzilut shemmitlabbesh bahen bechinat haiggulim dey sefirot, vegam gufot hammalachim daatzilut shehen bechinat yesh, uchemo shekkatuv: "uvemalachav yasim tohola", sheenan bivchinat bittul legamre kealul legabbe illato.

Ach nishmot hammalachim sheyyatzu mizziuug hanneshikin", vechen nishmot haadam sheyyatzu mizziuug deza venukeva daatzilut kodem sheyyardu livria-yetzira-asiyya enan bichlal "yesh" vedavar nifrad bifne atzman, ella hen meen bechinat elokut betzimtzum atzum, ucheen hakkelim dey sefirot daatzilut, shehen bivchinat gevul al-yede tzimtzum or haen-sof, hu hakkav" hamelubbash benefesh-ruach-neshama shellahem, uchemo tzimtzum harishon lihyot chalal vechulei.

(Veaf gam leachar sheyyardu hannefesh-ruach-neshama daatzilut laolam hazze latztzaddikim harishonim efshar shello nishtanna mahutan lihyot davar nifrad meelokut, velachen hayu mistallekot kesheratzu lachato beterem yechetu. vekarov lomar, sheggam haalafim verivvot almin deyatvin begulegalta" daarich anpin" uzeer anpin" – enan "almin" mammash keen hahechalot daatzilut uvechinat "yesh", ella keen nishmot hammalachim sheyyatzu mizziuug hanneshikin", venikreu "almin" legabbe bechinat haggulegalta" vedikna").
Ach enan elokut mammash livro yesh meayin, meachar shekkevar yatzu venifredu mehakkelim dey sefirot, shebbahen melubbash hakkav" meor-en-sof.

Shehaor hu keen hammaor, hu mahuto veatzmuto shel hammaatzil baruch-hu, shemmetziuto hu meatzmuto, veeno alul meeze illa shekkadma lo chas veshalom, velachen hu levaddo bechocho vichalto livro yesh meayin vaefes hammuchelat mammash, beli shum illa vesibba acheret kodemet layyesh hazze.

Uchede sheyyihye hayyesh hazze hannivra bechoach haen-sof baal gevul umidda – nitlabbesh or-en-sof bechelim dey sefirot daatzilut, umityayched betochan betachlit hayyichud, ad deihu vegarmohi chad", livro bahen veal yadan beruim baale gevul vetachlit, uvifrat al-yede hitlabbeshutan bivria-yetzira-asiyya.

Amnam mudaat zot, sheikkar hithauut hayyesh vedavar nifrad legamre, hu mimmalchut daatzilut shennaasa attik divria, ki "en melech belo am vechulei". vegam ribbuy hannivraim vehitchallekutan shennivreu bechoach haen-sof" yachid umeyuchad betachlit – hu al-yede ribbuy haotiyyot hayyotzin mimmalchut, "pi Adonai", "uveruach piv kol tzevaam", vaAdonai motzaot happe hen meAdonai gevurot denukeva.

Velazot nikret "alma deitgalya", ki bah nigle koach or-en-sof livro yesh meayin shello al-yede illa vealul, aval 9 sefirot harishonot neetzlu behishtalshelut illa vealul, veor haen-sof hu melubbash bechachma levaddah. vezehu shekkatuv: "nautz techillatan besofan", ki keter hu memutztza ben hammaatzil lanneetzalim, veyesh bo bechina haacharona shel haen sof.

Velachen nikra "keter malchut", ki en keter ella lemelech, vegam, ki bechina acharona deen-sof hi malchut deen-sof, velachen gam hammalchut daatzilut nikra "keter" mimmatta lemala. uma gam, ki beriat hanneshamot – mimmenna, lihyot yesh vedavar nifrad bifne atzmah beolam habberia, venikra beshem "leda", kikriat yam-suf divattika talya". vegam, kol giddul hanneshamot kol 7 chodashim, mizziuug shel shemini atzeret ad shevii shel pesach, hu kemo giddul zeer anpin venukeva beveten "imma illaa", shehu al-yede orot elyonim meimma illaa", umilmala lemala ad en-sof, hammitlabbesh bah kol 9 o 7 yarche leda. vechacha hu bivriat neshamot umalachim leolam habberia.

Vegam, kol ikkar veshoresh hattippa shemmekabbelet umitabberet mizzeer anpin", hu mimmochin deabba veimma", uvechol ziuug nimshechet leabba veimma" mearich anpin" veattik yomin", umilmala lemala ad en sof, rak shehakkol behelem bemochin, ad ledat hannukeva hanneshamot vehammalachim vehahechalot leolam habberia. nimtza, shezzehu gilluy or-en-sof mammash, al-yede haibbur vehalleda.

Uvaze yuvan, heyot hammitzvot bemalchut – Adonai shel shem havaya, vehattora bizer anpin" – vav shel shem havaya, hagam shellemala baarich anpin" hammitzvot hen begulegalta", belavnunit", hi haurecha" divfalguta desaare", demitpalga letaryag urechin deorayyta shebbizer anpin", veshoresh hattora denafka mechachma illaa" hu bemocha setimaa" daarich anpin", vehayeynu, hachachma detaame hammitzvot, ella shehu kechotam hammithappech.

Venautz techillatan besofan", hu koach haen-sof" baruch-hu livro yesh meayin, velo al-yede illa vealul, sheyyihye healul mukkaf meillato uvatel bimtziut, rak yihye hayyesh davar nifrad meelokut, bichde sheyyihye hammaatzil baruch-hu melech al kol hannifradim, al-yede sheyyekayyeymu mitzvotav sheyyetzavve alehem, vesof maase bemachashava techilla".

Velachen amru birushalmi: "velet leh lerabbi shimon shemmafsik lelulav vechulei", vechol hallomed shello laasot noach lo shennithappecha shilyayto al panav vechulei", ki hashshilya notzra techilla mehattippa, vehi levaddah hayta ikkar havvalad ad 40 yom shehitchila tzurat havvalad. vechacha hammitzvot hen ikkar hattora vesharshah, hagam shehammitzva hi gufanit vehattora hi chachma, rak shezze bechitzoniyyut veze bifnimiyyut, uchedilkamman.

Vehinne, kemo chen mizziuug zeer anpin venukeva divria-yetzira-asiyya nivreu meayin leyesh kol hannivraim vehannotzarim vehannaasim, al-yede or hanneshama shebbetochan, shehi elokut, mehakkelim dey sefirot demalchut daatzilut, vegam betochah hearat hakkav" deor-en-sof hamelubbash baatzilut ad happarsa", vehearat hakkav" shehaya meir bakkelim dey sefirot demalchut baka happarsa" immahem, umeir bahem bivria-yetzira-asiyya kemo baatzilut mammash.

Vechen, gam hakkav" beatzmo hamelubbash besiyyum vesof netzach-hod-yesod deadam kadmon", shehu sof ragle hayyosher shello hammistayyeymim bemalchut daasiyya, hinne hearat hakkav" meira mishsham umitlabbeshet beor hanneshama dey sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya shehu elokut. veheara deheara, mitlabbeshet benefesh-ruach dey sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya, veaf gam bechol hakkelim shellahem. veheara deheara deheara, hu bechol hannivraim venotzarim venaasim, kemo shekkatuv: "hayyammim vechol asher bahem, veatta mechayye et kullam".

Vechol zot bivchinat hitpashshetut hachayyut lehachayotam. amnam, metziuto umahuto shel or haen-sof – eno begeder makom kelal, vesovev kol almin beshave, veet hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male" behashevava achat, velet atar panuy minneh" af baaretz hallezu haggashmit, rak, shehu bivchinat makkif vesovev, uchemo shennitbaer happerush belikkute amarim, velo hitpashshetut vehitlabbeshut hachayyut lehachayotam ulehauotam meayin leyesh, ki im al-yede heara deheara deheara vechulei mehakkav", kannizkar leel.

Vegam meor-en-sof hassovev umakkif learba olamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya beshave, meir el hakkav happenimi derech hakkelim dey sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya, uvehearato toch hakkelim noten bahem koach vaoz livro yesh meayin.
Umeachar shehabberia hi al-yede hakkelim, lazot hem hannivraim bivchinat ribbuy vehitchallekut ugevul vetachlit, uvifrat al-yede haotiyyot, kannizkar leel.

Veod zot, yeter al ken al kol hannizkar leel, heara deheara deheara, vechol hannizkar leel hi mara kochah vichaltah bisod heafar haggashmi begilluy atzum, beyeter oz misodot haelyonim mimmennu, vegam mitztzeva hashshamayim, sheen bechocham vichaltam lehotzi yesh meayin tamid, kisod heafar hammatzmiach tamid yesh meayin, hem asavim veilanot (vehammazzal hammakke veomer "gedal", hayeynu leachar shekkevar tzamach haesev, veeno omer lo litzmoach meayin leyesh ella mikkoten legodel, velaset peri kol min umin bifrate peratiyyut. aval beterem yitzmach lemi yomar kol mazzal umazzal lechol esev veesev bifrate peratiyyut) mehakkoach hatztzomeach shebbo, shehu ayin veruchani, vehem gashmiyyim.
Veen zot, ella mishshum deragle "adam kadmon" mistayyeymim betachtit asiyya, vetachat raglav meir or-en-sof baruch-hu hassovev kol almin, beli hefsek rav benehem, rak iggule "adam kadmon" levaddo.

Vegam hakkav" meor-en-sof hammistayyem besiyyum ragle "adam kadmon" meir mimmatta lemala bivchinat "or chozer", kemo shehamelubbash baarich anpin" veabba veimma" uzeer anpin venukeva" daatzilut – meir beor chozer mimmalchut daatzilut, umalchut daatzilut hi bechinat keter mimmatta lemala, venautz techillatan besofan".

Vechacha hu besiyyum hakkav" deor-en-sof hammistayyem besiyyum hayyosher" deragle "adam kadmon" meir mimmatta lemala livchinat or hanneshama demalchut demalchut daasiyya, shehu elokut mammash, mechitzoniyyut hakkelim demalchut daatzilut.

Ulefi ma shekkatuv besefer haggilgulim" perek 20, huva belikkute amarim – mitlabbeshet techilla heara zo shel hakkav" deor-en-sof beor haatzilut shebbaasiyya, umimmenna livria vitzira shebbaasiyya, umehen livchinat or hanneshama demalchut demalchut daasiyya, veal-yede ze yesh koach vaoz besiyyum hakkeli demalchut demalchut daasiyya shebbisod heafar, vehu maamar "tadshe haaretz vechulei", lihyot poel bekerev haaretz tamid leolam vaed –

(Bechinat en-sof, velo bilvad besheshet yeme vereshit, kemaamar "yishretzu hammayim", umaamar "totze haaretz nefesh chayya", mechachma demalchut demalchut daasiyya, shebbez yeme vereshit heir baolam hazze heara meor-en-sof bechesed chinnam", beli haalaat "mayyin nukevin" kelal) –
Lehatzemiach asavim veilanot uferot meayin leyesh tamid midde shana beshana, shehu meen bechinat "en-sof", sheim yitkayyem olam hazze ribbuy rivvot shanim – yatzmichu midde shana beshana.

Ella sheyyesh mehen al-yede haalaat "mayyin nukevin", vehem hazzeruim vehannetuim, veaf-al-pi-chen, hem kemo yesh meayin, shehaggarin hannatua en lo erech kelal legabbe happeri, vegam neged kol hailan im haanafim vehealin, vechen bemine zeronim virakot, vegam bemine tevua lehithauot meot garinin miggarin echad, hu kemo yesh meayin, umikkol shekken hakkashshin vehashshibbolim.

Vehinne, happerot sheal-yede haalaat "mayyin nukevin", hi hazzeria vehannetia – hem meshubbachim meod meod mehaolim mealehen mikkoach hatztzomeach levaddo shebbaaretz, umizze naskil hameshachot orot elyonim baatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya (shehu tachlit beriat haadam), kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

Umizze yuvan hetev beinyan seder madregot: domem, tzomeach, chay, medabber, shehen bechinot afar, mayim, esh, ruach, sheaf shehachay hu lemala mehatztzomeach, vehamedabber – lemala mehachay, af-al-pi-chen, hachay nizzon vechay mehatztzomeach, vehamedabber mekabbel chayyuto mishshenehem, vegam chachma vadaat, sheen hattinok yodea likrot 'abba veimma ad sheyyitom taam dagan kulei", vaadayin la achilna bisra detora kulei", ki hu bechinat "or chozer" mimmatta lemala, mittachtit haasiyya, shemmitgallet sham beyeter oz, heara deheara kulei meor-en-sof hassovev kol almin, umehakkav" or-en-sof shebbesiyyum "ragle hayyosher" deadam kadmon" bivchinat "or chozer", kannizkar leel.

Veyuvan hetev baze tuv taam vadaat, ma shemmalachim elyonim shebbammerkava "pene shor" ufene nesher", nehenim meod venizzonim umistappekim meruach habbehema vehaof haola alehem mehakkarbanot sheal gabbe hammizbeach, uchedikduk leshon hazzohar hakkadosh: "veithanyayn misoda veikkara dilhon".

Veachare haddevarim vehaemet haelle daat lenavon nakal lehavin, al-yede kol hannizkar leel, godel maalat hammitzvot maasiyyot, asher hen tachlit yeridat hanneshamot laolam hazze haggashmi, kemo shekkatuv: "hayyom laasotam", veyafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze mikkol chayye olam-habba":
<small>Ad kan matzanu michtav yado hakkedosha</small>
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 21: Achar derishat shelomam, kemishpat leohave shemo, el hammitnaddevim baam, laasot tzidkat Adonai im artzo hakkedosha, latet midde shana beshana chok hakkatzuv maot eretz hakkodesh, tibbane vetikkonen bimhera veyamenu, alehem tittof millati, vetizzal kattal imrati, lezarez lizrizim, ulechazzek yadayim rafot bemattan damim maot eretz yisrael midde shabbat beshabbatto, ulefachot midde chodesh bechadsho, meerko hakkatzuv leerech shana, vechol kesef hakkodashim asher ala al lev ish lehitnaddev beli neder lefarnasat achenu yoshve eretz hakkodesh, midde shana beshana.

Ki hinne, millevad hayyadua lakkol godel maalat hazzerizut bechol hammitzvot, hanneemar venishna bedivre rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "leolam yakdim adam lidvar mitzva kulei", uzerizuteh deavraham avinu alav-hashshalom hi haomedet laad, lanu ulevanenu ad olam.

Ki haakeda atzmah enah nechshava kol kach lenissayon gadol leerech maalat avraham avinu alav-hashshalom, besheggam, ki Adonai dibber bo: "kach na et bincha kulei" vahare kamma vechamma kedoshim shemmasru nafsham al kedushshat Adonai gam ki lo dibber Adonai bam. rak sheavraham avinu alav-hashshalom asa zot bizrizut niflaa, lehareot simchato vecheftzo lemallovt retzon kono velaasot nachat ruach leyotzro.

Umimmennu lamdu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lekiyyum kol hammitzvot bichlal, uvifrat maase hatztzedaka haola al kullana hammeginna umatztzela beferoteha baolam hazze mikkol mine pureaniyyot hammitraggeshot, kedichtiv: "utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet", vechol shekken mishshear mine yissurim hakkallim mimmavet kol shekken shettov lanu gam baolam hazze lehakedimah kol ma deefshar, shehare adam niddon bechol yom:

Ach gam zot matzanu rainu baavodat hatztzedaka, maala peratiyyut gedola veniflaa en aroch eleha, lihyot maase hatztzedaka naaset bifamim rabbot, vechol hammarbe – hare ze meshubbach, velo befaam achat uvevat achat, gam ki hassach hakkolel echad hu, kemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha beferush hammishna sheshshanu chachamim zichronam livracha: "vehakkol lefi rov hammaase":

Vehinne, millevad ki harambam zichrono-livracha beer hetev taamo venimmuko, kede lezakkech hannefesh al-yede ribbuy hammaase, hinne mikra male dibber hakkatuv: "peullat tzedaka lechayyim", dehayynu, sheppeullatah usegullatah lehameshich chayyim elyonim mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu leeretz hachayyim, hi "shechinat uzzenu", shealeha neemar: "veatta mechayye et kullam", vehi sukkat david hannofelet ad afar, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "galu leedom shechina immahem kulei", ki beitaruta diltatta – "lehachayot ruach shefalim" delet leh miggarmeh kelum" – itaruta dilella, uvifrat behitnaddev am lehachayot yoshve eretz hachayyim mammash, veday lammevin.

Vechol maskil al davar gadol venifla kaze yimtza tuv taam vadaat, kamma gedolim divre chachamim zichronam-livracha sheamru: "hakkol lefi rov hammaase", dehayynu maase hatztzedaka hannaase bifamim rabbot, lehameshich chayyim elyonim, leyached yichud elyon peamim rabbot.

Vehayeynu name keen ma shekkatav harambam: lezakkech hannefesh, kannoda mizzohar hakkadosh dishchina nikret "nefesh", ki hi chayyenu venafshenu, uchetiv: "ki shacha leafar nafshenu". velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "gedola tzedaka, shemmekarevet et haggeulla", lahakimah meafar meat meat, "ad ki yavo shilo":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 22: Ahuvayy, achayy vereayy!

Meahava mesutteret tochachat megulla. lechu na venivvachcha! "zichru yemot olam, binu shenot dor vador", hehayta kazot mimot olam, veayye efo metzatem minhag ze beechad mikkol sifre chachme yisrael harishonim vehaacharonim, lihyot minhag vetikkun lishol beetza gashmiyyut, kedat ma laasot beinyene haolam haggashmi, af ligdole chachme yisrael harishonim ketannaim veamoraim, asher "kol raz lo anes lehu", unehirin lehon shevilin derakia" ki im linviim mammash, asher hayu lefanim beyisrael, kishmuel haroe, asher halach elav shaul lidrosh Adonai al devar haatonot shenneevdu leaviv.

Ki beemet, kol inyene adam, levad middivre tora veyirat shamayim enam mussagim rak binvua, velo lachachamim lechem", kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "hakkol bide shamayim, chutz miyyirat shamayim", veshiva devarim mechussim kulei en adam yodea bame mistakker kulei umalchut bet david matay tachazor kulei", hinne hushevu ze laze.

Uma shekkatuv bishaya: "yoetz vachacham charashim", vechen ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "venehenin mimmennu etza vetushiyya" hayeynu bedivre tora, hannikra "tushiyya", kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "yoetz" – "ze sheyyodea leabber shanim velikboa chodashim" kulei, shessod haibbur karuy ‘etza vesod bilshon tora, kidita besanhedrin daf 87, ayyen sham beferush Rashi:

Ach haemet aggid lashshomim li, ki "ahava mekalkelet hashshura", vehinne hi kesut enayim" shello lirot haemet, merov ahavatam lechayye hagguf leshem shamayim, laavod bo et Adonai, berishpe esh veshalhevet gedola meahavat nafsham et Adonai, veal ken, hetev chara lahem betzaar hagguf chas veshalom Adonai yerachem, veen yecholin lekabbel kelal, ad shemmaaviram al datam, lechattet raglehem meir leir, lishol etzot merachok, velo shau el Adonai lashuv elav beruach nemucha vehachenaat hagguf, lekabbel tochachto beahava, "ki et asher yeehav Adonai vechulei":

Uchemo av rachaman chacham vetzaddik hammakke beno, sheen leven chacham lahafoch oref lanus, limtzo lo ezra, o afilu melitz yosher, lifne aviv harachaman vehatztzaddik vechasid, rak lihyot "yashar yechezu fanemo" im aviv panim befanim, lisbol hakkaotav beahava, letov lo kol hayyamim.

Vehinne, lemala, bechinat "panim" hu haratzon vehacheshek, asher avinu shebbashshamayim mashpia levanav kol tuv olamim vechayye nefesh veguf, beahava veratzon, chashika vachafitza, al-yede torat chayyim shehi retzono yitbarech asher natan lanu, kemo sheomrim: "ki veor panecha natatta lanu torat chayyim kulei" laasot bah retzono, veal ze neemar: "beor pene melech chayyim, uretzono kulei".
Ma-sheen-ken leovde gillulim, mashpia chayye gufam shello beratzon vachashika vachafitza, lechach nikraim "elohim acherim", sheyyonkim mibbechinat "achorayim".
Vechach hu baadam, haratzon vehacheshek hu bechinat "panim", veim eno mekabbel beahava veratzon keillu hofech oref veachor, chas veshalom.

Veetza hayyeutza lekabbel beahava, hi atzat Adonai befi chachamenu-zichronam-livracha: "lefashpesh bemaasav", veyimtza lo avonot hatztzerichin meruk yissurim, veyire laayin godel ahavato elav, hamekalkelet hashshura, kimshal melech gadol venora harochetz bichvodo uveatzmo tzoat beno yechido, merov ahavato, kemo shekkatuv: "im rachatz Adonai tzoat benot tziyyon kulei, beruach mishpat kulei".

Vechammayim happanim el panim", titorer haahava belev kol maskil umevin yekar mahut ahavat Adonai el hattachtonim, asher hi yekara vetova mikkol chayye haolamim kullam, kemo shekkatuv: "ma yakar chasdecha vechulei", "ki tov chasdecha mechayyim kulei", ki hachesed shehu bechinat ahava, hu chayye hachayyim shebbechol haolamot, kemo sheomrim: "mechalkel chayyim bechesed".

Veaz, "gam Adonai yitten hattov", veyaer panav elav, bivchinat ahava megulla, asher hayta techilla melubbeshet umesutteret betochacha megulla, veyitmatteku haggevurot besharshan, veyitbattelu haddinin netzach sela vaed:
Ahuvayy, achayy vereayy!
Miggodel tirdati asher "hikkifu alay yachad" vesabbuni chammayim, kol hayyom vechol hallayla tamid lo yecheshu", lo uchal mallet massa lemor im hassefer kol asher bilvavi.

Ach biktzara bati, kemazkir umachazir al harishonot bichlal, uvifrat el hammitnaddevim baam, laamod al haavoda zo tefilla, bekol ram, lehitchazzek meod bechol oz vetaatzumot neged kol monea mibbayit umichutz, beyad chazaka kemashmao, shehu "retzon yereav", asher lemala min hachachma vehattevuna asher natan Adonai bahemma ladaat laasot et kol asher tzivva Adonai behasekel vadaat.

Rak ratzon pashut veruach nediva", bechol ish asher yiddevennu libbo laavod avoda tamma, laasot nachat ruach leyotzro. veal ze neemar: "ki am keshe oref hu, vesalachta". ki hasselicha hi gam ken lemala min hachachma. ki "shaalu lachachma kulei", umshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom bikkesh midda keneged midda, veday lammevin.

Veod zot edrosh mimmaalatchem, shello lehashelich devaray acharechem, asher arachti siach, lihyot kol ish yashar veholech betummo, kaasher "asa haelokim et haadam yashar", velo levakkesh "cheshbonot rabbim", mealilot mitzade gaver umachshevot adam vetachbulotav". ki zo, melechet shamayim hi velo melechet basar vadam.
Ulehaamin beemuna shelema bemitzvat chachamenu-zichronam-livracha: "veheve shefal ruach bifne chol adam" bichlal, ki yatztziva milleta vetakkin pitgama, shekkol echad metukkan mechavero.

Uchetiv: "kol [ish] yisrael keish echad chaverim", kemo sheish echad mechubbar meevarim rabbim, uvehippardam nogea ballev, "ki mimmennu totzot chayyim", im ken anachnu heyot kullanu keish echad mammash – tikkon haavoda ballev, umikkelal hen kulei, veal ken neemar: "uleavdo shechem echad" davka.

Veal ken ahuvayy yedidayy, na vena litroach bechol lev vanefesh litkoa ahavat reehu belibbo, "veish et raat reehu al tachshevu bilvavchem" ketiv, velo taale al lev leolam, veim taale – yehdefenna millibbo kehindof ashan, uchemo machashevet avoda-zara mammash.

Ki gedola lashon hara keneged avoda-zara vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim. veim bedibbur kach kulei, uchevar noda lechol chacham lev yitron hechsher hammachashava al haddibbur, hen letov vehen lemutav.
VaAdonai hattov hamevarech et ammo bashshalom, yasim alechem shalom vechayyim ad haolam, kenefesh ohev nafsham millev vanefesh:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 23: Bigzerat irin pitgama umaamar kaddishin, chachme hammishna alehem-hashshalom, sheshshanu bemishnatam: "asara sheyyoshvin veoskin battora shechina sheruya venehem", "ki ze kol haadam". veaf gam zot hayta kol yeridato baolam hazze letzorech aliyya zo, asher en aliyya lemala hemenna.

Ki shechinat uzzo asher begavhe meromim, vehashshamayim usheme hashshamayim lo yechalkelu" ematah – tishkon vetitgaddel betoch bene yisrael, kemo shekkatuv: "ki ani Adonai shochen betoch bene yisrael", al-yede esek hattora vehammitzvot baasara davka, kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "atya toch toch kulei". veal ze neemar: "bekirbecha kadosh", veen davar shebbikkedushsha befachot measara".

Umishshum hache name, itzterich lehu lerabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lemelaf mikkera: "minnayin sheafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora kulei". veaf gam zot, lo matzu lo semach min hammikra ella likviat sachar bilvad, leyachid lefi erko lefi [<small>nusach achar:</small> ulefi] erech hamerubbim, aval leinyan hasheraat kedushshat hakkadosh-baruch-hu – en lo erech alehem kelal.

Vehahefresh shebben hasheraa likviut sachar muvan limvine madda, ki, keviat sachar hu – shemmeir Adonai "lenefesh tidreshennu", beor torato, shehu maate levusho mammash, velachen nikret hattora "or", shenneemar: "ote or kassalma", vehannefesh hi baalat gevul vetachlit bechol kochoteha, lachen gam or Adonai hammeir bah hu gevuli, metzumetzam, umitlabbesh betochah, veal ken yitpael lev mevakshe Adonai bishat hattefilla vechayyotze vah, ki vo yismach libbam, veyagil "af gilat verannen", vetitanneg nafsham benoam Adonai [nusach achar: al Adonai] veoro, behiggaloto mimmaate levusho shehi hattora, veyatza chabbarak chitztzo, vezo hi keviat sechar hattora, hakkevua tamid benefesh amela bah.

Aval hahashraa – hi heara atzuma meor Adonai hammeir bah beli gevul vetachlit, veeno yachol lehitlabbesh benefesh gevulit, ki im makkif aleha milmala – meroshah vead raglah, kemo sheamru chachamenu-zichronam-livracha: "akkol be asara shechinta sharya", kelomar – alehem milmala, kemo shekkatuv: "vihi noam Adonai alenu, umaase yadenu konna alenu", kelomar, ki "noam Adonai" asher hofia bemaase yadenu", beesek hattora vehammitzvot, deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad" – yitkonen veyishre alenu milmala, lihyoto beli gevul vetachlit veeno mitlabbesh benafshenu vesichlenu.

Veal ken, en anu massigim besichlenu hanneimut vehaarevut minnoam Adonai" veziv hashshechina beli gevul vetachlit, asher mitkonen veshore alenu bemaase yadenu", betora umitzvot barabbim davka. veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "sechar mitzva behay alma lekka", ki i efshar laolam lehassigo, ki im – behitpashshetut hannefesh mehagguf. veaf gam zot – al derech hachesed, kemo shekkatuv: "ulecha Adonai chased, ki atta teshallem leish kemaasehu" uchemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shehakkadosh-baruch-hu noten koach batztzaddikim kulei.

Ma-sheen-ken bammalachim kemo sheshshamati merabbotay: ki illu nimtza malach echad omed bemaamad asara miyyisrael beyachad, af sheenam medabberim bedivre tora – tippol alav emata vafachad beli gevul vetachlit, mishshechinta desharya alayyhu, ad shehaya mitbattel mimmetziuto legamre.

Veal ken, ra beenay hammaase asher naasa tachat hashshemesh" bichlal, uvifrat ben achayy vereayy hanniggashim el Adonai, "haggasha – zo tefilla" veachar hattefilla o lefaneha – naase "moshav letzim" rachamana litztzelan, kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "shenayim sheyyoshvin veen benehem divre tora kulei", veim naasa "moshav letzim" baasara, dishchinta sharya alayyhu en lecha elbona ukelana dishchinta gadol mizze rachamana-litztzelan, veim amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al haover avera basseter sheddochek ragle hashshechina" chas veshalom, haover avera barabbim – dochek kol shiur koma shel yotzer bereshit kivyachol, kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en ani vehu vechulei", ella shemmelech asur barhatim" kulei.

Aval "vavy leman dedachakin lishchinta kad yokim lah kudesha-berich-hu, veyema lah: "hitnaari meafar kumi vegomer", veal telat millin mitakkeve yisrael begaluta: al dedachakin lishchinta, veal deavdin kelana bishchinta vechulei", kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh.

Al ken, ahuvayy achayy vereayy, al na tareu haraa haggedola hazzot, utenu chavod laAdonai elohechem beterem yechshach, dehayynu, ben mincha lemaariv kol yemot hachol, lilmod baasara penimiyyut hattora, shehi aggada shebbesefer "en yaakov", sherov sodot hattora genuzin bah, umechapperet avonotav shel adam, kimvoar bechitve haarizal, vehanniglot shebbah – hen darche Adonai sheyyelech bahem haadam veyashit etzot benafsho bemille dishmayya uvemille deilma, vechayyadua lechol chachme lev.

Vegam, lilmod meat beshulechan aruch" "orach-chayyim" halachot hatztzerichot lechol adam, veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "kol hashshone halachot bechol yom kulei", shehen halachot berurot ufesukot halacha lemaase, kimvoar beferush Rashi zichrono livracha sham.

Uveshabbat kodesh baalot hammincha yaasku behilchot shabbat, ki "hilcheta rabbeta leshabbeta", uvekal – yachol haadam likkashel bah chas veshalom, afilu beissur karet usekila mechesron yedia, veshiggat talmud – ola zadon" chas veshalom, veen tzarich lomar beissure divre-sofrim, sherabbu kemo rabbu lemala, uvifrat beissure muketze dishchiche tuva, vachamurim divre-sofrim yoter middivre tora", kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shekkol haover al divre chachamim" afilu beissur kal shel divrehem, kemo haochel kodem tefillat arvit uchehay gavna – "chayyayv mita" keover al chamurot shebbattora.

Vechol yachid al yifrosh atzmo min hatztzibbur afilu lilmod inyan acher, ki im baddavar shehatztzibbur asukin bo, veen tzarich lomar shello yetze hachutza im lo yihyu asara mibbilado, vealav ani kore happasuk: "veozve Adonai yichlu kulei", kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al kol davar shebbikdushsha. ki en kedushsha kikdushshat hattora, deorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad".
Vechol happoresh min hatztzibbur kulei". veshomea li yishkon betach, uveyamav uveyamenu tivvasha yehuda, virushalayim tishkon lavetach, amen ken yehi ratzon:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 24: Ahuvayy, achayy, al na tareu. reim haahuvim leyotzram usenuim leyitzram.

Veal yaase adam atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom, asher bachar bah mikkol hayyom, lehikkahel velaamod lefanav beshaa zo, shehi et ratzon lefanav, lehitgallot, lavo el hammikdash meat", lifkod lishchinat kevodo, "hashshochen ittam betoch tumeotam", ulehimmatze ledorshav umevakshav umeyaychalav.

Vehamesapper bitzrachav – mare beatzmo sheeno chafetz lehitbonen velirot begilluy kevod malchuto, venaase merkava temea lakkesil haelyon, shenneemar alav: "lo yachpotz kesil bitvuna kulei", kemo shekkatvu hazzohar vehaari zichrono livracha, dehayynu, sheeno chafetz lehitbonen velirot bikar tiferet gedullato shel melech-malche-hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu, hanniglot lemala beshaa zo, vegam lematta – el hachafetzim lehabbit el kevodo vegadlo, hammitattef umitlabbesh betoch tevot hattefilla hassedura befi chol, umitgalle lechol echad lefi sichlo veshoresh nishmato, kedichtiv: "lefi sichlo yehullal ish" – "yehallel" ketiv.

Umalchuta derakia – keen malchuta deara", shedderech hammelech lihyot chevyon uzzo bechadre chadarim, vechamma shomrim al happetachim, (ad) asher kamma vechamma, metzappim yamim veshanim lirot uzzo uchevodo, uchesheala retzono lehitgallot lakkol, veheevir kol bechol malchuto lehikkahel velaamod lefanav, lehareotam kevod malchuto vikar tiferet gedullato, mi sheomed lefanav veeno choshesh liroto umitassek bitzrachav – kamma garua vesachol ufeti hu, venimshal kabbehemot nidme beene kol habberiyyot.

Vegam, hu bizyon hammelech, behareoto lefanav, sheeno safun beenav lekabbel nachat veshaashuim mehabbit el kevodo veyafyo, yoter meesek tzerachav. vegam, hu mitchayyev benafsho lammelech, al hareot kelono uvizyono et hammelech leen kol roe. veal ze neemar: "uchesilim merim kalon", kelomar: af shehu kesil lo yihye "merim kalon", sheyyihye nire hakkalon leen kol.

Veal ken kavu chachamenu-zichronam-livracha battefilla: "keillu omed lifne hammelech", al kol panim yihye mare beatzmo keillu omed kulei leen kol roe beene vasar el maasav vedibburav, af sheen lo machashava – lakkesil. veal ze hainyan nitkan kol hattefillot, lammitbonen bahem hetev. umi sheeno mare ken – mitchayyev benafsho. vealav amru bazzohar hakkadosh: "deanhig kelana betikkuna illaa veachaze feruda, velet leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael", rachamana litztzelan.

Al ken, shelichutayyhu derabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ka avidna, ligzor gezera shava lechol nefesh, shello lasuach sicha betela mishsheyyatchil hashsheliach tzibbur lehitpallel hattefilla ad gemar kaddish batra, shacharit arvit umincha vechulei.

Vehaover al ze bezadon – yeshev al haaretz, vivakkesh mig anashim sheyyattiru lo nidduy shellemala, "veshav verafa lo", velo chal alav shum nidduy lemafrea kol ikkar, ki mittechillato lo chal, ki im al hammordim vehapposhim sheenam choshshim kelal levakkesh kappara min hashshamayim umin habberiyyot al heavon pelili hazze.

Vegam, davka keshemmedabberim bezadon bishat nefesh, velo al hashshocheach o shennizreku mippiv kamma tevot belo mitkavven, sheeno tzarich hattara kelal. uvochen libbot uchelayot elokim tzaddik. hetiva Adonai lattovim velisharim belibbotam:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 25: Lehavin imre vina, ma shekkatuv bassefer hannikra "tzavvavat rivash", hagam shebbeemet enah tzavvavato kelal, velo tzivva kelal lifne fetirato, rak hem likkute imrotav hattehorot, shellikketu lekute batar lekute, velo yadu lechavven hallashon al matkuneto, ach hamechuvvavn – hu emet laamitto.

Vehu, behakedim maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "kol hakkoes keillu oved akkum vechulei", vehattaam muvan leyode vina, lefi shebbeet kaaso nistalleka mimmennu haemuna, ki illu haya maamin shemmeet Adonai hayta zot lo – lo haya bechaas kelal.

Veaf shebben-adam shehu baal bechira mekallelo o makkehu o mazzik mamono umitchayyev bedine adam uvedine shamayim al roa bechirato, af-al-pi-chen, al hannizzak kevar nigzar min hashshamayim, veharebe sheluchim lammakom.

Velo od, ella afilu beshaa zo mammash shemmakkehu o mekallelo – mitlabbesh bo koach Adonai veruach piv yitbarech hamechayyehu umekayyeymo, uchemo shekkatuv: "ki Adonai amar lo kallel", vehechan amar leshimi? ella shemmachashava zo shennafla leshimi belibbo umocho – yarda meet Adonai, veruach piv hamechayye kol tzevaam" hecheya rucho shel shimi beshaa sheddibber devarim ellu ledavid, ki illu nistallek ruach piv yitbarech rega echad merucho shel shimi – lo yachol ledabber meuma.
(Vezehu "ki Adonai amar lo" – baet hahi mammash – "kallel" et david, "umi yomar lo vegomer".

Vechannoda ma sheamar habbaal-shem-tov zichrono-livracha al pasuk: "leolam Adonai devarcha nitztzav bashshamayim", shetztzeruf otiyyot shennivreu bahen hashshamayim, shehu maamar "yehi rakia kulei" – hen nitztzavot veomdot melubbashot bashshamayim leolam lehachayotam ulekayyeymam.

Velo kehappilosofim shekkofrim behashegacha feratit, umedammin bedimyonam hakkozev et maase Adonai, "ose shamayim vaaretz", lemaase enosh vetachbulotav: ki, kaasher yatza latztzoref keli – shuv en hakkeli tzarich lide hatztzoref, sheaf sheyyadav mesullakot hemennu – hu kayyaym meatzmo. vetach merot enehem", hahevdel haggadol shebben maase enosh vetachbulotav shehu yesh miyyesh, rak shemmeshanne hatztzura vehattemuna, lemaase shamayim vaaretz, shehu yesh meayin –

Vehu pele gadol yoter mikkeriat yam-suf al derech mashal, asher holich Adonai beruach kadim azza kol hallayla vayyibbaku hammayim, veillu pasak haruach kerega – hayu hammayim chozrim veniggarim bemorad kedarkam vetivam velo kamu kechoma, af shetteva ze bammayim hu gam ken nivra umechuddash yesh meayin, shehare chomat avanim nitztzevet meatzmah beli ruach, rak shetteva hammayim eno chen, vechol shekken vekal vachomer bivriat yesh meayin, shehi lemala mehatteva vehafele vafele yoter mikkeriat yam-suf, al achat kamma vechamma, shebbehistallekut chas veshalom koach habbore – yesh meayin – min hannivra – yashuv hannivra leayin vaefes mammash, ella, tzarich lihyot koach happoel bannifal tamid – lehachayoto ulekayyeymo, uvechina zo hu "devar Adonai" veruach piv" shebbaasara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam.

Vaafilu eretz hallezu haggashmit uvechinat domem shebbah – chayyutan vekiyyuman hu "devar Adonai" mi maamarot hamelubbash bahen umekayyeyman lihyot domem veyesh" meayin", velo yachzeru leayin vaefes mammash keshehayu.
Vezehu sheamar haarizal, sheggam bedomem, kaavanim veafar umayim, yesh bahem bechinat nefesh vechayyut ruchaniyyit.

Vehinne, noda leyode chen, ki "devar Adonai" nikra beshem "shechina" bilshon rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, veimma tattaa" umatronita" bilshon hazzohar, uvifrat beresh parashat vaera, lefi sheshshochen umitlabbesh bannivraim lehachayotam.
Uvilshon hamekubbalim – nikra beshem "malchut", al shem "devar melech shilton", ki hammelech, manhig malchuto bedibburo, veod teamim acherim yeduim leyode chen.
Umudaat zot, ki yesh bechinat umadregat "malchut daatzilut" uvechinat "malchut divria" vechulei.

Uferush "malchut daatzilut", hu – "devar Adonai" hamechayye umehavve neshamot haggedolot shehen mibbechinat atzilut, kemo nishmat adam harishon, shenneemar bo "vayyippach beappav nishmat chayim kulei", uchemo nishmot haavot vehanneviim vechayyotze vahen (shehayu merkava laAdonai mammash, uvetelim mammash bimtziut elav, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "shechina medabberet mittoch gerono shel moshe", vechen kol hanneviim uvaale ruach hakkodesh, haya kol vedibbur haelyon mitlabbesh bekolam vedibburam mammash, kemo sheamar haarizal).
Umalchut divria" hu – "devar Adonai" hamechayye umehavve hanneshamot vehammalachim shebbeolam habberia, sheen maalatam kemaalat haatzilut vechulei.
Umalchut daasiyya" hu – "devar Adonai" hamechayye umehavve et olam hazze bichlalo, ad yesod heafar vehammayim asher mittachat laaretz.

(Ella shebbechutz laaretz – hachayyut hu al-yede hitlabbeshut sarim hachitzonim hamemunnim al 70 ummot. dehayynu, sheyyored nitzotz middevar Adonai", hannikra beshem "malchut daasiyya", umeir al hassarim shel mala bivchinat makkif milmala, ach eno mitlabbesh bahem mammash, ella nimshach lahem chayyut meheara zo shemmeir alehem milmala, bivchinat makkif.

Umehassarim – nishpa chayyut laummot, velivhemot chayyot veofot shebbeartzotehem, velaaretz haggashmit velashshamayim haggashmiyyim shehem haggalgallim (ella sheshshamayim vaaretz uvehemot vechayyot veofot tehorim – nishpaim mikkelippat noga, vehattemeim venafshot haummot – mishshear kelippot).
Vehinne, shamayim vaaretz vechol asher bahem bechutz laaretz, kullam kela mammash chashive legabbe hassarim shehem chayyutam vekiyyumam.

Vehassarim – kela mammash chashive legabbe hachayyut hannimshach lahem mehannitzotz middevar Adonai" hammeir alehem milmala. veaf-al-pi-chen, hachayyut hannimshach letocham meheara zo – hu bivchinat galut betocham, shellachen nikraim beshem "elokim acherim", vekaru leh: "elaha deelahayya", sheggam hem, hen bechinat elokut.

Velachen, haggoyim hannishpaim mehem – hem ovde avoda-zara mammash, ad et ketz, sheyyevulla hammavet vehassitra ochora, veaz ehpoch el ammim kulei likro chullam beshem Adonai". venikra gam ken beshem "galut hashshechina", meachar shechayyut ze asher bivchinat "galut" betocham, hu meheara hannimshechet lahem mehannitzotz middevar Adonai" hannikra beshem "shechina" (vegalut ze nimshach mechet etz haddaat veelach, vehu bechinat "achorayim" levad dikdushsha.

Ach kesheggalu yisrael leven haummot, vaachizat yisrael vesharsham hu bivchinat "panim" haelyonim hinne zo hi galut shelema, veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "galu leedom shechina immahem")):

Vehinne, af ki "Adonai echad ushemo echad", dehayynu, dibburo veruach piv" hamechunne bazzohar hakkadosh beshem "shemo" – hu yachid umeyuchad, af-al-pi-chen, haheara vehameshachat hachayyut hannimshechet meruach piv" yitbarech, mitchalleket led madregot shonot, shehen 4 olamot: atzilut, beria, yetzira, asiyya.

Vehashshinnuy hu mechamat tzimtzumim umasachim (rabbim), letzamtzem haor vehachayyut, ulehastiro, shello yehe meir kol kach beolam habberia kemo beolam haatzilut, uveolam hayetzira hu al yede tzimtzumim umasachim yoter vechulei. aval en shum shinnuy chas veshalom beatzmut hashshechina, shehi "devar Adonai" veruach piv".

Vegam bivchinat haheara vehameshachat hachayyut, hinne haheara shebbaatzilut – bokaat hammasach umitlabbeshet babberia, vechen mibberia litzira umitzira laasiyya, velachen, or-en-sof baruch-hu shebbaatzilut, hu gam ken baasiyya uvaolam hazze hachumeri, al-yede hitlabbeshuto bemalchut divria-yetzira-asiyya, kimvoar hakkol bechitve haari zichrono livracha:

Vehinne, nefesh haadam, yadua lakkol shehi kelula mi sefirot, chachma bina daat vechulei. veaf shekkullan meruach piv" yitbarech, kedichtiv "vayyippach beappav kulei", mikkol makom, derech perat: chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho hen dugema lechachma-bina-daat shebbey sefirot, hamechunnot beshem "abba" veimma": umiddot ahava veyira vechulei shebbenafsho – hen dugema lammiddot shebbey sefirot, hannikraot beshem "zeer anpin": vechoach haddibbur shebbenafsho – dugema laddibbur haelyon, hannikra beshem "malchut" ushechina", velachen, keshemmedabber divre tora – meorer dibbur haelyon leyached hashshechina, umishshum hache kayyma lan bikriat-shema uvirkat hammazon vedivre tora – lo yatza behirhur belo dibbur:

Vehinne, "ze leummat ze", yesh asara kitre dimsaavuta, umehen nimshachot nafshot haummot – gam ken kelulot meeser bechinot ellu mammash. umudaat zot baaretz, ma shekkatuv besefer haggilgulim" al pasuk "asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo": shehu sod galut hashshechina betoch hakkelippot, lehachayotam ulehashlitam atta bizman haggalut, aval hu "lera lo" vechulei. velachen haummot sholtin atta al yisrael, lihyot – nafshot haummot mehakkelippot asher hashshechina mitlabbeshet bivchinat galut betocham. vehinne, af shezze tzarich beur rachav ech uma, mikkol makom haemet ken hu.

Ella sheaf-al-pi-chen, en hakkelippot vehaummot yonkim umekabbelim chayyut ella meheara hannimshechet lahem mibbechinat achorayim dikdushsha, "keman deshade batar katfeh", veaf gam zot al-yede tzimtzumim umasachim rabbim vaatzumim, ad shennitlabbesha heara zo bechumeriyyut olam hazze, umashpaat laummot osher vechavod vechol taanugim gashmiyyim.
Ma-sheen-ken yisrael, yonkim mibbechinat panim haelyonim, kemo shekkatuv: "yaer Adonai panav elecha", kol echad veechad lefi shoresh nishmato ad rum hammaalot:

Veachar haddevarim vehaemet haelle haggeluyim viduim lakkol, nachazor leinyan rishon, beinyan hakkaas – shehu "keoved avoda-zara", vehayeynu – bemille dealma, ki "hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim", velachen, bemille dishmayya – leafrushe meissura lo shayyaych hay taama daamaran, uchemo shekkatuv: "vayyiktzof moshe", vehayeynu, mishshum ki Adonai hikra lefanav mitzva zo, leafrushe meissura, kede lezakkoto:

Ach zehu kesheyyesh beyado limchot bekitzpo vechaaso al chavero, aval kesheen beyado limchot, kegon nachri hamedabber umevalbelo bitfillato, im ken ma zot asa Adonai lo, en zot, ki im – kede sheyyitgabber veyitammetz yoter bitfillato, beomek hallev uvechavvavna gedola kol kach, ad shello yishma dibbure hannachri.
Ach, shellemadrega zo tzarich hitorrut rabba vaatzuma.

Veetza hayyeutza lehitorrut zo, hi meinyan ze atzmo, kesheyyasim el libbo veyitbonen inyan yeridat hashshechina kivyachol, "vattered pelaim", lehitlabbesh nitzotz mehearatah, asher hi bivchinat galut betoch hakkelippot derech kelal lehachayotam, veatta happaam, nitzotz hearatah mitlabbesh bivchinat galut derech perat, bedibbur nachri ze, hamedabber devarim hamevalbelim avodat Adonai, hi kavvavnat hattefilla, uchemo shennitbaer leel, ki "ze leummat ze vechulei", vedibbur haelyon mitlabbesh baddibbur hattachton vechulei, vezehu mammash "asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo", dehayynu, sheal yede ze mitorer haadam lehitpallel yoter bechavvavna meumeka delibba, ad shello yishma dibburav.

Uma shekkatav hamelakket "sharta" – lo yada lechavven hallashon bedikduk, ki habbaal-shem-tov zichrono livracha haya omer divre tora bilshon idish velo bilshon hakkodesh, veratza lomar "nitlabbesha", vehayeynu bivchinat galut. vezehu "uvifrat im hu nachri kulei". sheaz hi bechinat galut beyoter.

Veen litmoah im nitzotz min hearat shechina nikra beshem "shechina", deha ashkechan, sheafilu malach nivra, nikra beshem Adonai befarashat vayyera leferush haramban, uchemo shekkatuv: "vattikra shem Adonai haddover eleha vechulei", uchehay gavna tuva.

Vechimdumme li, shettefisatam enah mitztzad dikduk hallashon, ella meikkar inyan hitlabbeshut hashshechina bakkelippot, sheen lahem emuna bema sheamar haarizal besefer haggilgulim", sheim yirtzu lechallek ben kelippot haruchaniyyim leovde gillulim haggashmiyyim en lecha gashmi kaafar haaretz, veaf-al-pi-chen mitlabbeshet bo malchut demalchut daasiyya uvetochah malchut ditzira kulei, vechannizkar leel. veim mishshum tumeat nafshot hannachrim, hare nafshotehem mizziuug zeer anpin venukeva diklippot haruchaniyyim, kemo shekkatuv bechitve haarizal. nimtza sheharuchaniyyim mekor tumeatam.

Ach beemet, tzarich beur rachav, ech hu hitlabbeshut zo? aval, lo alenu telunatam ki im al kitve haarizal. veal yachshedeni shomea, sheani beenay shehevanti divre haarizal lehafeshitan miggashmiyyutan ki lo bati rak lefaresh divre habbaal-shem-tov zichrono livracha vetalmidav al pi kabbalat haarizal. besheggam, sheinyan ze eno mechachmat hakkabbala umehannistarot laAdonai elokenu", ki im – mehanniglot lanu ulevanenu", lehaamin emuna shelema bemikra male sheddibber hakkatuv: "halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male, neum Adonai", sheen mikra yotze mide feshuto.

Vegam, hi emuna peshuta bistam kelalut yisrael, umesura beyadam meavotehem hakkedoshim shehalchu bitmimut im Adonai, beli lachkor besechel enoshi inyan haelokut, asher hu lemala mehassechel ad en ketz, leda ech hu male chol haaretz.

Rak, shechadashim mikkarov bau lachkor bachakira zo, vei efshar lekarev lahem el hassechel, ella davka al pi hakedamot lekuchot mikkitve arizal, mufeshatot miggashmiyyutan, uchefi sheshshamati merabbotay nishmatam eden. ach i efshar levaer ze hetev bemichtav, ki im, mippe leozen shomaat, lichide segulla velasseridim asher Adonai kore, kedichtiv: "umevakshe havaya yavinu chol", umikkelal hen atta shomea kulei".

Hinne, attem reitem perush maamar echad missefarim hayeduim, ledugema uleot, ki gam kol hammaamarim hattemuhim yesh lahem perush uveur hetev leyode chen. ach lo yekauu maalatam elay levaer lahem hakkol bemichtav, ki hi melacha keveda umerubba, vei efshar beshum ofen. rak, im tirtzu, shillechu mikkem echad umeyuchad shebbaeda, ufe el pe adabber bo" im yirtze Adonai. vaAdonai yihye im pi behattifi. veyihyu leratzon imre fi":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 26: Beraya mehemna parashat naso: "vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia" – "behay chibbura dilach deihu sefer hazzohar, min zohora deimma illaa" teshuva, beillen lo tzarich nissayon. uvegin daatidin yisrael lemitam meilana dechayye, deihu hay sefer hazzohar – yippekun beh min galuta berachamim, veyitkayyem behon: "Adonai badad yanchennu, veen immo el nechar".

Veilana detov vara deihu issur vehetter tumea vetohora – lo yishletu al yisrael yattir, deha, parnasa dilhon la leheve ella – missitra deilana dechayye, delet tamman lo kashya missitra dera velo machaloket meruach hattumea, dichtiv: "veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz" – dela yitparnesun talmide chachamim meamme haaretz, ella, missitra detov – deachlin tohora, kasher, hetter, vela meerev rav" deachlin tumea, pasul, asur kulei, uvezimna deilana detov vara shalta kulei, inun chachamim dedamyayn leshabbatot veyamim tovim, let lehon, ella ma deyahavin lehon innun "chullin", kegavvna deyom hashshabbat, delet leh ella ma dimtakkenin leh beyoma dechol.

Uvezimna deshalta ilana dechayye – itkafyay ilana detov vara, vela yehe leamme haaretz, ella ma deyahavin lehon talmide chachamim, veitkafyayn techotayyhu, keillu la havu bealma. vehache: issur, hetter, tumea vetohora – lo itabber meamme haaretz, demissitrayyhu, let ben galuta limot hammashiach – ella shibud malchuyyot bilvad, deinun – lo taame meilana dechayye, vetzarich lon matnitin beissur vehetter tumea vetohora". ad kan beraya mehemna:

Vehinne, hammuvan mehashekafa rishona lichora milleshon ze hammaamar lachasere madda, shellimmud issur vehetter veseder teharot hu meilana detov vara. millevad shehu pele gadol mechamat atzmo, vesoter peshate hakketuvim umidreshe rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, shekkol hattora hanniglet lanu ulevanenu nikra "etz chayyim lammachazikim bah", velo sefer hazzohar levad, uvifrat – shehaya ganuz bimehem, vegam, kol chachmat hakkabbala hayta nistara bimehem venelama mikkol talmide chachamim, ki im lichide segulla veaf gam zot behatzenea lechet velo barabbim, kidita baggemara.

Uchemo sheamar haarizal, dedavka bedorot ellu haacharonim, muttar umitzva legallot zot hachachma – velo baddorot harishonim, vegam rabbi shimon ben yochai amar bazzohar hakkadosh, shello nittan reshut legallot, rak lo velachaverav levaddam.

Veaf gam zot – pelia nisgava: dilfi ze lo haya limmud issur vehetter, vechol shekken dine mamonot, dochin mitzvat tefilla – shennitkena al pi sodot hazzohar veyichudim elyonim, layyodim – kerabbi shimon ben yochai vachaverav, veze eno, kidita baggemara: derabbi shimon ben yochai vachaverav vechol mi shettorato ummanuto – en mafsikin litfilla.
Vaafilu kesheosek bedine mamonot, kerav yehuda – dechullehu tannuye binzikin have", vaafilu hache, "la have matzlle ella mittelatin yomin litlatin yomin kad mehaddar talmuda", kidita baggemara.

Uvirushalmi perek kamma divrachot, sevira leh lerabbi shimon ben yochai, daafilu likriat-shema, en mafsikin ki im mimmikra, velo mimmishna, daadife mimmikra lerabbi shimon ben yochai, velo chillek ben seder zeraim umoed vekadashim teharot linzikin (vesoter daat atzmo beraya mehemna bechamma mekomot, demishna ihi shifcha kulei", vehammikra shehu torat moshe vadday adifa mikkabbala, deihi "matronita" beraya mehemna sham, vetora shebbichtav hu "malka" (dehayynu "yesod abba" hamelubbash bizer anpin", kemo sheamar haarizal)).

Vegam, pilpul hakkusheyot veterutzim, demissitra dera veruach hattumea, ashkechan berabbi shimon ben yochai, deasak beh tuva gam bihyoto bammeara, veadderabba bizchut tzaar hammeara zacha laze, kidita baggemara, deamar lerabbi pinchas ben yair akkol kusheya 24 peruke, veamar lo: "illu lo reitani bechach kulei" (vegam beemet, al karchacha, ikkar iskehem bammeara haya torat hammishnayot, tr sidre shehaya bimehem ad rabbenu hakkadosh, deillu sefer hazzohar vehattikkunim – haya yachol ligmor bev veg chodashim, ki bevadday lo amar davar echad 2 peamim).
Gam, amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, en lo lehakkadosh-baruch-hu ella 4 ammot shel halacha bilvad".

Veod yesh lehafeli, hafele vafele – ech efshar shellimot hammashiach lo yitztarchu leda hilchot issur vehetter vetumea vetohora, ki ech yishchatu hakkarbanot vegam chullin, im lo yedu hilchot derasa vachalada ushehiyya happoslim hashshechita, ufegimat hassakkin, vechi yivvaled ish betivo sheyyehe shochet beli shehiyya uderasa? vegam hassakkin tihye beria veomedet beli pegima leolam?

Veod harebe hilchot chelev vedam ushear issurin, vegam tumeat hammet yihyu tzerichin leda, kedichtiv: "hannaar ben mea shana yamut", vegam tumeat yoledet tzarich leda, kedichtiv: "hara veyoledet yachdav". im teled ishsha bechol yom mibbia achat, af-al-pi-chen – din issur tumeatah lo yishtanne.
