Veen lehaarich bedavar happashut umefuresam hefko bechol hashshas umidrashim, defarich "hilcheta limshicha?", veeliyyahu ba lifshot kol hassefekot, ufarasha zo atid eliyyahu ledorshah" kulei:

Veod eno muvan, ma shekkatuv: "dela yitparnesun talmide chachamim meamme haaretz kulei vela meerev rav" deachlin pasul tame veasur" chas veshalom, deha gam bizman bayit sheni lo hayu mitparnesin meamme haaretz deachlin pasul asur chas veshalom, shehare talmide chachamim hayu lahem sadot ucheramim keamme haaretz, vaafilu hache – hayu oskin belimmud issur vehetter vetumea vetohora kol hazzugot shehayu bime bayit sheni, veheemidu talmidim laalafim urevavot, velimmud hannistar behester kulei:

Ach beemet, keshettedakdek bilshon raya mehemna dilel, "veilana detov vara deihu issur vehetter kulei", velo amar "torat issur vehetter" o "hilchot issur vehetter", ella rotze lomar, deguf davar haasur vedavar hammuttar – hu meilana detov vara, shehu kelippat noga, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim.

Vezehu leshon "asur", shehakkelippa shora alav veeno yachol laalot lemala kedavar hammuttar", dehayynu – sheeno kashur veasur biklippa, veyuchal laalot al-yede haadam haochlo bechavvavna laAdonai, vegam bistam, kol adam haoved Adonai shebbechoach haachila hahi lomed umitpallel laAdonai, venimtza shennaasa otiyyot hattora vehattefilla haola laAdonai – mikkoach hannivrar mehammaachol hahu.

Vezehu bechol, aval beshabbat sheyyesh aliyya liklippat noga beatzmah im hachitzoniyyut shebbechol haolamot, lachen, mitzva leechol kol taanugim beshabbat uleharbot bevasar veyayin, af shebbechol nikra zolel vesove.

Ma-sheen-ken bidvar issur, sheeno yachol laalot lo beshabbat velo bechol, gam keshemmitpallel velomed bakkoach hahu, im lo sheachal lefikkuach nefesh shehittiru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha venaasa hetter [gamur].

Aval hallimmud battora, af hilchot issur vehetter tumea vetohora, shehem hammishnayot uvarayytot shebbaggemara ufoskim, hamevaarim umevarrim divrehem lahalacha lemaase, hen hen gufe tora shebbeal-pe, shehi sefirat malchut daatzilut, kidita bazzohar hakkadosh bimkomot en mispar, uveresh tikkunim: "malchut – pe, tora shebbeal pe karinan lah", uvaatzilut – "ihu vegarmohi chad behon", dehayynu, sheor-en-sof baruch-hu mityayched baatzilut betachlit hayyichud, shehu uretzono vechachmato hamelubbashim bedibburo shennikra "malchut" – hakkol echad:

Uma sheamar haarizal shehammishnayot hen bemalchut ditzira, rotze lomar: levush malchut ditzira shennitlabbesha bah malchut daatzilut, umalchut ditzira nikra "shifcha" legabbe malchut daatzilut, umalchut divria nikra "ama".

Veteda: mimma sheamar haarizal demikra, dehayynu tora shebbichtav – hu baasiyya, vahare meforash bazzohar uvechitve haarizal mekomot en mispar – shehi tiferet, shehu "zeer anpin" daatzilut – ella shemmitlabbeshet baasiyya. vechen hu behedya besefer hakkavvavnot, shemmikra umishna vetalmud vekabbala – kullam baatzilut, ella, shemmikra – mitlabbesh ad asiyya, umishna – ad hayetzira, vetalmud – bivria.

Vehinne, keshehammalchut daatzilut mitlabbeshet biklippat noga, kede levarer hannitzotzot shennaflu bechet adam harishon vegam harappach nitzotzin shennaflu bishvirat hakkelim, azay, gam hammalchut daatzilut nikra beshem "etz haddaat tov vara" legabbe "zeer anpin" daatzilut, sheeno yored sham, venikra "etz chayyim".

Vehinne, hitlabbeshut hammalchut biklippat noga hu sod galut hashshechina – "asher shalat haadam beadam kulei". vezehu shekkatuv beraya mehemna: "uvezimna deilana detov vara shalta kulei innun kulei", dehayynu, bizman galut hashshechina shemmashpaat lachitzonim shehem biklippat noga, shehaerev rav" yonkim mishsham, umittamtzitan nizzonin talmide chachamim baggalut, veaz, ikkar avodat haadam veikkar esek hattora vehammitzvot – hu levarer hannitzotzot kannoda mehaarizal.

Lachen, ikkar inyan hallimmud hu beiyyun ufilpul halacha, beissur vehetter tumea vetohora, levarer hammuttar vehattahor mehaasur vehattame – al-yede iyyun ufilpul halacha bechachma bina vadaat, kannoda deorayyta mechachma nafkat", uvechachma dayyka itberiru, vehayeynu chachma illaa daatzilut, hamelubbeshet bemalchut daatzilut, sod tora shebbeal-pe (besod "abba yasad beratta"), hamelubbeshet bemalchut ditzira, (vesod) [sod] hammishnayot uvarayytot hamelubbashot biklippat noga shekkeneged olam hayetzira, sheshsham matchil bechinat haddaat [<small>nusach achar:</small> hara] shebbenoga [<small>nusach achar:</small> vehabbarayytot, hamelubbashot biklippat noga shekkeneged olam haasiyya, sheshsham matchil bechinat hara shebbenoga], kannoda mehaarizal.

Vehammaskil yavin inyan pele gadol mizze meod, ma naase bashshamayim mimmaal al-yede iyyun uverur halacha pesuka min haggemara ufoskim rishonim veacharonim, ma shehaya behelem davar kodem haiyyun hallaz, ki al-yede ze maale halacha zo mehakkelippot shehayu maalimim umechassim otah, shello hayta yedua kelal, o shello hayta muvenet hetev betaamah, shehattaam hu sod hassefira chachma illaa, shennaflu mimmenna nitzotzin bakkelippot bishvirat hakkelim, vehem sham bivchinat galut, shehakkelippot sholtim alehem umaalimim chachmat hattora meelyonim vetachtonim. vezehu shekkatuv beraya mehemna, shehakkusheya hi missitra dera.

Vehinne, haelyonim en bahem koach levarer ulehaalot mehashshevira shebbiklippat noga, ella hattachtonim levad, lefi shehem melubbashim beguf chumeri "mashka dechivya" mikkelippat noga, vehem mattishim kochah bishvirat hattaavot, veitkafya sitra ochora, veyitpardu kol poale aven". velachen baim haelyonim lishmoa chiddushe tora mehattachtonim, ma shemmechaddeshim umegallim taalumot hachachma shehayu kevushim baggola ad atta.

Vechol ish yisrael yuchal legallot taalumot chachma (legallot) ulechaddesh sechel chadash, hen bahalachot, hen beaggadot, hen bannigle, hen bannistar, kefi bechinat shoresh nishmato, umechuyyayv baddavar, lehashelim nishmato behaalaat kol hannitzotzot shennaflu lechelkah ulegoralah, kannoda.

(Vechol divre tora, uvifrat devar halacha, hi nitzotz mehashshechina, shehi hi devar Adonai, kidita baggemara: "devar Adonai zo halacha", sod malchut daatzilut hammalbeshet lechachma daatzilut, umelubbashim bemalchut ditzira, veyardu biklippat noga bishvirat hakkelim).
Vezehu sheamru baggemara: "kol haosek battora, amar hakkadosh-baruch-hu: maale ani alav keillu pedaani veet banay mibben haummot haolam".

Aval betzet hashshechina mikkelippat noga [nusach achar: mehakkelippot] achar sheyyushelam berur hannitzotzot, veyuferad hara mehattov veyitpardu kol poale aven", vela shalta ilana detov vara betzet hattov mimmenna, azay – lo yihye esek hattora vehammitzvot levarer berurin, ki im – leyached yichudim elyonim yoter, lehameshich orot elyonim yoter mehaatzilut, kemo sheamar haari zichrono livracha.
Vehakkol – al-yede penimiyyut hattora, lekayyem hammitzvot bechavvavnot elyonot shemmechavvenot leorot elyonim kulei. ki shoresh hammitzvot hu lemala mala been-sof baruch-hu.
(Uma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha demitzvot betelot leatid lavo", hayeynu, bitchiyyayt hammetim, aval limot hammashiach, kodem techiyyayt hammetim – en betelim).

Velachen yihye gam ikkar esek hattora gam ken bifnimiyyut hammitzvot vetaamehem hannistarim. aval hanniglot yihyu geluyim viduim lechol ish yisrael bidia battechilla beli shichcha, veen tzerichim laasok bahem, ella leerev rav" shello yizku lemitam meilana dechayye, shehu penimiyyut hattora vehammitzva, utzerichim laasok [battora] bammishna, lehattish koach hassitra ochora haddavuk bahem (al yede esek hattora. bichtav yad leta), shello tishlot bahem lehachatiam, kedichtiv: "vehachote ben mea shana yekullal", sheyyihyu chotim meerev rav".

Vegam lemaase, yihyu tzerichim lifrate hilchot issur vetumea yoter miyyisrael, shello yeera lahem pesul vetumea veissur, ki "lo yeunne kulei". vegam, efshar vekarov haddavar sheyyedu mippenimiyyut hattora kol gufe hattora hanniglet, kemo avraham avinu alav-hashshalom, velachen, en tzerichim laasok bahem kelal.

Ma-sheen-ken bizman bayit sheni, hayu tzerichim laasok – gam ki lo bishvil halacha lemaase bilvad, ella shezzehu ikkar avoda lehattish koach hassitra ochora, ulehaalot nitzotze hakkedushsha al-yede hattora vehaavoda, kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

Veachar haddevarim vehaemet, yuvan hetev betosefet beur haraya mehemna dilel, bema sheamar "ilana detov vara kulei", rotze lomar – kelippat noga, shehu olam hazze haikkar, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim, veday lammevin:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 27: <small>Ma shekkatav leyoshve eretz hakkodesh tibbane vetikkonen bimhera veyamenu amen lenachamam bechiflayim letushiyya, al petirat harav haggaon hamefuresam ish elokim kadosh, ner yisrael, ammud hayemani pattish hechazak, morenu harav verabbenu rabbi menachem mendel nishmato eden.</small>
Ahuvayy achayy vereayy asher kenafshi kulei, Adonai alehem yichyu chayyim ad haolam, vetzeetzaehem ittam zera emet beruche Adonai hemma meatta vead olam.

Achare derishat shelomam kemishpat leohave shemo, bati ledabber al lev nidkaim hanneenachim vehanneenakim, ulenachamam bechiflayim letushiyya, asher shama azni vattaven lah, al maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha "deshavak chayyim lechol chay".

Ki "tzaddik beemunato yichye", uveyirat Adonai lechayyim", uverishfe esh shalhevet ahavato mechayyim, lechol bahen chayye rucho [<small>nusach achar:</small> venishmato] kol yeme cheldo, vayhi behaalot Adonai rucho, venishmato elav yeesof, veyaale beilluy achar illuy ad rum hammaalot – shavak chayye rucho, "peullato asher avad bah" lefanim beyisrael, peullat tzaddik lechayyim lechol chay, hi nefesh kol chay hakkeshura benafsho bechavle avotot ahava rabba veahavat olam, bal timmot lanetzach, asher "mi haish hechafetz chayyim", ledavka baAdonai chayyim – baavodato tidbak nafsho, vehayta tzerura bitzror hachayyim et Adonai, bechayye ruach appenu asher amarnu betzillo nichye vaggoyim.

Asher shavak lanu, bechol echad veechad kefi bechinat hitkashsheruto beemet, veahavato ahavat emet hattehora, "mikkerev ish velev amok", ki "kammayim happanim vechulei", veruach ayyti ruach veamshich ruach", verucho omedet bekirbenu mammash, ki biroto yeladav maase yadav bekirbo yakdishu shemo yitbarech, asher yitgaddel veyitkaddesh, kaasher nelech bederech yeshara asher horanu midderachav, venelcha beorchotav netzach sela vaed.

Vezehu shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh detzaddika deitpattar ishtakkach bechullehu almin yattir mibbechayyohi", dehayynu, sheggam beze haolam hammaase – "hayyom laasotam" – ishtakkach yattir: ki hammaase (gadol) [gadel] veholech, giddule giddulin, min "or zarua latztzaddik" bassade asher bercho Adonai", hammeir laaretz vechutzot, vegam anachnu elle fo hayyom kullanu chayyim bidrachav – "derech hakkodesh yikkare lah". zot baavodat Adonai bemille dishmayya.

Uvemille dealma – beferush ittemar bazzohar hakkadosh, detzaddikayyay meginnin al alma uvemitathon yattir mibbechayyehon, veilmale tzelota detzaddikayyay behahu alma – la itkayyem alma riga chada". vechol hakkarov karov el mishkan Adonai bechayyav kodem livracha:
Bayor al hannizkar leel

Ita bazzohar hakkadosh, detzaddika deitpattar ishtakkach bechullehu almin yattir mibbechayyohi kulei". vetzarich lehavin, tenach beolamot elyonim – ishtakkach yattir baaloto shamma, aval baolam hazze ech ishtakkach yattir?
Veyesh lomar, al derech ma shekkibbalti al maamar chachamenu-zichronam-livracha "deshavak chayyim lechol chay".

Kannoda, shechayye hatztzaddik enam chayyim besarim ki im chayyim ruchaniyyim, shehem emuna veyira veahava, ki beemuna ketiv: "vetzaddik beemunato yichye", uveyira ketiv: "veyirat Adonai lechayyim", uveahava ketiv: "rodef tzedaka vachesed yimtza chayyim", vechesed hu ahava.
Ushelosha middot ellu hem bechol olam veolam ad rum hammaalot, hakkol lefi erech bechinat maalot haolamot ze al ze bederech illa vealul, kannoda.

Vehinne, bihyot hatztzaddik chay al pene haadama, hayu shelosha middot ellu betoch keli ulevush shellahem bivchinat makom gashmi, shehi bechinat nefesh hakkeshura begufo, vechol talmidav enam mekabbelim rak hearat middot ellu vezivan, hammeir chutz lichli ze al-yede dibburav umachshevotav hakkedoshim, velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheen adam omed al daat rabbo vechulei.

Aval leachar petirato, lefi shemmitpardim bechinat hannefesh shennishara bakkever mibbechinat haruach shebbegan eden, shehen shalosh middot hallalu, lefichach yachol kol hakkarov elav lekabbel chelek mibbechinat rucho shebbegan eden, hoil veenah betoch keli velo bivchinat makom gashmi, kannoda maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al yaakov avinu alav-hashshalom shennichnas immo gan eden, vechen katav besefer asara maamarot, sheavir gan eden mitpashshet saviv kol adam, venirshamim baavir ze kol machshevotav vedibburav hattovim battora vaavodat Adonai (vechen lehefech chas veshalom nirshamim baavir hammitpashshet miggehinnom saviv kol adam).

Hilkach, nakel meod letalmidav, lekabbel chelkam mibbechinat ruach rabbam haatzmiyyit, shehem emunato veyirato veahavato asher avad bahem et Adonai, velo zivavm bilvad hammeir chutz lakkeli, lefi shebbechinat rucho haatzmit mitalla beilluy achar illuy, lehikkalel bivchinat nishmato shebbegan eden haelyon shebbaolamot haelyonim.

Venoda, shekkol davar shebbikdushsha eno nekar legamre mikkol vachol mimmekomo umadregato harishona, gam leachar shennitalla lemala lemala. uvechina zo harishona shennishara lematta began eden hattachton bimkomo umadregato harishona, hi hammitpashshetet betalmidav, kol echad kefi bechinat hitkashsheruto vekirvato elav bechayyav uvemoto beahava rabba, ki, hameshachat kol ruchaniyyut, enah ella al-yede ahava rabba, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh deruach diruta delibba amshich ruach milleela, rak im yikkon likrat elohav bahachana rabba vigia atzuma, lekabbel shalosh middot hallalu, kederech shehorahu rabbo, uchemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "yagata umatzata – taamin".

Vehinne, yesh od bechinat heara letalmidav, rak sheenah mitlabbeshet betoch mocham mammash karishona, rak meira alehem milmala, vehi mealiyyayt rucho venishmato limkor chutzebo, dehayynu lachakal tappuchin kaddishin", veal-yede ze naase sham yichud, al-yede haalaat "mayyin nukevin" mikkol maasav vetorato vaavodato asher avad kol yeme chayyav, venizreu bachakal tappuchin kaddishin" orot elyonim meod, leummat tachtonim, asher hem torato vaavodato.

Vehearat orot elyonim ellu meira al kol talmidav, shennaasu ovde Adonai al-yede torato vaavodato. veheara zo shealehem milmala, machneset belibbam hirhure teshuva umaasim tovim, vechol hammaasim tovim hannoladim meheara zo shemmeira meorot hazzeruim bassade hannizkar leel – nikra "giddule giddulin".

Veheara zo hi behelem vehester gadol, kemo shemesh hammeir lakkochavim mittachat laaretz, kidita battikkunim al moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom, sheachar petirato mitpashshetet hearato bechol dara vedara leshishshim ribbo neshamot, kemo shemesh hammeir mittachat laaretz leshishshim ribbo kochavim:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 28: Ma shekkatav limchuttano, harav haggaon hamefuresam, ish elokim kedosh Adonai, ner yisrael, ammud hayemani, pattish hechazak, morenu verabbenu harav levi yitzchak nishmato eden, av bet-din dikhillat kodesh barditshov, lenachamo al petirat beno harav hechasid, morenu verabbenu harav meir nishmato eden:
Lamma nismecha parashat miryam lefarashat para, lomar lecha: ma para mechapperet vechulei.

Vetzarich lehavin, lamma nismecha davka lefara adumma hannaase chutz leshalosh machanot, ella dechattat karyeh rachamana [<small>bichtav yad hanevasechaa:</small> 'hannaase bachutz. <small>umin tevat "leshalosh" ad tevat "rachamana" leta bichtav yad</small>] velo nismecha lefarashat chattat hannaase bifnim al gabbe hammizbeach – kappara mammash.

Amnam, noda mizzohar hakkadosh vehaarizal, sod hakkarbanot sheal gabbe hammizbeach – hen bechinat haalaat "mayyin nukevin" minnefesh habbahamit shebbenoga, el sharshan umekoran – hen bechinot 4 chayyot shebbammerkava hannosot et hakkisse, pene shor ufene nesher vechulei, veal-yede ze nimshachim veyordim "mayyin ducherin" mibbechinat "adam" sheal hakkisse, hannikra beshem "malka" uzeer anpin".

Achen, bisrefat happara adumma, hinne al-yede hashelachat etz erez veezov vechulei unetinat mayim chayyim el haefer – nikra beshem "kiddush me chattat" bammishna, vehi bechinat "kodesh haelyon", hannikra beshem "talla divdulecha", kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh, shehi bechinat "chachma illaa" umocha setimaa" daarich anpin", vaalah itmar beduchete tuva bazzohar hakkadosh: "bechachma itberiru", veithappecha chashocha linhora", dehayynu olam hattikkun, shennitbarer venittakken al-yede "mocha setimaa" daarich anpin", meolam hattohu ushevirat hakkelim, shennaflu bivria-yetzira-asiyya vechulei, kannoda. velazot – metaheret tumeat hammet, af shehu avi avot vechulei, ulematta matta minnoga:

Vehinne, mudaat zot, deabba" yonek mimmazzal hashshemini hu tikkun "notzer chesed", "notzer" otiyyot "ratzon", vehi et ratzon hammitgalle umeir bivchinat gilluy milmala lematta, beet petirat tzaddike elyon, ovde Adonai beahava, bimsirat nafsham laAdonai bechayyehem arvit veshacharit bikriat-shema, sheal-yede ze hayu maalim "mayyin nukevin" leabba" veimma" bikriat-shema, kayyadua. (vechen betalmud tora demechachma nafka), veal-yede ze hayu nimshachim veyordim bechinat "mayyin ducherin" mittikkun "venotzer chesed", vehem hem hammeirim bivchinat gilluy biftiratam, kannoda – shekkol amal haadam sheamla nafsho bechayyav lemala bivchinat helem vehester, mitgalle umeir bivchinat gilluy milmala lematta beet petiratv.

Vehinne, al-yede gilluy hearat tikkun "venotzer chesed" biftiratan, meir "chesed Adonai meolam ad olam al yereav", ufoel yeshuot bekerev haaretz", lechapper al avon haddor, af gam al hazzedonot shehen mig kelippot hattemeot shellematta minnoga, lefi shemmazzal denotzer" mimmocha setimaa" daarich anpin" mekor habberurim, veithappecha chashocha dishvirat hakkelim linhora deolam hattikkun.
Ma-sheen-ken bakkarbanot sheal gabbe hammizbeach, sheenan mechapperim ella al hashshegagot, shehen mehitgabberut nefesh habbahamit shemminnoga, kemo shekkatuv belikkute tora" parashat vayyikra.
Velachen nismecha lefarashat para davka – "ma para vechulei". uveyalkut parashat shemini haggirsa "me chattat vechulei":
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 29: Eshet chayil ateret balah kulei.

Ita baggemara perek 4 dimgilla: "udeishtammesh betagga cholaf kulei" – "ze hammishtammesh bemi sheshshone halachot, kitrah shel tora kulei", "tana deve eliyyahu, kol hashshone halachot muvetach lo kulei".

Vetzarich lehavin, lamma nikreu hahalachot beshem "tagga" vechitrah shel tora"? vegam, lamma "hashshone halachot" davka "muvetach lo kulei", velo shear divre tora? vechen lehavin maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha beferek 11 dimnachot: "afilu lo shana adam ella perek echad shacharit kulei" yatza yede chovato, velamma eno yotze yede chovato bishar divre tora?

Ach mudaat zot, ma sheamar haarizal, shekkol adam miyyisrael tzarich lavo begilgulim rabbim ad sheyyekayyem kol taryag mitzvot hattora bemachashava dibbur umaase, lehashelim levushe nafsho uletakkenam shello yehe levusha dechasra kulei, levad mitzvot hatteluyot bammelech, shehu motzi kol yisrael, ki hu kelalut kullam kulei, vehattaam hu – kede lehalebish kol taryag bechinot vechochot shebbenafsho, achat mehenna lo nedara kulei.

Uveur inyan hechrach vetzorech levushim ellu, mevoar bazzohar, umuvan lechol maskil, ki lihyot shennefesh ruach uneshama shebbeadam hen bechinot nivraim, vei efshar leshum nivra lehassig shum hassaga bevore veyotzer hakkol, en-sof baruch-hu.

Vegam achare asher heir Adonai meoro yitbarech veheetzil bivchinat hishtalshelut madregot rabbot, madrega achar madrega, bivchinat tzimtzumim atzumim ulevushim rabbim vaatzumim hayeduim leyode chen, venikraim beidra rabba beshem "searot", uchedichtiv bedaniyyel: "usear resheh kaamar neke kulei", af-al-pi-chen, lo yachla hannefesh, o haruach uneshama lemisbal haor, ki tov umatok haor vechulei, kemo shekkatuv: "lachazot benoam Adonai", leshon neimut vaarevut umetikut vetaanug atzum leen ketz, kemo shekkatuv: "az titannag al Adonai", "vehisbia betzachtzachot kulei", leshon "tziche tzama", kemo shekkatuv bazzohar.

Veen bechochah lekabbel hanneimut vaarevut hatztzachtzachot, shello tetze minnartekah vetitbattel mimmetziutah kener baavuka. im lo, shemmibbechinat or ze atzmo – tishtalshel vetimmashech mimmennu ezo heara muetet, bederech hishtalshelut madrega achar madrega betzimtzumim rabbim, ad sheyyibbare mimmenna levush echad nivra, meen mahut or ze, lehalebish hannefesh ruach uneshama.

Vederech levush ze, shehu meen or ze tuchal lehanot mizziv or ze ulehassigo, velo titbattel mimmetziutah, vechimshal haroe bashshemesh derech ashashit zakka umeira vechulei, uchemo shekkatuv: "vayyavo moshe betoch heanan, vayyaal kulei", shennitlabbesh beanan veala veraa derech heanan vechulei, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar chelek 2 daf 210 vercht.

Vehinne, or ze hagganuz latztzaddikim leatid lavo, hannikra beshem "noam Adonai" vetzachtzachot", lehitanneg al Adonai, ved meot almin dechissufin demitannege behon tzaddikayyay kulei", kemo shekkatuv: "arba meot shekel kesef kulei" hinne yesh bo maalot umadregot rabbot meod, gavoah meal gavoah, ach heara muetet hayyoredet madrega achar madrega livro levush ze, hi mibbechinat madrega haacharona shebbeor ze, venikret beshem "madrega hachitzona" vaachorayim" derech mashal, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar daf Rosh Chodesh ammud 2 (ayyen besefer "mikdash melech") very ammud 2: uma deishtear kulei.

Vehinne, kemo shebbenishmat haadam yesh bah koach hattaanug shemmitanneget mimma sheyyesh lah oneg mimmennu, kemo mehasekalat sechel chadash uchehay gavna, uvechinat chitzoniyyut vaachorayim shel koach uvechinat hattaanug shebbah – hi bechinat koach haratzon shebbah, shehu rotze ma shehu rotze, dehayynu davar sheeno tzaar, shehatztzaar – hefech hattaanug.

Vechacha al derech mashal beor en-sof baruch-hu, gam ken, kivyachol, haratzon haelyon baruch-hu hi bechinat chitzoniyyut vaachorayim livchinat "oneg haelyon" venoam Adonai" vetzachtzachot" vealmin dechissufin" hannizkarim leel.

Hagam shehem meyuchadim betachlit hayyichud, shehu yitbarech uretzono echad, velo kirtzon haadam chas veshalom, lo minneh velo miktzateh, veen dimyon benehem kelal, af-al-pi-chen, dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, leshakkech haozen ma sheyyechola lishmoa bemashal umelitza minnishmat haadam hakkelula mikkoach hattaanug veharatzon vehachachma vehabbina vechulei, vechannire bechush, shekkesheadam maskil eze sechel chadash nifla, azay, beotah rega al kol panim nolad lo taanug nifla besichlo, mikkelal, shehattaanug hu lemala mala mibbechinat hassechel vehachachma, rak shemmelubbash bivchinat sechel vechachma, ucheshehaadam margish hassechel vechachma, dehayynu – shemmassigah umevinah hetev, azay, margish gam ken bechinat hattaanug hamelubbash bachachma.

Velachen nikret bechinat bina beshem "olam-habba" bazzohar hakkadosh, shehi bechinat hitgallut hachachma im hattaanug hamelubbash bah, shemmassigim hatztzaddikim began eden umaskilim bifnimiyyut hattora, deorayyta mechachma nafka, veorayyta vekudesha-berich-hu kulla chad:

Vehinne, ratzon haelyon baruch-hu mechunne venikra befi chachme haemet beshem "keter elyon", uvo 620 ammude or vechulei. perush, derech mashal, kemo sheyyesh ammudim bevet choma gadol, nitztzavim baaretz verosham mechubbar battikra, kacha mammash al derech mashal, "keter elyon" baruch-hu, hu lemala mibbechinat madregat hachachma, vehu milleshon "koteret", shehu machtir umakkif al hammochin shebbarosh, shehem bechinot chachma-bina-daat.

Veratzon ze nitlabbesh betaryag mitzvot hattora vez mitzvot derabbanan, sherubbam kechullam hen mitzvot maasiyyot. vegam hatteluyot bedibbur – ha kayyma lan daakimat sefatav have maase". vegam hatteluyot bammachashava o ballev – hare hammitzva nittena laadam haggashmi shebbaolam hazze davka, shehu baal bechira lehattot levavo letov vechulei, ma-sheen-ken hanneshama belo guf, en tzarich letzavvotah al ze.

Venimtza, shehammitzvot – hen al derech mashal kemo haammudim, nitztzavim merum hammaalot, hu ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, ad haaretz hallezu hachumerit. vehen al derech mashal kemo haammudim chalulin, shemmakkifin umalbishin nishmat haadam o rucho o nafsho keshemmekayyem hammitzvot, vederech ammudim ellu olin hannefesh-ruach-neshama shello ad rum hammaalot, litzror bitzror hachayyim et Adonai, perush lihyot tzerurot umelubbashot beor hakketer, hu ratzon haelyon baruch-hu, veal-yede levush ze – yuchelu lachazot benoam Adonai" vetzachtzachot" shellemala mimmaalat hakketer, vehen penimiyyuto al derech mashal.

(Vahagam shennitbaer bemakom acher, shehammitzvot hen penimiyyut ratzon haelyon baruch-hu hinne mudaat zot leyode chen, ribbuy bechinot umadregot sheyyesh bechol bechina umadrega mimmadregot hakkedushsha, kamma bechinot "panim" lefanim", vechamma bechinot "achorayim" laachorayim", leen ketz vechulei).

Vehinne, 7 mitzvot derabbanan enan nechshavot mitzvot bifne atzman, shehare kevar neemar: "lo tosef", ella hen yotzot venimshachot mimmitzvot hattora uchelulot bahen bemispar taryag, lehalebish taryag bechinot vechochot shebbenefesh-ruach-nishmat haadam.
Vezehu shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh parashat pekude (daf 229 ammud 2): "deinnun ovadin tavin deavid bar nash mashche minnehora dezivav illaa levusha kulei, vechame kulei benoam Adonai vechulei".

Vahagam dehatam mayyri began eden hattachton, shehallevushim sham hem mimmitzvot maasiyyot mammash, aval began eden haelyon hallevushim hem meruta vechavvavna delibba beorayyta utzelota, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar sham (daf 210), hare hakkavvavna hi kavvavnat esko battora lishmah meahavat Adonai, umitzvat talmud tora hi gam ken mikkelal mitzvot maasiyyot, daakimat sefatav have maase", vehirhur lav kedibbur dami, veeno yotze yede chovato behirhur levaddo, vechen bitfilla.
Uma gam, ki maalat hakkavvavna al haddibbur umaase enah mitztzad atzmah kulei, ella mitztzad hearat ratzon haelyon kulei, kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek 1 perek 38 baarichut, ayyen sham.

Vehinne mudaat zot, ki hinne, ratzon haelyon baruch-hu hamelubbash betaryag mitzvot shebbattora shebbichtav, hu mufela umechusse, tamir venelam, veeno mitgalle ella battora shebbeal pe, kemo mitzvat tefillin, al derech mashal, shenneemar battora shebbichtav: "ukeshartam leot al yadecha vehayu letotafot ben enecha", vehu maamar satum venelam, shello feresh hakkatuv ech uma likshor, umahu "totafot", vehechan hu "ben enecha" veal yadecha", ad sheppersha tora shebbeal pe, shetztzarich likshor bayit echad al hayyad ved battim al harosh, uvetocham 4 parashiyyot, vehabbattim yihyu meor meubbad, umerubbaim davka, umekushsharim birtzuot shel or shechorot davka, vechol shear perate hilchot asiyyayt hattefillin shenneemru beal pe, veal yadecha" hi hazzeroa davka velo kaf hayyad, uven enecha" ze kadkod velo hammetzach.

Vechen kol mitzvot shebbattora, ben mitzvot ase ben mitzvot lo taase – enan geluyot viduot umeforashot ella al-yede tora shebbeal pe, kemitzvat lo taase shenneemar beshabbat: "lo taase melacha", velo feresh ma hi melacha, uvattora shebbeal pe nitparesh shehen 39 melachot hayeduot, velo tiltul avanim vekorot kevedot.
Vechayyotze vahen hen kol hammitzvot, ben mitzvot ase ben mitzvot lo taase, hen setumot velo meforashot ugeluyot viduot, ella al-yede tora shebbeal pe.

Umishshum hache ketiv al tora shebbeal pe: "al tittosh torat immecha", kemo shekkatuv bazzohar, mishshum sheal derech mashal kemo shekkol evre havvalad kelulim betippat haav behelem gadol, vehaem motziato lide gilluy beledatah valad shalem beramach evarim veshasa gidim, kacha mammash kol ramach mitzvot ase veshasa mitzvot lo taase baim mehahelem el haggilluy battora shebbeal pe, veresheh dikra: "shema beni musar avicha" kae attora shebbichtav, denafka mechachma illaa hannikret beshem "av".

Vezehu shekkatuv: "eshet chayil ateret balah", ki hattora shebbeal pe hannikret "eshet chayil", hammolida umaamedet chayaylot harebe, kemo shekkatuv: "vaalamot en mispar" al tikre "alamot" ella "olamot" – ellu halachot delet lon chushebana, kemo shekkatuv battikkunim.

Vechullan hen bechinat gilluy ratzon haelyon baruch-hu hannelam battora shebbichtav, veratzon haelyon baruch-hu hu lemala mala mimmaalat chachma illaa, uchemo keter vaatara sheal hammochin shebbarosh, lachen nikreu hahalachot beshem "tagga" vechitrah shel tora", vehashshone halachot muvetach lo shehu ben olam-habba", al-yede hitlabbeshut nefesh-ruach-neshama shello baratzon haelyon baruch-hu, kannizkar leel:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 30: Mudaat zot ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "kol haragil lavo levet hakkeneset veyom echad lo va hakkadosh-baruch-hu shoel alav, shenneemar: "mi vachem yere Adonai vechulei".

Vechen bechol hammitzvot, uvifrat mitzvat hatztzedaka sheshshekula keneged kol hammitzvot. hagam shehi beli neder chas veshalom, af-al-pi-chen, kol hachayil asher naga yirat Adonai belibbam lo yaata lenafsham haelokit latet migraot bakkodesh, measher kevar hureglu midde shana lehaferish mimmeodam, lehachayot ruach shefalim venidkaim delet lehon miggarmehon, hi bechinat "sukkat david hannofelet" vechulei, lekomem uleromem vechulei, "lemeheve echad beechad" vechulei.

Vehakkol lefi rov hammaase" vechulei, ulefi hacheshbon, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "kol peruta uferuta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol vechulei", al derech maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: ematay "gadol havaya"? – keshehu "beir elohenu" vechulei, hi bechinat umekom hacheshbon, kemo shekkatuv: "enayich berechot becheshbon".

Vehamechuvvavn, kannoda, ki beitaruta diltatta" – hameshachat chayyim chen vachesed bemaase hatztzedaka beratzon hattov vesever panim yafot – "itaruta dilella", yaer havaya panav, hu hearat vehameshachat chen vachesed veratzon elyon mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu asher ligdullato en cheker vehassaga kelal el bechinat "malchutecha malchut kol olamim", alma deitgalya, hamechayye kol habberuim shebbechol hahechalot elyonim vetachtonim, shehen bivchinat mispar vecheshbon, kemo shekkatuv: "elef alafim yeshammeshuneh".

Vezehu "cheshbon gadol", sheal-yede rov "maase hatztzedaka shalom", ki perush "shalom" hu davar hamechabber umetavvevch 2 ketzavot hafchiyyim, shehen ketze hashshamayim leella, bechinat "veligdullato en cheker", uketze hashshamayim letatta, hammitlabbesh bivria-yetzira-asiyya, bechinat gevul umispar, veday lammevin:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 31: Noda bashshearim ma shekkatuv battikkunim, dishchinta ihi mara begaluta" kivyachol.

Perush, al derech mashal, kemo choli hagguf, hammavdil ben kodesh vechulei, shessibbat hacholi vehabberiut hi hitpashshetut vehilluch hachayyut mehallev el kol haevarim, hamelubbeshet bedam hannefesh hayyotze mehallev el kol haevarim, vesovev sovev holech haruach chayyim vehaddam toch toch kol haevarim vehaggidim hammuvelaim bahem, vechozer el hallev.

Veim sibbuv vehilluch haruach chayyim hallaz hu kehilchato, temidi kesidro hamesuddar lo mechayye hachayyim baruch-hu azay haadam bari betachlit, ki kol haevarim mekushsharim yachad umekabbelim chayyutam harauy lahem mehallev al-yede sibbuv hallaz.

Ach im yesh eze kilkul beezehu mekoman, hammonea umeakkev o memaet sibbuv vehilluch haddam im haruach chayyim hamelubbash bo, azay, nifsak o mitmaet hakkesher hallaz hamekashsher kol haevarim el hallev al-yede sibbuv hallaz, vaazay – nofel haadam lemishkav vecholi, Adonai yishmerenu.

Vechacha mammash, al derech mashal, hinne kol nishmot yisrael nikraim bechinat "evre dishchinta", hannikret beshem "lev", kemo shekkatuv: "vetzur levavi", uchemo shekkatuv: "veshachanti betocham": perush, ki leshon shechina" hu, sheor havaya shochen beolamot beria-yetzira-asiyya lehachayotam.

Vehameshachat chayut ze hi al-yede hitlabbeshut techilla benishmot yisrael, lefi shekkol hannivraim, en aroch lahem el habbore yitbarech, decholla kammeh kela mammash chashivin, vei efshar lahem lekabbel chayut meoro veshifo yitbarech, lihyot nivraim meayin leyesh vechayyim vekayyaymim, ki im al-yede hanneshamot shealu bemachashava, vekadmu livriat olamot sheal-yede bechinat haddibbur, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "bemi nimlach hakkadosh baruch-hu vechulei", kannoda bemakom acher.

Venoda bashshearim, ki kol hameshachat hachayyut vehahashpaa meelyonim letachtonim mehem, hen kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira: "nautz techillatan besofan vesofan bitchillatan", uvechitve haarizal mechunne beshem "or yashar" veor chozer", uchemo shekkatuv: "vehachayyot ratzo vashov".

Asher al ken, al pi haddevarim vehaemet haelle, asher i efshar levaer hetev bemichtav, nikret hashshechina beshem "lev", vehanneshamot beshem "evarim": lehorot lanu, ki kaasher kol hanneshamot devukot umekushsharot yachad azay sibbuv vehilluch hachayyut vehahashpaa sovev sovev, venautz sofan bitchillatan, lekashsher ulechabber kullan lahavaya echad uledavka bo yitbarech, uchemo shekkatuv: "attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem lifne havaya elokechem" "kullechem" dayyka, velifne" dayyka, "rashechem kulei mechotev etzecha kulei".

Uvaze yuvan maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha, ki chureban bayit sheni unefilat yisrael baggalut vehistallekut hashshechina viridatah leedom bivchinat galut, kivyachol, hakkol haya baavon sinat chinnam uferud levavot rachamana litztzelan. velachen nikret "chola" al derech mashal, kemo shekkatuv: "somech noflim verofe cholim" leshon rabbim, hem kol haevarim vechulei:
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 32: Barech Adonai chelam ufoal yadam yirtze, leratzon lahem lifne Adonai tamid, ko yitten vecho yosif Adonai leammetz libbam baggibborim, venadiv al nedivot yakum, lihyot gadol hameasse bechol ir uminyan, vetechashev lo litzdaka.
Veal haose neemar: "tzidkato omedet laad" – "omedet" leshon nekeva, shemmekabbel hitorrut libbo hattahor miggadol hameasse", af-al-pi-chen – "omedet laad".

Perush, shekkol hatztzedaka vehachesed sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze minnidvat libbam hattahor hen henna chayyot vekayyaymot baolam hazze haggashmi ad zeman hattechiyyay, sheaz, hu zeman gilluy elokut veor-en-sof baruch-hu mibbechinat sovev kol almin baolam hazze, uchemo shennitbaer baarichut bammichtav deeshtakad.

Vetzarich lihyot keli umachon lehitlabbesh bo or-en-sof baruch-hu, kemo hagguf lanneshama al derech mashal, kemo shekkatuv: "halo cho devari kaesh" "ma esh enah meira baolam hazze ella keshenneechezet umitlabbeshet bappetila kulei", kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher.

Vehagguf vehakkeli leoro yitbarech – hi middat hachesed unedivat hallev, litten ulehashpia chayyut leman delet leh kulei, kemo shekkatuv battikkunim: "vechamma gufin tekkinat lon, veitkeriu betikkuna da chesed deroa yemina", vechol hagguf nichlal beyamin, vechach amar happayyayt: "levusho tzedaka".

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "en hatztzedaka mishtallemet ella lefi chesed shebbah, shenneemar: "ziru lachem litzdaka, kitzru lefi chased": shehakkatzir hu gilluy hazzeria hattemuna baaretz, vechach hu hatztzedaka vehachesed sheyyisrael osin bizman haggalut, hi temuna venisteret ad zeman hattechiyya, sheyyitlabbesh veyair or-en-sof baruch-hu baolam hazze haggashmi, veihu vegarmohi chad", hem bechinot hakkelim deeser sefirot daatzilut, vechol shekken vekal vachomer or-en-sof baruch-hu hassovev kol almin milmala mala mibbechinat atzilut.
Ulefichach nikret "tzedaka" leshon nekeva – "tzidkato omedet laad", shemmekabbelet heara meor-en-sof hassovev kol almin, hammitlabbesh betochah baolam hazze haggashmi bizman hattechiyya.

Aval "tzedek lefanav yehallech" hu leshon zachar, hi middat hachesed hammitoreret belev haadam meatzmo, al-yede hitorrut ahavat Adonai bikriat-shema, uledavka vo, velimsor nafsho beechad", uvechol meodecha" kifshuto vechulei.

Uveitaruta diltatta", vechammayim happanim lappanim ken lev" adam haelyon kulei – "itaruta dilella", hu hameshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu hassovev kol almin lematta matta baolam hazze haggashmi bivchinat gilluy bizman hattechiyya, kimvoar bammichtav deeshtakad baarichut.

Vezehu "lefanav yehallech", shemmolich umamshich "panim" haelyonim milmala mehaatzilut ad olam haasiyya. vechaet et lekatztzer, vechol tuv mehem lo yibbatzer, "hetiva Adonai lattovim velisharim belibbotam", kenefesh tidreshennu:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 1:
Kunetres acharon al kamma perakim
ayyen balekavetay omrim chelek 1 perek 40
Lehavin, ech hakkore besippure maasiyyot shebbattora, hu mekushshar bechachma illaa.

Al pi ma shekkatuv bakkavvavnot daf 16 ammud 2: kemo shehaadam osek lematta, kach deyokan haadam haelyon lemala kulei, vechen yesh lomar behirhur baotiyyot hakketuvot. aval haddibbur yesh lomar – devokea vesalik laatzilut mammash, o livria bidchilu urechimu sichliyyim, o litzira bidchilu urechimu tiviyyim, uvammikra salik meolam hazze ley sefirot daasiyya, mishshum devaka avirin vechulei. ma-sheen-ken behirhur, ella haddeyokan" shehu shoresh nishmato vechulei.

Uma shekkatuv bazzohar chelek 3 daf 105 dehirhur la avid mide kulei, vehayeynu afilu letav, ayyen sham uvedaf 31 ammud 2, yesh lomar, dehayynu, leitara leella sheyyumeshach mishsham letatta, rak machashavto nishara sham, umosifa sham or gadol, betosefet veribbuy haor baatzilut, al-yede mikra umitzvot maasiyyot shebbaasiyya, sheikkar hayyichud – hu lemala, rak happerot" baolam hazze, al-yede hameshachat or meat mizzeer lematta al-yede haddibbur umaase, ma-sheen-ken behirhur lo nimshach kelum, velachen, lo yatza yede chovato, ma sheyyarda nishmato laolam hazze rak lehameshich orot elyonim lematta, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar 26 "lehameshich or".
Aval lehaalot mimmatta lemala, hu davka al-yede machashava tova, divla dechilu urechimu la farcha leela, uchemo shekkatuv beshaar hannevua perek 2, vehammachashava tova kulei.

Uma shekkatuv devaka rekiin vechulei", vehayeynu, afilu bela dechilu urechimu, bemikkol shekken middevarim betelim demidda tova merubba, hayeynu – "rekiin" davka, shehen hahechalot" vehabbattim", velo beguf haadam haelyon", vechol shekken benefesh-ruach-neshama afilu beadam daasiyya", shehen 10 sefirot, orot vechelim. vezehu shekkatuv battikkunim, "divla dechilu urechimu la yachla lesalka ulemekam kodam Adonai" davka:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 2: Ayyen etz chayyim shaar hannekuddot shaar 8 perek 6, sheen hachazarat panim befanim ki im al-yede mitzvot maasiyyot davka. vetaam haddavar, ki al-yede maasim tovim gorem ziuug haelyon vechulei.

Ulehavin, ammay "maasiyyot" davka? yuvan mimma shekkatuv beshaar man umd, ki tzarich techilla lehaalot "mayyin nukevin denukeva dizer anpin", umayyin nukevin denukeva" hen bechinat asiyya, kemo shekkatuv sham perek 1.

Vehinne, hammaasim tovim nikraim "kissuach vekitztzutz hakkotzim", hanneechazim baachorayim, shehen bechinat asiyya, kemo shekkatuv beshaar 47 perek Adonai, vehayeynu al-yede haalaat hattov hagganuz bahem hamelubbash bemitzvot maasiyyot limkoro, likdushshat haatzilut shekkevar huverra.

Uma shekkatuv sham sheadam harishon tikken gam ken al-yede tefilla, hayeynu al-yede otiyyot haddibbur, daakimat sefatav have maase", ki hen minnefesh hachiyyunit shebbagguf vedamo asher sharshan minnoga.
Vehinne, habberurim daasiyya olin litzira al yede shem ban, umitzira livria velaatzilut, kemo shekkatuv beshaar man derush 11 siman 7.

Uvaze yuvan dehirhur la avid mide, ki beli haalaat "mayyin nukevin" mehammelachim" shebbenoga", i efshar lehameshich tippin milmala leziuug zeer anpin venukeva, ki rotze linak meimmo velo lehashepia lematta, kemo shekkatuv beshaar man derush 2. veayyen zohar parashat pekude daf 244 ammud 2: deit siddura kulei leistakkela kulei, vehen kavvavnot hattefilla veyichudim elyonim layyodim umassigim leistakkela kulei, ki nefesh-ruach-neshama shellahem atzman hen "mayyin nukevin", bimsirat nafsham al hattora, uvinfilat appayim, kannoda:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 3: Lehavin ma shekkatuv beshaar hayyichudim perek 2, deal-yede tora shello vechavvavna nivraim malachim beolam hayetzira, vesham hevi mehazzohar parashat shelach: "delet kala deitavid kulei bar kala deorayyta utzelota desalik uvaka kulei". vehinne, mikkavvavnat hattefilla nivreu malachim beolam habberia kemo mikkavvavnat hattora, uvelo chavvavna – nidchet lematta legamre, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar parashat pekude daf 245 ammud 2: "go rakia tattaa kulei deikkerin tzelotin pesilan kulei", veayyen sham parashat vayyakhel daf 201 ammud 2: "i hi milla kidka yaut kulei".

Ach hahefresh ben tora litfilla shello vechavvavna, muvan meelav, ki limmud hattora hu mevin veyodea ma shellomed, divlav hache la mikre limmud kelal, rak, shellomed setam, belo kavvavna lishmah meahavat Adonai shebbelibbo bivchinat gilluy, rak meahava hamesutteret hattivit, ach eno lomed shello lishmah mammash lehitgaddel kulei, deha la salik leella min shimsha, kemo shekkatuv befarashat vaychi daf 223 ammud 2, vehayeynu mishshum shemmachashavto vechavvavnato hen mitlabbeshot beotiyyot haddibbur veenan mannichot otan lesalka leela.

Vehache name bitfilla shello vechavvavna, shemmechashshev machashavot zarot (ella mippene shekkavvavnato lashshamayim, lechach yesh lah tikkun bekal lachazor velaalot, keshemmitpallel bechavvavna afilu tefilla achat melukketet mittefillot kol hashshana, kemo shekkatuv bemikdash melech" parashat pekude).

Uma shekkatuv befarashat pekude: "go rakia tattaa", uvefarashat vayyakhel mashma dedavka "i ihi milla kidka yaut salkin immah" ad avira derakia dilella kulei – lo kashe mide: derakia tattaa meinnun rekiin demiddabbere go alma shebbefarashat pekude – hen demalchut daasiyya, udefarashat vayyakhel – hen dizer anpin" daasiyya, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar hashshemot perek 3 gabbe "zeer anpin" daasiyyay, ayyen sham.

Veha demashma lichora befarashat pekude, degam tefilla pesula ola ad hechol harishon shemmimmennu nidchet lematta, vehu bizer anpin" divria – lo kashe mide: shehare afilu kol haavonot mammash, kallot vachamurot – olot lesham afilu ad hechol had, kemo shekkatuv daf 252 ammud 1, ella vadday, sheen mahut haaliyyot shavot, veen aroch vedimyon benehem – ella beshittuf hashshem bilvad, veday lammevin.

Uvaze yuvan gam ken ma shekkatuv sham daf 247, shebbehechol hav [<small>ulay tzarich lihyot:</small> izdamman hamemunne. <small>veulay tzarich lihyot:</small> kayyaymin hallevushim] memunne al hallevushim shemmalbishim hanneshama mimmaase hammitzvot, af shehen began eden hattachton daasiyya, kemo shekkatuv sham daf 210.

Vehinne, tefilla pesula adifa mittora shello lishmah mammash, shehi tachat hashshemesh, vehattefilla hi go rakia kulei. aval tora setam, sheenah shello lishmah rak meahava mesutteret tivit, la gara mehevel pihen shel tinokot-shel-bet-rabban, desalik leella mippene shehu hevel sheen bo chet, vesalik leella, af im hu shello lishmah mammash, miyyirat hartzua shebbeyad hassofer, veayyen sham daf 255 ammud 2, shehammalachim hem maalim hahevel shel tinokot-shel-bet-rabban ad atzilut:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 4: Lehavin ma shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim, devizman hazze, ikkar habberur al yede hattefilla davka, af shettalmud tora lemala mehattefilla.
Hainyan hu: sheal-yede tora umitzvot mosifin or baatzilut kulei, perush, or-en-sof baruch-hu bechelim daatzilut – al-yede talmud tora – bifnimit, dehayynu hameshachot hammochin:

Uvekiyyum hammitzvot – bechitzonit hakkelim, shehem bechinot netzach-hod-yesod, shebbey sefirot "zeer anpin" shebbaatzilut, rak shemmitlabbeshim bivria-yetzira-asiyya, betora umitzvot haggashmiyyim shebbaolam hazze.

Aval hattefilla, hi hameshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu livria-yetzira-asiyya davka, lo bederech hitlabbeshut bilvad, rak haor mammash, leshannot hannivraim mikkemot shehem, sheyyitrappe hachole, veyered haggeshem mishshamayim laaretz veyolidah veyatzmichah.

Ma-sheen-ken betora umitzvot, sheen shinnuy biklaf hattefillin al-yede hanachatan barosh uvazzeroa. vegam bemitzvot sheasiyyaytan hu gemar mitzvatan, hashshinnuy hu al-yede adam, velo bide shamayim kevitfilla, shehi hameshachat hachayyut meen-sof baruch-hu, shehu levaddo kol yachol:
Vehilkach, kede lehameshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta, i efshar beli haalaat "mayyin nukevin" millematta davka.
Ma-sheen-ken letalmud tora shebbaatzilut, hameyuchedet belav hache bammaatzil baruch-hu.

Vehaalaat "mayyin nukevin" bemocho velibbo shel adam, hi bechinat "rishpe esh" beli gevul, venikret "meodecha", kede leorer bechinat en-sof, vehayeynu al-yede gevurot desag", shehen hen harappach nitzotzin kulei.

Velachen nikret hattefilla – "chayye shaa", hi malchut hayyoredet bivria-yetzira-asiyya, vetora – "chayye olam", hu "zeer anpin", ki ramach pikkudin hen mitchallekin bey kelim deeser sefirot dizer anpin" kulei.

Vehinne, bemakom echad katav sheramach mitzvot ase – hen baAdonai chasadim veshasa lo taase baAdonai gevurot vechulei, uvemakom acher katav shehen taryag archin nimshachin mechad archa kulei, shehu lavnunit vechulei.

Ach hainyan, shekkol hammitzvot letakken ramach evre "zeer anpin", al yede hameshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu bemochin, hakkelulin baAdonai chasadim vaAdonai gevurot, umekor hammochin hu lavnunit kulei, hu haoneg vechefetz haelyon lehameshich haor lematta leramach evarin dizer anpin", umitchalleket hahamshacha letaryag hameshachot peratiyyot, lefi bechinat erech hammitzvot, kegon bitzdaka ugemilut chasadim – nimshach or-en-sof baruch-hu lechitzoniyyut hakkeli dechesed dizer anpin", uvekiyyum haddinin – bechitzonit gevura, uverachamim kulei.
Vederech umaavar hahamshacha, hu al-yede penimiyyut hakkelim umochotehen, shehen dechilu urechimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim, shehen bechinot mochin dekatnut vegadlut.

Velaze bikkesh moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom meod lekayyem hammitzvot maasiyyot hatteluyot baaretz, shehen tachlit hahishtalshelut, lehameshich or-en-sof baruch-hu levarer hakkelim dizer anpin" divria-yetzira-asiyya, shebbahen, hen harappach nitzotzin, al-yede tora umitzvot maasiyyot shebbivria-yetzira-asiyya davka.

Vehinne, lekiyyum mitzva shei efshar laasot al-yede acherim mevattelin talmud tora, vaafilu maase merkava, vechol shekken tefilla shehi bechinat mochin udechilu urechimu sichliyyim, vehattaam – kannizkar leel.

Veod zot, shebbeemet meod gadla vegavha maalat hammitzvot maasiyyot, vechen limmudam, al maalat hammochin shehen dechilu urechimu sichliyyim. ki hagam dichtiv: "uledavka vo" al-yede middotav, mikkol makom, enennu davek afilu bemiddot haelyonot ella bimtziutan, velo bemahutan, uchemo shekkatuv: "veanochi afar vaefer".

Vechol shekken beor-en-sof baruch-hu, delet machashava tefisa veh" beoro vehitpashshetut hachayyut mimmennu yitbarech, ki im bimtziuto, shehu shemmechayye et kullam, velo bemahuto, afilu laelyonim, kemo shekkatuv: "kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot kulei", levad "alulim hanneetzalim" – massigim kol echad beillato" kefi hasseder shebbeetz chayyim" behitlabbeshut happartzufim".
Aval lo benivraim afilu binshamot daatzilut, kemo shekkatuv bemoshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom: "veraita et achoray kulei".

Ma-sheen-ken maase hammitzvot "maase elokim hemma" henna bederech hishtalshelut mikkelim daatzilut livria-yetzira-asiyya, mimmahutan veatzmutan dechitzoniyyutan, kemo al derech mashal etrog uminav, hilbish bahen hakkadosh-baruch-hu mimmahutan veatzmutan dachasadim [penimit] [penimim] dizer anpin", vehayeynu mibbechinat chitzoniyyutan, kannoda bechol mitzvot maasiyyot.

Ma-sheen-ken haadam, afilu yesh lo neshama daatzilut, meachar shemmelubbeshet beguf, lo yuchal limtzo benafsho ulehassig mahutan veatzmutan shel penimit hachasadim dizer anpin" daatzilut, (ki haatzilut hi bechinat "chayya" bichlalut haolamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya, shehi bechinat makkif milmala veenah mitlabbeshet bichli kelal) ki im metziutan, al-yede dechilu urechimu sichliyyim.
Uma shekkatuv: "veraita et achoray", hu bederech nevua davka. (shehu hitpashshetut haggashmiyyut, kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat mishpatim).
Vehayeynu hattaam, lefi shei efshar lannivra lehassig kelum bemahut haelokut, shehu habbore, uveli hassaga – en zo halebasha utefisa udevekut amittit.

Ma-sheen-ken haetrog al derech mashal, chayyuto nimshecha venishtalshela mimmahut chitzonit dechelim denukeva dizer anpin" daatzilut, shehu bechinat elokut, kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shekkol happerot hen baatzilut, ki lamed kelim daatzilut yardu livria-yetzira-asiyya (vehen yod maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam, al-yede hitlabbeshut benukeva daasiyya, mahut bemahut) ki hakkelim daatzilut naasu neshama baasiyya shehi bechinat elokut mammash, lefi shebbaatzilut "ihu vegarmohi chad", hammaatzil vehanneetzal, veal-yede hitlabbeshut mahut hanneshama bemahut hakkelim denukeva daasiyya – nithavva haetrog.
Nimtza, keshettofes haetrog umenaano kehilchato, hare ze tofes mammash chayyuto hamelubbash bo minnukeva daatzilut, hameyuchedet beor-en-sof hammaatzil baruch-hu.

Ma-sheen-ken bechavvavnato, eno massig vetofes, af hayyodea hassod. – ella metziutah, velo mahutah. ach belimmud hilchot etrog massig vetofes haetrog mammash umitzvato kahalacha, bivchinat dibbur umachashava, vechol shekken hallomed hassod. aval davka sodot hammitzva, delo gara millimmud hilchoteha, veadderabba kulei, af sheeno massig hammahut.

Ma sheen ken beseder hahishtalshelut, af im massig hammetziut, lo adif mitztzad atzmo kelimmud hammitzvot shemmassig vetofes hammahut, umaale alav keillu kiyyem befoal mammash, kemo shekkatuv: "zot hattora kulei".

Ella sheyyediat hammetziut mehahishtalshelut, hi gam ken mitzva rama venissaa, veadderabba – ola al kullana, kemo shekkatuv: "veyadata hayyom kulei", "da et eloke avicha kulei", umevia lelev shalem" kulei, shehu haikkar, vehassagat hammetziut hu lehafeshit miggashmiyyut kulei.

Rak shezzo hi mitzva achat mittaryag, vehaadam – tzarich lekayyem kol taryag, lefi shehen hishtalshelut hammahut dechitzonit dechelim daatzilut, lechach, tzarich leharebot belimmud kol hattaryag vekiyyuman befoal mammash bemachashava dibbur umaase, shehen beria-yetzira-asiyya, levarer berurin asher sham.

Veod zot, shebbeemet habberurin shebbivria-yetzira-asiyya merappach, al-yede tora umitzvot bemachashava dibbur umaase, gevohin besharshan minnefesh-ruach-neshama shebbaadam, ki hen missag" shebbifnimit "adam kadmon", venefesh-ruach-neshama shekkevar nitkenu al-yede "ma", hu yotze mehammetzach" heara bealma. vezehu shekkatuv: "lifne meloch melech kulei". vehayeynu taama shehaadam chay bimzonot domem-tzomeach-chay, umevarran bema" shebbo, vechay bahem, lefi shehem misag".
Veod zot, kemo shekkatuv: "ufanay lo yerau" – sheppenimit haelyon eno yachol lered lematta, rak chitzoniyyuto uvechinat achorayim, shehu novlot chachma illaa.

Veod zot, shehare haddibbur middivre chachma illaa eno molid, vehattippa shennimshecha mehakkeli dechachma illaa yesh bah koach hammolid umehavvev yesh meayin. vegam hameshachat chachma illaa, kelula bah. vehattaam, mippene shebbah nimshach mahutah veatzmutah dechachma illaa.

Ma-sheen-ken bedibbur umachashava, vaafilu behasekalat hassechel beezo chachma, hare chachma zo rak heara mitpashshetet mimmahut hassechel shebbannefesh veatzmuto, veheara zo hi rak levush lemahuto veatzmuto shel hassechel, vehassechel hu heara ulevush lemahut hannefesh. ma-sheen-ken hattippa, nimshach bah gam mimmahut hannefesh veatzmutah hamelubbeshet bemochin, velachen molida bedome lah mammash.
Vezehu hahefresh ben avodat hammalachim hayyotzin minneshikin" lehanneshamot hayyotzin mehakkelim.
Ach hakkelim daatzilut naasu neshama livria-yetzira-asiyya, vehilkach, dechilu urechimu sichliyyim hen kemalachim dinshikin" mehearat chitzonit dechachma-bina-daat bivria-yetzira-asiyya.

Vehattaam, mishshum difnimit chachma-bina-daat umahuto veatzmuto shel or penimi, eno yachol lehitgallot, ella al-yede hearat hakkelim davka, hayyordim lematta ketippat haadam mimmochin, uchemo shekkatuv: "ufanay lo yerau".

Uvar min kol den, afilu binshama daatzilut, af shehi mikkelim daatzilut, vechen benefesh-ruach mikkelim ditzira-asiyya hinne rechimu [ulay tzarich lihyot: dechilu urechimu] sichliyyim shellahem – meorrim gam ken bechelim ditzira-asiyya bechinat haalaa mimmatta lemala beitaruta diltatta", vezehu bechinat histallekut levad chas veshalom.

Aval bechinat hameshacha milmala lematta, hu al-yede mitzvot maasiyyot davka, lehameshich or bakkelim, uvechitzonit hakkelim davka, shechitzoniyyut haelyon yored lematta ufenimiyyut hattachton ole lemala. vezehu shekkatuv bazzohar parashat pekude hannizkar leel "deit siddura kulei".
Ushetehen tzorech gavoah, haalaa vehameshacha, al-yede haalaat "mayyin nukevin" missag", bivchinat ovada umillula.

Vezehu tachlit hahishtalshelut, lehitgallot or elyon lematta, velo laalot hattachton lemala, shezze, eno ella lefi shaa. veaf gam zot, davka aliyyot hakkelim leorot elyonim hi maalat hashshabbat veyom hakkippurim, aval lo aliyyot vehistallekut haorot chas veshalom, kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim.

Venefesh-ruach-neshama shel haadam legabbe gufo baolam hazze chashive keorot legabbe kelim, vechen dechilu urechimu sichliyyim legabbe mitzvot maasiyyot davka. velachen hitpallel moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom tefillot keminyan "vaetchannan", al kiyyum mitzvot maasiyyot davka. vehu haddin ledibbur gashmi shel hilchotehen.

Ach lehavin, ech haetrog shehu merappach shello nivreru adayin, vechen kelaf hattefillin, yamshich or bechelim dizer anpin venukeva daatzilut, shekkevar nivreru venitkenu al-yede shem "ma" lihyot bechinat elokut?

Hinne hammashal laze – hi hazzeria vehannetia, shehaggarin meorer koach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz, shehu devar Adonai: "tadshe haaretz kulei, etz peri kulei", al-yede haalaat "mayyin nukevin" lesharsho, kacha meorrim hakkelaf vehaetrog – ad rum hammaalot, shehu shem "sag" shellifne hashshevira, shehu mahut veatzmut orot shebbeadam kadmon", velo heara bealma kemo shem "ma" shemmimmitzcho.

Vechen belimmud veiyyun hilchotehen meorer bechinat chachma-bina-daat shebbeeser sefirot dechelim dizer anpin venukeva, vead rum hammaalot gam ken, bechinat chachma-bina-daat shebbesag" difnimit "adam kadmon", hayyotze derech haenayim" kulei.
Vechol hannizkar leel hu bemitzvot ase, aval lo belimmud perate hilchot issure lo taase lichora, uvifrat bidla shechiche kelal kemo perate hilchot piggul uchehay gavna.
Ach od zot hashshave bakkol, ki kol dechilu urechimu sichliyyim shel hammalachim hen bechinot nivraim meayin leyesh, vehen bechinot nefesh ruach divria-yetzira-asiyya.

Aval perate hahalachot – hen hameshachot chachma illaa dehammaatzil baruch-hu hamelubbeshet begashmiyyut, vehalebasha zo, enah kehalebashat chachma illaa bidchilu urechimu sichliyyim, dehatam, hallevush hu maalim umastir legamre, kehester vehelem haaretz hachumeriyyit legabbe chachma illaa hamelubbeshet bah, kemo shekkatuv: "kullam bechachma asita", vehayeynu, chitzoniut dechitzoniyyut dechelim demalchut daatzilut shebbaasiyya, shehi mesutteret legamre beruach-nefesh daasiyya, vechen bivria hi mesutteret legamre beruach-nefesh, shehem bechinot nivraim behester vehelem habbore mehannivra.

Ma-sheen-ken hahalachot, hare hearat hachachma meira bahen begilluy, ulevush haasiyya hu derech maavar levad, kemo beyom tov, shechesed daatzilut hamelubbash legamre bechesed divria mechayye olam hazze haggashmi, al-yede maavar chesed ditzira vaasiyya, hannikra gam ken hitlabbeshut, sheim lo chen, lo haya poel begashmiyyut olam hazze.

Veaf sheggashmiyyut olam hazze vadday mastir legamre afilu hachesed daasiyya, mikkol makom, hahalacha atzmah – enah gashmiyyut mammash, shehi bechinat ratzon hannimshach mechachma illaa lehakel o lehachamir, rak sheyyored umeir bivchinat gilluy begashmiyyut, kemayim hayyordim mimmakom gavoah kulei, vehaddavar haggashmi atzmo shebbo medabberet hahalacha, beemet – hu mastir legamre, kemo "hammachalif para bachamor", vechen besar happiggul o lo figgul vechasher.

Rak hahalacha beatzmah im hattaam hannigle, hi mibbechinat malchut divria vitzira divchinat neshama, shehu elokut, hamechayye umehavve nefesh-ruach divria-yetzira-asiyya, shehen dechilu urechimu shel hammalachim vehanneshamot vechachma-bina-daat shellahem, meayin leyesh.

Velachen hi merava tzimonam kodem sheyyarda laolam hazze, kemayim hayyordim kulei. vegam achar sheyyarda laasiyya, hi lemala mala mibbechinat chachma-bina-daat daasiyya, afilu divchinat neshama – shehi elokut.

Vehattaam, mishshum dechachma-bina-daat daasiyya divchinat neshama hu mekor hachayyut dechachma-bina-daat denefesh-ruach vetoldotehen, vehithauutan meayin leyesh im toldotehen, ad sof haasiyya, hi haaretz vechol tzevaah.

Aval chachma-bina-daat dahalachot betaamehen shebbemalchut divria vitzira, inyan hachachma – hi betikkun partzufe haatzilut, shebbahen teluyin kol taame hammitzvot, mitzvot ase – baAdonai chasadim, umitzvot lo taase – baAdonai gevurot. umishshum hache name, kesheyyardu lehitlabbesh bannivraim – hen bemalchut divria-vitzira divchinat neshama davka, shehu mikkelim daatzilut, velo bivchinat nefesh-ruach.

Veaf dechachma-bina-daat divria-yetzira divchinat neshama, sheggavha meod maalatan al bechinat malchut divria yetzira dinshama, veaf-al-pi-chen hen makor lechachma-bina-daat divria-yetzira shel bechinot nefesh-ruach shehen hammalachim? lo kashe mide – deveemet hammalachim vehanneshamot enan ella mittippa hannimshechet mechachma-bina-daat dinshama lisod zeer anpin" venittan lenukeva", umishsham yatzu bivchinat "leda". ki af im timtza lomar shennivreu mehearat hakkelim denukeva daatzilut, hare, hem hayyordim venaasim neshama.
Aval atzmut chachma-bina-daat dinshama, mitpashshet bev ketzavot dizer anpin venukeva, vesham hem shitta sidre mishna ugemara.

Uma shekkatuv beetz chayyim (veshaar hayyichudim) sheal-yede hakkavvavna naase levush neshama, veal-yede hattora levush ruach deruach al-yede mishna ditzira, veruach dinshama divria al-yede haggemara, yesh lomar dehayynu davka al-yede torat haadam baolam hazze haola lemala. aval hattalmud atzmo shennittan besinay hu binshama, velachen hu mevarer haruach, vechen bemishna ditzira.

Veaf im timtza lomar, sheggam hannittan missinay hu beruach divria-yetzira, hare noda, shekkol malach shehu shaliach milmala, azay nikra beshem Adonai mammash hashshochen bekirbo ma-sheen-ken kesheeno shaliach yesh lo shem acher kefi avodato, vaazay kore "kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai kulei", kelomar sheshshem Adonai muvedal mimmennu, vechen hu mammash bivchinat hitlabbeshut hattalmud bivchinat ruach divria, vehammishna beruach ditzira, hem sheluche Adonai, dehayynu kelim denukeva daatzilut, hachitzonim battalmud, vehaemtzaim bammishna.

Asher hammishna vehattalmud shebbahem nimshachim misod abba", hamekabbel mechachma setimaa" daarich anpin", shebbo melubbash or-en-sof baruch-hu, venimtza, sheor-en-sof, hu shem Adonai, shochen beruach divria-yetzira-asiyya, bemikra umishna vetalmud, ucheshehaadam lomed, mamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu baolam hazze lihyot nichlal uvatel beoro yitbarech, "ki ze kol haadam".

Vezot hayta avodat rabbi shimon bar yochai vechol hattannaim veamoraim bannigle, lehameshich oro yitbarech, ulevarer berure noga kol meshech zeman haggalut deshalta ilana detov vara, kemo shekkatuv: "et asher shalat haadam beadam kulei", ki zehu tachlit hahishtalshelut sheyyered haelyon lematta veyihye lo dira battachtonim, kede lehaalotan "lemeheve echad beechad".

Ma-sheen-ken avodat hammalachim, dechilu urechimu sichliyyim, enah bivchinat hameshacha kelal uchelal, rak histallekut kulei. uvaze yuvan ma shennivraim malachim meayin leyesh al-yede esek hattora afilu shello vechavvavna, shehu bechinat ruach bilvad – sheenah elokut kelal, ella lefi sheaf-al-pi-chen shem Adonai shochen vechulei, veday lammevin:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 5: Ulehavin perate hahalachot dela shechiche kelal, veefshar shello hayu meolam bimtziut, mikkol shekken shello yihyu leatid lavo, kemo perate dine piggul uchehay gavna.

Hinne mudaat zot, shekkol issur shebbaolam yesh lo shoresh umekor chayyim bakkelippot, sheim lo chen lo haya yachol lihyot bimtziut baolam bilti hashepaa elyona. vaafilu hamesalsel besaaro uchehay gavna, mekabbel chayyuto berega zo mehechlot hakkelippot, kemo shekkatuv bazzohar. vehilkach, gam perate haissurim shello vau lide maase meolam baolam hazze haggashmi, mikkol makom sharshe chayyutam hen bimtziut befoal mammash behechlot hakkelippot.

Vegam happeratim sheyyuchal lihyot shello hayu velo yihyu leolam bimtziut, kegon taut ushegagot, shettaa vekara latteshii asiri kulei uchehay gavna, delo shayyaych bemezid lihyot kelippa shora al ze, veyuchal lihyot dichhay gavna eno bimtziut behechlot hakkelippot [<small>haggaha 291 baal tzemach tzedek zichrono livracha nishmato eden:</small> nire li, ma shekkatav "veyuchal lihyot", alma – dela berira leh, hayeynu mishshum shehashshegagot baot minnoga, im ken, yesh lomar, deyesh lahem shoresh behechalot denoga]. mikkol makom, al kol panim yeshno bimtziut, lehavedil, bechachma illaa, shennitpashsheta bifrat ze lemoshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom besinay, [kammaamar: "ma] shekkol talmid vatik atid lechaddesh kulei", vechol perate haibbayot derabbi yirmeya, ucherachattu kulei" perek 4 dechullin.

Ki hitpashshetut chachma illaa hi bivchinat "en-sof" hamelubbash bah befoal mammash, vechol perat halacha, hu shaar nimshach mechachma illaa, deyasad beratta", umelubbash bah, umimmenna nimshach umitlabbesh bivria-yetzira-asiyya.

Venoda, ki yenikat hakkelippot meachorayim dey sefirot dikdushsha, uvifrat millevushim dey sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya, uvifrat ditzira vaasiyya hameoravim bakkelippot, kannoda, sheyyenikatam mibbechinat hallevushim.

Veal-yede esek hahalachot bedibbur umachashava mitparshim umitpardim mehakkedushsha, kemo shekkatuv battikkunim veraya mehemna: "leafrasha [kulei]". vehayeynu – kannoda mimma sheamru: "al shello berchu battora techilla" kulei, shehu al-yede hameshachat or-en-sof bechachma illaa hamelubbeshet bahen, uvechachma itberiru" – beor-en-sof shebbah.
Vehameshacha zo naasa al-yede deyokan haelyon shel haadam, haosek gam ken bahalachot ellu lemala besharsho, benukeva dizer anpin" divria-yetzira-asiyya.

Uvaze yuvan chiyyuv kol nefesh-ruach-neshama lehashelim kol hattaryag bemachashava dibbur umaase shehen perate hahalachot, utzerichot lavo begilgul lehashelim hattora bifshat-remez-derush-sod, kede levarer kol habberurin hannogot lahem mikkol harappach, shehi komat adam shelema, taryag bechinot kelaliyyot uferatiyyot.

Aval leatid lavo, kesheyyushelam habberur, yihye esek hattora bivchinat "ase tov" levad – lehaalot hannefesh-ruach-neshama mala mala ad en sof, vegam beshasa lo taase besharshan lemala, shehen gevurot kedoshot, ulehamtikan bachasadim beramach mitzvot ase, ulechallan yachad.

Veal ken, hattora chullah nitzchit bichlalah uvifratah, sheggam perate hahalachot deshasa lo taase, hen hen anafim mehakkelalot, veyesh lechullam shoresh lemala baAdonai gevurot dikdushsha, kemo hashasa lo taase atzman, shehen lemala bechinat haddam hamechayye haevarim dechelim dizer anpin":
